#530. ‘The Rings of Power’s Best Storyline Kicks Off With an Emotional Death

📅 14 Nov 2026

‘The Rings of Power’s Best Storyline Kicks Off With an Emotional Death

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/the-rings-of-power-season-3-earien-death-numenor-storyline/

Editor's note: The below contains spoilers for The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 Episode 2.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's likely that the rings of power plotline that longtime fans of j. R. R. Tolkien's larger Middle-earth saga are most invested in is everything regarding Númenor. Certainly one of the draws of exploring the Second Age is seeing this island kingdom at its peak, as well as the inevitable descent into civil unrest between two warring factions vying for the nation's well-being. But only two episodes into its third season, the Prime Video series raises the stakes when Eärien (Ema Horvath), the daughter of Elendil (Lloyd Owen), is discovered as a spy for the Faithful, leading to a harrowing self-sacrifice that no one saw coming.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, eärien's mere existence in the rings of power was an issue for some viewers. Having officially joined the Faithful in the five years between the second season and the third, Eärien works stealthily under Ar-Pharazôn (Trystan Gravelle), feeding intel to her father through her brother Isildur, who has returned home. After all, Elendil is said to have two sons — Isildur (Maxim Baldry) and Anárion (Andrew Richardson), with the latter finally arriving this season — but not a daughter. Created specifically for Prime Video's adaptation, Eärien has always been presented as a woman torn between loyalty and duty, and Season 3 has finally forced her to pick a side, despite the high cost. Upon being discovered, however, she chooses not to betray her family or convictions, but rather to throw herself from Pharazôn's window, a drastic but understandable action that costs her life. Although Rings of Power had finally pushed Eärien to the right side, her sudden demise reminds us that the threat the Faithful are facing is real — and that Númenor is worse off than things may appear on the surface.

From new projects in beloved franchises to festive holiday films.

Berdasarkan laporan, there's an argument to be made that the rings of power has always been at its best when it's given the númenor plot the time of day. From what's revealed up front, it feels as if The Rings of Power aimed to spend the season exploring Isildur and Eärien's strategic rebellion, but all of that quickly changed when Eärien was discovered and thus flung herself onto the streets of Armenelos. Elendil was one of the more interesting and complex characters in the first season, and Tar-Míriel (Cynthia Addai-Robinson) is, naturally, essential to the nation's fate. From the moment viewers return to the island kingdom, the show sets up a game of undercover cat and mouse, as Eärien attempts to balance complex political maneuvers with keeping a low profile. While last season began the conflict between the King's Men faction and the Faithful, Season 3 gives the struggle real legs. Although Eärien refuses to betray her kin or the Faithful, her betrayal has forced Pharazôn's hand, as he aims to wage war against his fellow Númenóreans.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as elendil and míriel wrestle for power against pharazôn, the rings of power seems to be setting up the cataclysm to come. This is exactly what occurs in the vision that Míriel has in the first season after contact with the palantír, and it's undoubtedly where the Prime Video series is heading. This angers Eru Ilúvatar, the God of Tolkien’s world, who not only annihilates Pharazôn and his forces, but, like the biblical Great Flood or the tragedy of Atlantis, sends a massive wave to destroy Númenor itself. In Tolkien's writings, he reveals that Pharazôn eventually forces Míriel to marry him before Sauron (Charlie Vickers) seduces the ruler into a full-scale assault on Valinor to usurp the Valar in an effort to claim eternal life for Men. That said, even with the outcome in mind, how Númenor gets there has always been the most interesting part of that story — with Eärien's demise being one more step toward that ultimate fate.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, elendil and his sons have a destiny of their own, one that doesn't include their fallen daughter and sister. Elendil would abandon the depraved Númenor to establish the united Kingdoms of Gondor and Arnor, kingdoms his sons would inherit. Not only does Aragorn reunite the fractured kingdoms, but he becomes pivotal in the final defeat of Sauron centuries later. Through this royal lineage, Aragorn is eventually born during the Third Age. Now, it's hard to say when exactly this will all take place in The Rings of Power, but we can rest easy knowing the show has not only firmly set its course, but is now driving full-speed ahead.

New episodes of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power are available for streaming Wednesdays on Prime Video.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we have multiple fallout projects in active development right now," bethesda said in an official announcement this summer. Diungkapkan bahwa fallout 3 and fallout: new vegas' remasters follow last year's release of the elder scrolls 4: oblivion remastered, which was co-developed by virtuos and bethesda game studios. Fallout 3 is set in and around Washington D. 200 years after a devastating nuclear war, and players control a 19-year-old Vault dweller in search of their missing father.

Diungkapkan bahwa fallout: new vegas followed in 2010, and was developed by obsidian entertainment. It was set in the Mojave Desert and casts players as a courier who becomes embroiled in a conflict between various factions who are vying for control of the region.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in addition to new fallout games, a third season of the fallout tv series is in the works and recently wrapped filming. Bethesda Game Studios is also hard at work on the next game in its fantasy role-playing game series: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is now in development.

#535. 12 Best Sci-Fi Movies Released Since Blade Runner, Ranked

📅 14 Nov 2026

12 Best Sci-Fi Movies Released Since Blade Runner, Ranked

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/best-sci-fi-movies-since-blade-runner/

Diungkapkan bahwa in many ways, ridley scott's original blade runner helped redefine what sci-fi movies could achieve both in terms of visual and narrative storytelling, playing a solid role in why the genre is still so prevalent today. Keeping that in mind, it's interesting to look at some of the biggest and best sci-fi movies that have been released in the decades since.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, since 1982's blade runner, plenty of movies have pushed science fiction and its many sub-genres in all kinds of exciting new directions, exploring new concepts and using groundbreaking film-making technologies to create some of the most influential stories ever put on screen. To determine the best sci-fi movies since Blade Runner, this ranking considers factors like overall quality, originality, and overall cultural/lasting impact.

Keeping that in mind, here are 12 of the biggest and best sci-fi movies in the last four decades since Ridley Scott's original Blade Runner, ranked from great to greatest.

Out of all the Star Wars movies released since Blade Runner, George Lucas' Revenge of the Sith feels the most worthy of being on this list, one of the most compelling and beloved sci-fi fantasy blockbusters of the modern era.

Diungkapkan bahwa as the final chapter in the prequel trilogy and the last star wars movie from lucas himself, revenge of the sith details anakin skywalker's tragic transformation into darth vader, bringing the original 6-film skywalker saga full circle with the republic becoming palpatine's galactic empire, as seen in the original trilogy. Despite its dark narrative, Revenge of the Sith features some of the most impressive and memorable sci-fi visuals in the entire Star Wars franchise.

Berdasarkan laporan, time travel has inspired plenty of complicated science-fiction stories over the years, though one of the most entertaining and arguably most accessible is back to the future, directed by robert zemeckis. Transported from 1985 to 1955 in a time-traveling DeLorean, Michael J. Fox's Marty McFly is endlessly entertaining as he attempts to make it back to his own timeline with help from Christopher Lloyd's Doc Brown before his own existence is erased. Across the board, Back to the Future is one of the most perfect sci-fi blockbusters, including its sequels, proving that not every sci-fi has to be so dark and serious.

To this day, Christopher Nolan's Inception has one of the most fascinating sci-fi premises, exploring the idea of infiltrating one's dreams using the classic tropes and concepts of a heist film with professional operatives stealing information from the subconscious, and the unique challenge of planting an idea in a target's head without them realizing it wasn't their own.

Sebagaimana diketahui, starring leonardo dicaprio, joseph gordon levitt, elliot page, tom hardy, and more hollywood legends, inception is easily one of the greatest and most original sci-fi films on this list, one that trusts viewers to keep up with its admittedly complicated ideas for the sake of providing some brilliant visuals as it showcases the "architecture of dreams. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, denis villeneuve's arrival takes the alien invasion premise and turns it on its head, putting the themes of communication and connection at the forefront rather than the typical narratives of violence and humanity being on the brink of extinction. Rather than treating the visiting aliens as straightforward threats, language and its effects on a species serve as the central sci-fi concept, with a linguist played by Amy Adams gradually having her perceptions of time shifted the more she learns their language.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the result is one of the most beautiful and captivating sci-fi films in the modern era. While Arrival might not have the usual fast-paced stakes or conflict seen in other sci-fi epics, Villeneuve still managed to create solid tension all the same.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thanks to interstellar, christopher nolan absolutely deserves to be on this list twice. An incredibly bold space epic with a mission to save humanity as a dying Earth becomes harder and harder to inhabit, the true dangers of space are on full display with one of the most scientifically accurate sci-fi movies of all time.

Diungkapkan bahwa interstellar is also one of the most emotionally devastating on this list, particularly as matthew mcconaughey's cooper is forced to leave his children behind. Just like in Inception and subsequent films on this list, composer Hans Zimmer further cements himself with Interstellar as a key architect of how sci-fi movies sound in the modern era. The film may have some clunkier dialogue and exposition in some places, though that certainly doesn't keep it from being one of the best sci-fi movies of all time, especially with its massive scale of space and time being contrasted with a strong thematic focus on family throughout.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the terminator is easily one of the most influential science-fiction action movies ever made, introducing audiences to a terrifyingly classic dystopian future where humanity has nearly been wiped out by its own robotic creations. Also featuring time travel, James Cameron's iconic film details the robots' effort to end the war before it can even begin by sending a Terminator back in time to kill the mother of humanity's greatest leader/savior in the future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the sci-fi premise is brilliantly simple, making for one of the best sci-fi action movies of the 80s, and arnold schwarzenegger's performance made the terminator a huge cinematic icon. Despite its more modest scale, the impressive use of physical effects helped make the world and its mythology incredibly fascinating, and it's no wonder that the movie has generated as many sequel projects as it has.

Diungkapkan bahwa showcasing the dangers of unchecked scientific power in one of the most fantastic ways possible, steven spielberg's jurassic park brought dinosaurs back to life in a way never experienced before. A personal favorite of mine, the blending of groundbreaking visual effects and practical animatronics ensures that the early 90s movie still holds up quite well today. While the movie naturally generated multiple sequels and an entire Jurassic franchise, none have managed to fully rival the original.

Sebagaimana diketahui, james cameron's aliens is perhaps even more impactful on the sci-fi genre than the terminator, the sequel to ridley scott's original film that elevated the original concepts into a major horror-action film. Expanding the Alien universe with new technology, characters, and brand-new ways to make Xenomorphs even more dangerous, Cameron's Aliens is one of the best examples of a sequel finding its own unique identity while still building on the foundation of what made the first entry so captivating in the first place.

Berdasarkan laporan, when we're talking about some of the best sci-fi movies since the original blade runner, it only makes sense to include its epic follow-up with denis villeneuve's blade runner 2049. Another solid example of a sci-fi sequel finding its own unique identity while honoring the original material, 2049 takes place decades after the original, following replicant Blade Runner K (Ryan Gosling) as he uncovers a discovery that could massively change the relationship between humans and artificial life.

Diungkapkan bahwa naturally, k's investigation eventually leads to harrison ford's rick deckard, providing a strong connection to the original film while gosling's performance knocks it out of the park. The cinematography is also on another level, expanding the world and future of the first movie rather than just repeating it.

The Matrix may very well be one of the most perfect sci-fi movies of all time, particularly the first chapter directed by the Wachowskis.

After learning the truth about his life and digital existence, Neo (Keanu Reeves) chooses to wake up to the much harsher reality as "The One" who's capable of changing the dark future humanity has found itself in.

Sebagaimana diketahui, featuring groundbreaking visual effects, reeves remains one of the biggest sci-fi action icons thanks to the matrix for good reason. Featuring several philosophical ideas about reality and free will, the movie goes beyond typical blockbuster spectacle as well, making it one of the most enduring and best sci-fi achievements of all time, much like Blade Runner.

#536. Ex-Cop Sentenced to Chemical Castration After He Was Convicted of Child Rape

Ex-Cop Sentenced to Chemical Castration After He Was Convicted of Child Rape

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/crime-news/news/ex-police-officer-convicted-of-child-rape-to-be-castrated/

A former Louisiana police officer and volunteer firefighter convicted of raping children was sentenced to three life prison sentences and castration as an additional punishment.

Berdasarkan laporan, kedreyon k. Williams, of New Roads, was found guilty in October of three counts of first-degree child rape, indecent behavior with a child and possession of pornography involving children following a four-day trial, according to the 18th Judicial District Attorney’s Office.

“A rape conviction automatically carries a mandatory sentence of life in prison, but District Attorney Tony Clayton went a step further and filed the motion for castration,” the office said in a Friday, November 13, news release.

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2024, louisiana became the first state to legalize surgical castration as punishment for people convicted of sex crimes against a child younger than 12, according to the associated press. Louisiana and a few other states also allow for chemical castration in cases involving sex crime convictions.

Williams, 31, was sentenced to undergo chemical castration, the district attorney’s office confirmed to Louisiana First News.

Diungkapkan bahwa “he performed disgusting acts on children who could not defend themselves,” clayton said in a statement. “He is a child predator and he deserves exactly what he is getting and more. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “the castration is another layer of punishment for these horrendous crimes,” clayton added. “If a man takes sexual advantage of a child, and we will take his manhood!”.

Williams, who previously worked as a New Roads police officer and volunteer firefighter in the city, was convicted in connection with the rapes of multiple children ages 8 to 11, according to prosecutors.

He allegedly forced them to perform sex acts, including at New Roads fire stations, his workplace at a business and his home.

Williams was also found guilty in connection with a video found on his phone that showed “a child performing a sex act on him,” the district attorney’s office said.

Diungkapkan bahwa authorities launched an investigation after a child’s mother alerted police to information her child shared with her, according to prosecutors. Then, investigators identified additional children who Williams allegedly abused.

During Williams’ trial, 12 jurors returned guilty verdicts against him after deliberating for 39 minutes, the district attorney’s office said.

Diungkapkan bahwa the district attorney’s office didn’t specify when williams may undergo chemical castration, a rare punishment involving administering pharmaceutical drugs to stop a person’s sex drive, according to louisiana law review. Chemical castration has been allowed under state law since 2008.

A defendant sentenced to chemical castration in Louisiana must first be evaluated by a court-appointed medical expert who will determine whether they are “an appropriate candidate” for treatment, according to state law.

#540. Bloodborne Just Got A Complete Overhaul On PC

📅 14 Nov 2026

Bloodborne Just Got A Complete Overhaul On PC

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/bloodborne-pc-overhaul-path-tracing-mod/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bloodborne's status as a playstation 4 exclusive has caused no shortage of complaints over the years, especially now that over a decade has passed without any platform update. While it's perfectly functional on the platform, the frame rate could be a lot better, and those without a PS4 have long hoped for it to be more widely available.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the meantime, fans have been making it a lot more accessible on pc. Fans seeking to play it on their computer can choose between either an emulated solution that's received plenty of updates over time or a more recent native decompilation port (which unfortunately made some use of AI in development). If you want to double down on the latter, a new lighting overhaul takes things even further.

Berdasarkan laporan, bloodborne pc path tracing, uploaded to nexus mods by ssoullxx, delivers a full suite of ray-traced features to the unofficial pc port of bloodborne. The description lists its additions as follows: "ray traced moonlight, global illumination, shadows, reflections, puddle mirrors and glass, with DLSS Ray Reconstruction. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the project is currently an alpha build, meaning that not everything will look correct in the new version as it stands. That being said, those who have already played Bloodborne countless times could still appreciate a new look for the game, and future updates might deliver more thoroughly on the potential for a ray-traced version. It's also possible to toggle the overhaul on and off while playing simply by pressing F9, so there's no real commitment involved here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's certainly been cool to see the community work on bloodborne over the years, but as with many fan projects, recent months have seen a major turn toward ai-assisted coding. On top of the AI assistance involved in the unofficial Bloodborne PC port, the Nexus Mods page for the Path Tracing mod features a disclosure noting that "AI produced the majority of the code, or the UI, or the voice, the dialogue, the translations, music, or other assets. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, opinions on ai coding vary greatly, but there are at least a couple of reasons to think twice before gleefully installing vibe-coded ports or mods. To begin with, AI code is typically going to be less efficient than that of a skilled human programmer, increasing the odds of poor performance or problems that might not be present in 100% human work. The environmental impact of running large language models is also worth considering, especially in light of the sheer volume of projects using AI to generate code.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when it comes to lighting, there's also the simple matter of bespoke design. The original version of Bloodborne features atmospheric lighting from the hands of FromSoft's skilled designers, which even a human-coded ray-tracing mod would run the risk of losing. There's no denying that this mod is a drastic overhaul of Bloodborne, but whether the iconic game is in need of one is a question that anyone considering an installation will have to decide for themselves.

We will vigorously defend this action and are confident that the courts will vindicate Michael Mann’s statutory rights under the Copyright Act.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the director's stance is that the script for heat was his own original work, as it was an adaptation of his novel of the same name. Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/celebrity-body/news/lindsay-arnold-details-sister-rylees-dwts-fitness-routine/

Lindsay Arnold is revealing how younger sister Rylee Arnoldis staying in tip-top shape ahead of the Dancing With the Stars season 35 semifinals.

“My baby sister’s snatched physique is going viral right now, well deserved, and I’m here to give you all the secrets,” Lindsay, 32, a former DWTS pro herself, began a Thursday, November 12, TikTok video.

Lindsay noted that as a certified personal trainer, she designed Rylee’s fitness routine to better focus on “more consistent workouts” more than one year ago.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the movement club fitness app founder explained that rylee, 21, asked her to create a program for her so that she could maintain her stamina off-season and feel like “she never stepped away” from the ballroom. (Rylee and season 35 dance partner Connor Wood are about to enter week 10 of the competition and are inching closer to the season finale. ).

Rylee also asked about “increasing her muscle tone and muscle definition,” which Lindsay took into account while tailoring her program.

Berdasarkan laporan, “as an oldest sister, when a baby sister comes to you and wants help or wants your advice on something, it’s the best day ever,” lindsay gushed. “So I immediately got her onto a full workout regimen, as well as incorporating some supplements into her everyday routine. ”.

Before season 35 of DWTS began, Lindsay said that her sibling did six days of workouts with one rest day.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i would always start her with 30 minutes of cardio,” the mother of three explained, noting that the types of cardio would vary between a stationary bike, treadmill at a 12 incline and three speed, followed by a “30 to 45 minute movement club session. ”.

Rylee also followed her sister’s six-week Advanced Weights program, which uses five to 20-pound dumbbells, a workout bench and resistance bands.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “rylee followed along with [it] religiously, which was so cool to see,” lindsay shared. “I’ve been so proud of Rylee and her consistency in moving her body and working towards her goals and obviously it’s been a huge payoff. ”.

Once Rylee began her DWTS journey, Lindsay said they “shifted” her fitness regime since she was already dancing up to nine hours a day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, lindsay explained that instead of focusing on the advanced weights program, she pointed rylee to her app’s pilates x strength program. It combines the “incredible lengthening and flexibility” of Pilates-style workouts with “strength and weighted” workouts.

Berdasarkan laporan, “then cardio every day is based on her preference and energy levels,” lindsay shared, pointing out that “the dancing and rehearsals that she’s doing is providing an incredible amount of cardio into her routine. ”.

Lindsay, who exited DWTS in 2022, admitted that being a pro on the show gives dancers an amount of cardio that “isn’t realistic in everyday life” and is definitely a factor in Rylee’s toned physique.

As the season has progressed, Lindsay told Rylee to “focus on protein intake,” and encouraged her to add 5 mg of creatine into her daily routine to support her muscles and keep building strength.

Berdasarkan laporan, “speaking from experience of being in that position [on dwts], i always found that during a season, with the amount of cardio demands on you and the amount of calories that you are burning through in a day with a rigorous schedule,” lindsay explained. “I found it was really hard for me to maintain my muscle definition and tone throughout a season. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “rylee is absolutely incredible. What she’s able to manage and do in her days, she’s amazing,” she said. “I’m so proud of her across the board: her work ethic, her talent, her choreography ability has just been absolutely off the charts this season, and I could not be more proud of her. ”.

#548. Tom Hardy's Ridley Scott Thriller Is The Ultimate Slow-Burn, And Season 2 Can't Come Soon Enough

Tom Hardy's Ridley Scott Thriller Is The Ultimate Slow-Burn, And Season 2 Can't Come Soon Enough

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/tom-hardy-taboo-thriller-series-slow-burn-season-2-in-development/

Diungkapkan bahwa cher thompson is a senior staff writer at screen rant, where she covers everything from explosive reality tv moments to cast interviews about the twists and turns of scripted dramas. With a background in creative writing, marketing, and teaching, Cher knows how to spot both the storytelling genius and the guilty pleasures in pop culture. Her work blends wit with insight, making readers feel like they’re chatting with a friend who just happens to know way too much about TV.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some tv thrillers make their biggest impression through constant action, while others take their time establishing an atmosphere like tom hardy's ridley scott slow burn series, which will be returning for a second season in the near future. While a flash-in-the-pan thriller series can make waves in the short-term, shows that build out their stories and establish a long game can be more interesting to viewers. When all of the elements of a show with a slow burning plot come together, it can be delicious for the audience as a reward for their time spent watching and faith in the writers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this slow burning quality is what makes one of hardy's most distinctive tv projects worth revisiting, especially as the series has a second season coming in the future. The historical thriller, which premiered in 2017 and has remained in the public conversation since, had some struggling with its deliberately slow pacing, while other viewers praised the way that it took on dense storytelling. The series, created by Hardy and his father, Chips, and executive produced by Ridley Scott, follows James Delaney (Hardy) a mysterious adventurer returning to London in the early 1800s to claim an inheritance and confront issues within his father's business.

Berdasarkan laporan, although it's been nearly a decade since the first season of taboo aired in 2017, the show has long been a topic of conversation, especially with the series' second season being confirmed by hardy himself in recent press. While the wait's been long, the journey to Taboo season 2 will surely be well worth the wait.

Berdasarkan laporan, set in 1814, taboo follows hardy's james keziah delaney, an adventurer who returns to london after years in africa left him presumed dead back at home. Word of his father's death brings him back to claim what remains of his family's shipping empire, but James' inheritance isn't exactly straightforward, as the East India Company has their own business interests in the company. Other powerful figures also have their own reasons for keeping Delaney from taking control of the family business, as his return opens old wounds and changes family relationships. As the reasons behind his father's passing are called into question, Delaney's world slowly begins to fall apart.

Diungkapkan bahwa while the show does operate as a period piece due to its timing, it isn't always a conventional one. The version of London that unfurls in Taboo is grim and complicated, focusing on a more corrupt depiction of the city than the reality of what early 19th century London was like. With Hardy's performance anchoring the show, Taboo is able to move within its slow rolling story because his spectacular performance. On top of Hardy, the ensemble cast of the series does a phenomenal job in depicting a fascinating mix of characters in the most difficult of circumstances.

Berdasarkan laporan, after a renewed burst of attention because of a streaming resurgence, taboo is more in demand than it's ever been before. With Delaney and his companions leaving London on the search for their next adventure, the challenges that came with creating another season of Taboo didn't seem too intense when the first season came to a close. The most frustrating part of Taboo's legacy has been the fact that it had a stellar first season and seemed like a series that was determined to continue, but has yet to air another season after its 2017 debut. Thankfully, Hardy himself recently confirmed there was more to come.

Sebagaimana diketahui, despite the unusually long wait between seasons, taboo does seem like it will be back for another season at some point, though there's no filming dates or release window to speak of. Taboo has demonstrated with ease that its long-form storytelling can have a lasting impact, so the amount of time between seasons may simply create more material for the show to work with. Though a second season isn't guaranteed to arrive anytime soon, the series does seem to be a lock for another season in the future. Taboo's return will be another win for Hardy.

Tiger Woods Breaks Silence on NBC Sportscaster Dan Hicks' Death

Tiger Woods has broken his silence on the death of his longtime friend, NBC sportscaster Dan Hicks.

Berdasarkan laporan, “dan hicks was beloved by all who had the privilege of knowing and working alongside him. His kindness, warmth, and presence will be deeply missed,” Woods, 50, wrote via X on Friday, November 13.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “like so many in the golf world, dan was a great friend to me both on and off the course,” he continued. “I had the utmost respect for him and the incredible job he did for our sport for decades. ”.

Woods then shared his support for Hicks’ wife, ESPN anchor Hannah Storm, and their kids, Hannah, 29, Ellery, 28, and Riley, 25.

Diungkapkan bahwa “our thoughts are with hannah and their daughters during this incredibly difficult time,” he wrote. “I hope they find comfort in knowing how much he meant to so many people and the lasting impact he made on everyone whose life he touched. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa hicks died on wednesday, november 11, at age 64. His wife revealed that he died of “an acute illness. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “he was a devoted husband of over 30 years, loving father to our three daughters, and cherished friend to so many,” storm, also 64, wrote via instagram on thursday, november 12. “His loss is immeasurable. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, storm continued, “dan was truly one of a kind and, quite simply, the person everyone wanted to be around. Our three daughters and I are heartbroken. He was endlessly kind, thoughtful and funny, and he made everyone feel like they mattered. We are grateful for the love and support surrounding our family during this incredibly difficult time. When he walked into the room, he brought the energy, the laughter, and the people together. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, she concluded, “there are simply no words to express how much he will be missed. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nbc sports also released a statement on thursday, calling hicks “an extraordinary colleague, friend and person. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, “in his 34 years at nbc sports, he was an exceptional storyteller and caller of games and events who elevated some of the biggest moments in sports history,” the statement read. “From Olympic swimming and skiing to Notre Dame football, numerous other high profile events and especially as the signature voice of our golf coverage for the last 26 years, Dan’s blend of knowledge, style, enthusiasm and humor informed and entertained fans for decades. ”.

Hicks joined NBC in 1992 and became the network’s lead golf play-by-play announcer in 2000.

Berdasarkan laporan, the network added, “dan was a better person who welcomed teammates with a smile, a joke, or a word of encouragement, sometimes all three in the same sentence. ”.

#550. Apple TV’s 5-Season Sci-Fi Spectacle Delivers a Masterclass in Worldbuilding

📅 14 Nov 2026

Apple TV’s 5-Season Sci-Fi Spectacle Delivers a Masterclass in Worldbuilding

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/for-all-mankind-apple-tv-worldbuilding-masterclass/

Berdasarkan laporan, julio is a senior author for collider. He studied History and International Relations at university, but found his calling in cultural journalism. Having loved movies, music, and TV from an early age, he prides himself in knowing every minute detail about the things he loves. When he isn't writing, Julio also teaches English at a nearby school. He has lived in São Paulo most of his life, where he covers CCXP and other big events. When he is older, he dreams of owning a movie theater in a small countryside town.

Berdasarkan laporan, when watching science fiction, feeling immersed in the story's universe goes a long way in getting the viewer to like it — if you feel like you're part of that world, you'll never forget it. It's set right here, on Earth, over a timeframe that comprises most of our lifetimes, but in a completely different timeline. " And, right now, there is no better sci-fi work to properly understand worldbuilding than Apple TV's For All Mankind. That's the power of worldbuilding, the narrative process through which storytellers create the settings of their stories, from the environment to its "rules. While everything is familiar enough for the viewer to feel "at home," its world is wildly imaginative in how it's built, making this series a true masterclass in this subject.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, right now, the world is experiencing a sort of "space age renaissance" of sorts, but in for all mankind, the space race never ended. Now, NASA and the government need not only to understand why they were beaten, but also to double down on achieving the next big milestone and take the lead. The series begins with the USSR landing a cosmonaut on the Moon before the US, which is enough to set that world on a completely different path from our own. The Soviets also don't want to be overtaken, and so the space race continues.

Berdasarkan laporan, over five seasons, for all mankind explores the increasingly dramatic consequences of this historical divergence. In Season 2, the Moon becomes another battleground in the Cold War. By Season 3, the focus shifts to Mars, with several players competing to become the first to reach it. Each season is set in a different decade, focusing on the next steps of space exploration. In the fourth season, humanity attempts to establish a more permanent presence there, while the fifth examines all the implications of human ambitions beyond Earth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all that might sound like a lot, but it's actually what the series is really all about: imagining what humanity might have accomplished if the technological and political momentum of the 1960s had continued uninterrupted. Its greatest achievement is making this hypothetical and increasingly extraordinary future feel like the natural consequence of events that began with a single different historical moment. The characters and their stories are the vehicle that takes us there, but the world itself is the main sight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with such a huge timeframe, for all mankind is more of a generational saga rather than a single individual story, and it's through these people's eyes — especially astronaut ed baldwin (joel kinnaman) and his family — that we experience how different their world becomes from ours. A lot must happen before any rocket can leave the ground, though. That's where most of the worldbuilding takes place and what makes this series so special, as it spends just as much time setting all that up on Earth as it does among the stars.

Berdasarkan laporan, the soviets arriving first on the moon has some serious ramifications. This leads to technological advancements coming to the population much earlier than they do in real life. No US President wants to be the one who "lost the Moon," so investments in space exploration increase on both sides of the Cold War. Personal computers and electric cars are on the market by the 1980s, for example, as well as screens becoming the norm for long-distance communication instead of phones.

Berdasarkan laporan, naturally, the political arena is impacted, too. Space exploration sees the rise of some unlikely heroes on both sides, leading to some crucial (and rather weird) differences from our world. Progressives and conservatives trade places multiple times, with some unlikely candidates becoming world leaders instead of those we learn about in school. Ted Kennedy beats Richard Nixon by cancelling his trip to Chappaquiddick, show character Ellen Wilson (Jodi Balfour) wins the 1992 election over Bill Clinton, and because Ellen wins the election she also pushes forward the legalizing of same-sex marriage in 1998. The series leans into all of the what-ifs of American history without ever lingering too long in any one major change.

Joel Kinnaman as Ed Baldwin and Masha Mashkova as Svetlana Zakharova in a space shuttle cockpit in For All Mankind Season 4.

Joel Kinnaman as Ed Baldwin and Masha Mashkova as Svetlana Zakharova in a space shuttle cockpit in For All Mankind Season 4.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with every new season of for all mankind, an archival-style montage helps to ease the viewers into the new decade, getting them up to speed about everything that happened in the world between one season and the other. With every major development, the series' timeline grows more and more distant from ours, but everything is still rooted in real historical foundations. Regardless of how different things might be, there is always some common ground between fiction and reality, including political personalities and NASA personnel.

Berdasarkan laporan, among the many what-ifs, it's particularly interesting how the series uses real-world events like the rise of tech billionaires in the private sector to add new players to its imagined space race. By the 1990s, they are already a key part of exploration, with enough power to stand up to both the US and the USSR, sometimes even forcing them to cooperate. Soon enough, other space-faring countries also rise to prominence, just as developing countries like the BRICS became important in the international arena in the 2000s, too.

Berdasarkan laporan, worldbuilding in alternate history, like for all mankind, is a challenge in itself, as it demands a solid foundation in reality. Finding the balance between what is real and its plausible imagined ramifications can be tricky, but For All Mankind does it in a way that allows it to become an inspiration instead of a dark mirror. Instead of feeling detached from our world, this makes us even more connected; what separates us from that are only a few different outcomes and decisions, so why not chase them?.

For All Mankind is streaming on Apple TV.

#555. 2nd Woman Found Buried in Man's Basement Identified Nearly 40 Years Later

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/crime-news/news/woman-found-buried-in-nashville-basement-identified/

Investigators have identified the second of two women found buried in a shallow grave in the dirt floor of a basement nearly 40 years after the discovery.

Diungkapkan bahwa forensic genetic genealogy identified the woman as toni l. Gordon, a 31-year-old Nashville resident who was discovered in 1987 in the basement of a home rented by her killer, James Shaffer, the Metropolitan Nashville Police Department announced in a Monday, November 9, news release.

Gordon was buried alongside another woman, identified in 2025 as 23-year-old Sheila Cummings, in the dirt floor of the basement in Nashville, according to police.

Investigators believe Shaffer murdered Gordon and Cummings two years before they were found.

Their identities remained a mystery, with Shaffer only referring to Gordon as “Lil’ Bit,” police said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shaffer confessed to the murders following the discovery of their bodies and was sentenced to serve two life sentences, according to police. He died behind bars in 2004.

“Family members believed that Gordon moved out of state and lost contact with them,” police said in the news release.

Authorities notified them of the identification of her remains.

By the time a tenant discovered both women’s skeletal remains at the Nashville home, Shaffer was imprisoned in Kentucky in connection with the rape and kidnapping of a teenage boy, according to the Nashville Banner.

When Shaffer confessed to the killings, he claimed the women were sex workers and that he murdered them out of anger when he discovered they had allegedly tried to steal something from him, the news outlet reported.

In January 2025, the remains of both Gordon and Cummings were exhumed for a forensic analysis, The Tennessean reported.

Cummings, who was from Elgin, Illinois, was identified months later after a DNA sample was collected from her adult daughter, according to the newspaper.

The woman had previously called cold case investigators about her missing mother, who she said vanished in 1984, the newspaper reported.

Nashville police worked with DNA Investigative Solutions, Bode Technology, the National Missing & Unidentified Persons System, a medical examiner’s office and the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation to identify both women.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i think my goal was to have people see elizabeth,” evans said, while acknowledging how the final product made him appear “conniving” to audiences. “When I watch that movie, I see the person that I love and exactly who she is. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “we had a 30-minute zoom, and you were like, ‘yeah, come over with cameras,’” he recalled. That’s all you agreed to. “We wanted to show you what became the first half of the film, and then we would talk about it. ”.

#562. Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt's Daughter Vivienne Reveals Eating Disorder Battle

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/celebrity-body/news/angelina-jolie-brad-pitts-daughter-details-eating-disorder/

Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt’s daughter Vivienne bared her soul through art while revealing she was hospitalized for an eating disorder earlier this year.

The 18-year-old opened up about her private health battle as part of her Los Angeles art exhibition titled “The Tulip Field: A Gallery on Patience of Patients,” displayed from November 2 through November 8 at Forager Crafts.

Berdasarkan laporan, “welcome to the tulip field,” vivienne wrote in a statement at the exhibit via page six. “Why is it called The Tulip Field, you ask? Like many, I have struggled with mental health. I have also struggled with an eating disorder. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa she recalled, “at the beginning of this year, i was hospitalized for my ed. I was angry, sick, and very alone. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, vivienne, who is one of jolie and pitt’s six children, revealed that with time she embraced the people and the environment at the hospital. (In addition to Vivienne and her twin brother, Knox, the former couple also share kids Maddox, Zahara, Shiloh and Pax. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, “eventually, however, the kindness and warmth of the kids and staff at the hospital broke down the walls i had built so high,” she wrote. “I have never laughed or cried harder, never been more honest or more myself. ”.

Vivienne noted that it was the other kids at the hospital who helped her find her strength.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the other kids there taught me how to be strong when you are at your weakest,” she continued. “It was the worst and best time of my life and I am better for it. ”.

Vivienne shared with artgoers that the exhibit was meant to document her time at the hospital and how it transformed her life.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the tulip field is what i call the hospital and the paintings here represent moments in time spent there,” she wrote. “Moments of hopelessness, moments I couldn’t stop laughing, moments of safety, moments of bravery. ”.

The Maleficent actress explained that there were no photographs taken during her hospitalization, so the artwork is a way to depict the feelings and emotions she experienced along with the other patients.

Berdasarkan laporan, “these are our memories, our purest memories, preserved,” vivienne added. “The title of each painting is a sentence I took from journal entries I wrote during my time at the hospital, from passages I felt best fit the paintings. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one painting, titled “vitals,” showed a tulip in a hospital room getting their vitals taken. It featured a handwritten note dated May 14, 2026, that read, “I feel guilty for needing to be in the hospital this long. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a separate piece titled “sleph’s star,” depicted two tulips staring up at a gold star. The handwritten message read, “We all went to the deck last night. ”.

Us has reached out to reps for Jolie and Pitt for comment.

Vivienne’s exhibit opened the same day Us confirmed that a judge in Los Angeles granted her petition to legally change her name from Vivienne Marcheline Jolie-Pitt to Vivienne Marcheline Jolie.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, vivienne is the fourth of jolie and pitt’s children to drop the fight club actor’s moniker since the couple split in september 2016. The exes were married two years and didn’t finalize their divorce until December 2024.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you or someone you know struggles with an eating disorder, visit the national alliance for eating disorders website or call their hotline at (866) 662-1235. Text “ALLIANCE” to 741741 for free, 24/7 support.

#564. ‘Fatherland,’ ‘La Bola Negra,’ ‘Fjord’ Lead European Film Award Nominations

‘Fatherland,’ ‘La Bola Negra,’ ‘Fjord’ Lead European Film Award Nominations

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/fatherland-la-bola-negra-european-film-award-nominations-1236754942/

Sandra Hüller scored a dual best actress nom for 'Fatherland' and 'Rose,' with Renate Reinsve, Sebastian Stan, Penelope Cruz, Javier Bardem and Andrew Scott among the acting nominees.

Pawel Pawlikowski’s German black-and-white period drama Fatherland, and La Bola Negra, a gay Spanish epic from director Javier Ambrossi and Javier Calvo, are the frontrunners for the 2027 European Film Awards, with Fatherland racking up 11 EFA nominations to 10 for La Bola Negra.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, both fatherland and la bola negra picked up efa noms in the best european film, european director, european screenwriter and european cinematographer categories, with fatherland also receiving european actress and european actor noms for leads hanns zischler and sandra hüller for their performances, respectively, as nobel prize-winning writer thomas mann and daughter erika. Related Stories Movies Modern Fairy Tale 'Mo Amor' Explores Identity, Transformation and Love in All Its Forms Movies 5 Takeaways From China's Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival.

Berdasarkan laporan, hüller received a second best european actress nom, for her starring role as a 17th-century woman masquerading as a man in markus schleinzer’s rose. She’s going up against Penélope Cruz, nominated for Florian Zeller’s Bunker; Léa Seydoux for her leading role in Marie Kreutzer’s Gentle Monster; Mathilde Arcel for her performance in May el-Toukhy’s Venice Festival winner Woman Unknown; and Renate Reinsve for her starring role in Cristian Mungiu’s Palme d’Or-winning Fjord.

Sebastian Stan, who plays Reinsve’s fundamentalist Christian husband in Fjord, received a best European actor nomination, alongside Zischler; Javier Bardem, nominated for Rodrigo Sorogoyen’s The Beloved; Swann Arlaud for his turn in Emmanuel Marre’s A Man of His Time; and Andrew Scott, nominated for his performance in Simon Stone’s Elsinore as Ian Charleson, the British actor dying of AIDS who throws himself into a final performance of Hamlet.

Nominated for best European film, alongside Fatherland and La Bola Negra, are Fjord, Woman Unknown and La Gradiva, a French coming-of-age drama from first-time director Marine Atlan.

Best European director nominees, alongside Pawlikowski and Ambrossi/Calvo, are Mungiu for Fjord, Sandra Wollner for the German drama Everytime and Andrey Zvyagintsev for the Russian crime thriller Minotaur.

The European Animation Film nominees are: In Waves, directed by Phuong Mai Nguyen; Iron Boy from Louis Clichy; Jim Queen, directed by Marco Nguyen and Nicolas Athané; Lucy Lost, directed by Olivier Clert; and Viva Carmen from Sébastien Laudenbach.

Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor’s NAZA, an exposé of Israel’s war in Gaza, produced by The Guardian and Britain’s JW Films, was nominated for best European documentary, alongside Letters From the Silenced Country from director Andrei Kutsila; Pegah Ahangarani’s Rehearsals for a Revolution; To Hold a Mountain from directors Biljana Tutorov and Petar Glomazić; and Whispers in the Woods, directed by Vincent Munier.

All of the best animation and best documentary nominees are also nominated in the best European film category.

Berdasarkan laporan, the 39th european film awards will be held in athens on jan. 16, 2027.

#565. Cinephil Boards Alexandru Solomon’s Romanian Election Doc ‘Small Expectations’ – IDFA

📅 14 Nov 2026

Cinephil Boards Alexandru Solomon’s Romanian Election Doc ‘Small Expectations’ – IDFA

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://deadline.com/2026/11/cinephil-alexandru-solomon-small-expectations-idfa-1237223722/

EXCLUSIVE: Doc sales specialist Cinephil has boarded Alexandru Solomon’s Small Expectations ahead of its world premiere in the Frontlight sidebar of the International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam next week.

The first-person investigation chronicles the chaotic lead-up to Romania’s 2025 presidential election in which moderate independent Nicușor Dan faced off against far-right forces, including Trump-aligned street fighter George Simion and ultranationalist Călin Georgescu.

Diungkapkan bahwa solomon delves into the machinery of power, disinformation, and the rapid radicalization of a society under pressure, as russian interference allegations, institutional breakdowns, and the unleashing of fascist energy left romania’s democracy exposed. Related Stories Documentary IDFA Artistic Director Isabel Arrate Fernandez On Festival's Competition Lineups, "Huge" Interest In Elizabeth Holmes Doc, And AI In Documentaries Acquisitions Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere 'The Big Boom!', Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions.

Sebagaimana diketahui, production is led by award-winning romanian company microfilm, headed by ada solomon, current chair of the european film academy board, in co-production with belgium’s while we’re here (frederik nicolai and annabel verbeke). Watch on Deadline.

“Following the particular case of the Romanian elections, the film is talking about very serious matters but using an approach that we wanted vivid, unconventional and entertaining at the same time,” said Alexandru Solomon and Ada Solomon in a joint statement.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we are super excited to team up with cinephil and we are confident that we have the right partners for the international journey of the film. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa alexandru solomon is one of romania’s top documentarians. After starting out as a cinematographer for fiction films in the 990s and collaborating with other artists on experimental works, he shifted his focus to documentaries.

Diungkapkan bahwa his feature documentaries include the great communist robbery (2004), cold waves – war on radio (2007), kapitalism, our secret recipe (2010), tarzan’s testicle (2017). His work has played at film festivals including IDFA, Karlovy Vary, IFFR Rotterdam, been nominated for European Film Awards and won several national awards at home.

His most recent film, Arsenie, An Amazing Life (2023) premiered in Karlovy Vary IFF and was screened in IDFA, Valladolid and ZagrebDox, among others.

Alongside making documentaries, Soloman also teaches at University of Arts – UNArte, Bucharest, and is the president of One World Romania Association in charge of the homonym film festival, the only human rights dedicated film festival in Romania.

Berdasarkan laporan, “few directors have mapped the fault lines of contemporary romania with the consistency, courage, and cinematic intelligence of alexandru solomon. We’re honored to be collaborating with him and his team to bring Small Expectations to audiences,” said Shoshi Korman and Suzanne Nodale, co-Managing Directors of Cinephil.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “as so many countries are facing the same challenges and upcoming elections around the world, the film acts as a cautionary tale of the fragility of our democracies in an ever more connected world. ”.

Further partners include the Centrul Național al Cinematografiei (CNC), Flemish public broadcaster VRT, Romanian public broadcaster TVR, and Avanpost Media.

#572. Modern Fairy Tale ‘Mo Amor’ Explores Identity, Transformation and Love in All Its Forms

Estonian director Eeva Mägi is back at the Tallinn Black Nights Film Fest with her tender new film about a photographer, Princess Niina and her three suitors: The Mentor, The Writer and The Stonemason.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once upon a time… princess niina lived in her castle. She was courted by three suitors: The Mentor, The Writer and The Stonemason. This is, more or less, how the film Mo Amor, a tender, modern and very timely Estonian fairy tale about love in all its forms and identity, begins. And it is about to get its world premiere at the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF).

Sebagaimana diketahui, writer-director eeva mägi (mo mamma, mo papa, the weight of all the beauty) and her creative collaborators present a cinematic story told by a photographer named kaur. Inviting her former lovers to a secluded summer home, the stage is set for a strange reunion where memory, myth, and reality begin to intertwine, old wounds resurface, and love takes unexpected forms. “Princess Niina is adored by three suitors, yet remains restless, searching for something she cannot quite name,” teases a synopsis on the PÖFF website. “Then she sheds her crown and reveals her true self. ” Related Stories Movies 5 Takeaways From China's Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival Movies Joel Kinnaman to Star in Creature Thriller 'The Cell' for 'Sleeping Dogs' Director Adam Cooper (Exclusive).

Diungkapkan bahwa mo amor gets its world premiere on monday, nov. 16, in the Critics’ Picks Competition of the festival. Mägi’s previous film, Mo Papa, opened Tallinn’s Critics’ Picks section last year and earned a special mention.

Berdasarkan laporan, mägi wrote and directed the film and produced it with sten-johan lill, who also handled the cinematography. The editor was Jette Keedus. The cast features Mo Papa stars Ester Kuntu and Jarmo Reha, one of this year’s 10 rising stars in Tallinn’s Black Nights Stars showcase, as well as Tambet Tuisk, Andres Mähar, Sander Roosimägi and Ivor Mikker.

Ahead of the film’s Tallinn world premiere, Mägi talked to THR about the inspiration for the film, how identity is used in political rhetoric and the lyrical quality of Mo Amor.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i always have personal stories intertwined with stories that i want to tell for society or that society needs to be told,” the filmmaker shares about her inspiration for the new movie. But then also, transgender people are facing so many obstacles, at least in Estonia, and society is still very prejudicial towards them. “I had this idea about what if love actually survives the truth, since we lie so much to people we love just to pretend we’re someone else or are sometimes so afraid to reveal who we are. So I wanted to tell a universal love story, make a transgender person a hero and show a trans man’s fairy tale. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, mägi also emphasizes: “of course, there is no such thing as transgender love and ordinary love. It is all just pure love. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the idea to tell the journey of self-discovery and transformation that niina goes on came organically in the filmmaking process. “And it also shows that everything is possible. “I thought it would be even more powerful if I told it as a fairy tale because fairy tales allow us to talk about very difficult topics in very beautiful and universal ways,” she tells THR. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i had the feeling that it had to be a fairy tale because this story in our society is still being seen as a fairy tale – people don’t think it’s realistic. But I think we have to tell these fairy tales until they become part of our real life. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mägi loves bringing back collaborators from her past films because she shoots with a small budget and a very open process without a pre-written script that allows the creative team to explore the characters and storylines and see where the discovery process takes them. Tambet Tuisk, who’s playing The Writer, was in two of my previous short films, and he’s also part of Mo Hunt, which is my next feature film – and Jarmo is there again, too. So, these actors and others [on the production] are already used to my method. “I’ve been working with the same actors and actresses for years now,” she explains. “Both Jarmo Reha, who is Kaur, and Ester Kuntu, who’s playing Niina, were also in Mo Papa. We are all surfing on the same wave of chaos. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, mikker is not a professional actor, so how did he end up in mo amor? “i met him at a bar,” the writer-director shares. He’s studying sculpture at the Estonian Arts Academy. “He’s my friend. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, was there an option to cast a trans actor for the film? “we couldn’t find a transgender actor to play in the film because we don’t have any [in estonia],” the writer-director explains. And we are not so much concentrating on the transition period. “So, I talked to the trans community, and they thought that it was okay if Ester, as a woman, is playing Niina and Jarmo, as a man, is playing Kaur. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that was also by choice. “We didn’t want to concentrate on the transitioning period and use a lot of makeup and do all these stereotypical things that a lot of films do,” Mägi tells THR.

Diungkapkan bahwa what mo amor does feature, though, is recurring photo camera sounds followed by still frames before the “action” or moving images continue. “And when we started shooting, I realized that I wanted to have these still frames because Niina/Kaur is a photographer. “The process itself is always guiding us,” the filmmaker emphasizes. I wanted to somehow make the film reflect this profession and use it as part of the cinematic storytelling. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa mo amor was shot over the course of 17 days at the filmmaker’s boathouse on vilsandi island in the baltic sea, estonia’s westernmost populated island. “It’s very cinematic. And as we didn’t have any budget, as always, I decided to basically shoot it at home. “This place is amazing,” the creative says about the island. ”.

What can she share about her next feature, the briefly mentioned Mo Hunt? “We are in post- production at the moment,” she says.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and just like mo papa and mo amor are very different in terms of look, feel and atmosphere, mo hunt will also be a different kind of experience. “It’s a hybrid film, a staged documentary. I don’t want to repeat myself. And it’s also the outcome of the fact that we don’t have everything planned. And I guess every story has its unique ways of being reflected. We really go into the process and let the story guide us. “The visual language is different,” Mägi tells THR. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the original idea for mo hunt was to tell the story of a ballerina who becomes an illegal surrogate. “Artistic creation can become exploitation or mental abuse. I was wondering how far I can push actors just for the sake of art. I understood that there are boundaries, there are limits. “We started staging this ballerina, and then I had a feeling that I had to collect stories from different artists about how they have experienced the thin line between artistic creation and manipulation,” the director recalls. So, then I started to get interested in this topic and started collecting different stories from different artists. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that is why mo hunt will be “a staged documentary. ” Explains Mägi: “All the people in the film are playing actors, but they are presenting the stories of different artists. So, the film combines what’s happening in the fiction film with what’s actually happening in artists’ hearts and minds. ”.

#573. European Film Awards: ‘Fatherland’ & ‘La Bola Negra’ Top Nominations – Full List Of Films & Credits

European Film Awards: ‘Fatherland’ & ‘La Bola Negra’ Top Nominations – Full List Of Films & Credits

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://deadline.com/2026/11/european-film-awards-2026-nominations-1237223704/

The European Film Academy has unveiled the nominations in the 16 key categories of its 39th European Film Awards taking place in Greece in January 2027.

Paweł Pawlikowski’s Fatherland leads the nominations, making it into 11 categories, followed by Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi’s La Bola Negra with ten nominations and Cristian Mungiu’s Cannes Palme d’Or winner Fjord with five.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nominations were announced in front of a live audience on saturday at the pavlos zannas theatre in the iconic olympian building in thessaloniki, as part of the thessaloniki international film festival. Related Stories News London Film Festival: 'La Bola Negra' Wins Audience Award News 'La Bola Negra' Caliente At Box Office With $43M Worldwide, Becomes Spain's Top-Grossing Local Pic Of 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the winners will be unveiled at an awards ceremony on january 16 at the stavros niarchos foundation cultural center in athens, greece, co-organised by the european film academy and the ηellenic film and audiovisual center. Watch on Deadline.

The nominations are based on the votes of 5,700 members of the European Film Academy who have been watching the films included in the annual European Film Awards Shortlist, and will now vote for the winners.

Pawlikowski’s first film in eight years, Cold War drama Fatherland stars Hanns Zischler and Sandra Hüller as writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika as they travel across Germany in 1949 from Frankfurt in West Germany to Weimar, East Germany.

The Polish filmmaker shared the Cannes Best Director prize in May with Calvo and Ambrossi, whose La Bola Negra is one of the frontrunners across the award season this year.

Revolving around the interconnected stories of three gay men in 1932, 1937 and 2017, La Bola Negra has been raking in audience awards and storming the box office at home and internationally since its Cannes world premiere and Best Director win.

Mungiu’s Fjord, starring Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve as a Romanian and Norwegian couple whose plans for a new life in a fjord village come up against neighbors with a very different outlook on life, won the director his second Cannes Palme d’Or this year, after 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days in 2007.

Fifteen films have garnered a nomination in the European Film category spanning fiction, documentary and animation.

Previous recent winners in the category have included Best International Feature Film Oscar winners Another Round and Sentimental Value as well as Quo Vadis, Aida?, Triangle of Sadness and Anatomy of a Fall, which won the Best Original Screenplay Academy Award.

Diungkapkan bahwa a number of documentaries have been nominated for best documentary and best film including bombshell exposé naza, french box office break out whispers in the woods and letters from a silenced country. Best Animation nominees also making it into the Best Film category include festival breakouts In Waves, Iron Boy and Jim Queen.

The upcoming ceremony in Greece will be the second time the European Film Awards take place in a new January slot as part of a strategy to place them at the heart of the wider awards season, having taken place in December for many years.

Berdasarkan laporan, the january 16, 2027 slot once again falls the day after the end of nomination voting in the academy awards on january 15, and before the january 21 nominations announcement. This gives European talents in the running for the Oscars time to return home to Europe for the awards. The Golden Globes will also be done and dusted with its 2027 ceremony set for January 10.

#575. ‘Hen’ Review: A Resilient Chicken Flies the Coop, Over and Over, in an Unexpectedly Stirring Survival Story

📅 14 Nov 2026

‘Hen’ Review: A Resilient Chicken Flies the Coop, Over and Over, in an Unexpectedly Stirring Survival Story

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://variety.com/2026/film/news/hen-review-1236947197/

Like 'Au Hasard Balthasar' for the humblest of barnyard animals, Hungarian director György Pálfi's film is a remarkable technical and logistical feat, but so emotionally involving you almost forget to notice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why did the chicken cross the road? in “hen,” the answer is, as ever, to get to the other side. But it’s not the miraculous novelty of the production that crosses your mind as you’re watching: In the moment, your heart pounds for that poor, dumb but surprisingly resourceful chicken, and you lock completely into her simultaneously small and vast survival saga. But the stakes are a little higher and more urgent than that in György Pálfi unassuming marvel of a creature feature: When its gallinaceous protagonist is forced across a busy highway, it’s because a hungry fox is very much on her tailfeathers. That hunter and prey in this scenario are both played by real live animals is a large part what makes “Hen” riveting: Made without CGI, with a predominantly non-human ensemble that includes eight fowl playing the lead role alone, it’s a sustained cinematic feat of fauna-wrangling unlike any other. Related Stories Is ‘I Play Rocky’ Original or Adapted? Stallone’s ‘Rocky’ Origin Story Faces a ‘Barbie’-Style Oscar Dilemma (EXCLUSIVE) 'I Play Rocky' Star Anthony Ippolito on Becoming Sylvester Stallone and Acting With a Dog: 'He Wasn't a Huge Fan of Me'.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, coming from most filmmakers, “hen” — which premiered in toronto’s platform competition last year, earning an honorable mention from the jury — would count as an eccentric project. But from Hungarian auteur Pálfi, whose consistently experimental oeuvre includes 2006’s Cannes-selected, shape-shifting body horror “Taxidermia” and 2018’s labyrinthine mixed-media Stanislaw Lem adaptation “His Master’s Voice,” this may be the most narratively conventional film he’s ever assembled: a grandly linear hero’s journey in which the hero just happens to be a resplendently scarlet-combed and treacle-plumed chicken, whose antagonists along the way run the gamut from wild predators to human traffickers. No life form is given precedence over another, as “Hen” limns a tense dog-eat-dog-eat-bird ecosystem — the world we all know and struggle through, just from a different vantage point.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the hen in question remains nameless and voiceless from beginning to end — though the birds playing her all get star billing by name in the closing credits. ) Pálfi has little interest in directly anthropomorphic storytelling, and while his film is a rather eventfully scripted fiction, it aims for documentary-style naturalism and spontaneity. (Eszti, Szandi, Feri, Enci, Eti, Enikő, Nóra and Anett, to give them their due. The obvious recent comparison point is Jerzy Skolimowski’s Oscar-nominated donkey odyssey “EO,” minus that film’s more expressionistic flourishes; Robert Bresson’s “Au Hasard Balthasar,” too, minus at least some of its despairing tragedy.

Berdasarkan laporan, it begins in a cramped industrial farm somewhere in rural greece, where the hen’s life begins with a startlingly graphic egg-laying scene. (If you’ve ever wondered what a chicken’s cloaca looks like up close, Pálfi has you covered. ) After the fledgling chick cracks her way into the outside world — standing out from the vast crowd with her uniformly dark plumage — she soon learns the cruel ways of commercial poultry-rearing and, in time, seeks a different destiny. A heart-in-mouth chain of circumstances enables her escape; via a serious of perilous scrapes, she eventually winds up at a coastal smallholding, owned by a family who get by running a shabby café on the premises, alongside other, less legal activities.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there, she finds herself trapped again in the owners’ chicken coop, and put to work laying eggs: a less grim fate than the one that awaited her in the farm where she was born, perhaps, but an unhappy one just the same. Though Pálfi lightens matters with some droll music cues — the coop’s resident rooster is introduced to the grandiose strains of a romantic ballad by Greek favorite Grigoris Mpithikotsis — the film doesn’t shy from the traumatizing impact of what effectively amounts, for our feathered heroine, to recurring sexual assault, and the repeated theft of her eggs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and so she escapes, thrillingly, and more than once — motivated, it seems, by little more than some unknowing, unspoken sense that there has to be something else out there for her. In a particularly dark stab of irony, a key chance at liberation comes via her owners’ reckless venture into the trafficking of refugees. Though “Hen” maintains a sly comic sensibility throughout, there’s solemn substance to how it shows the interconnected abuse of human and animal rights alike, adding up to a portrait of a world sliding off its moral axis.

Berdasarkan laporan, that deft command and calibration of tone is as remarkable as the film’s seamless technical fluency, with every below-the-line contribution vital in cleaving to the chicken’s perspective. Vividly detailed sound design keeps us in her tiny headspace; ditto Giorgos Karvelas’ lithe, nimble cinematography, fully alert to her rhythm of movement and occasional, unpredictable moments of flighty rebellion. Editor Lehmhényi Réka, meanwhile, achieves the extraordinary feat of forging one coherent and characterful performance from footage of multiple birds — a patchworked star turn that invites and earns our complete emotional investment. A madly impractical and richly felt vision that pretty much required Pálfi to put all his eggs in one basket, “Hen” is a risk that pays off in heartening style.

GIJÓN, Spain — Taking place in northern Spain under two monhs after the San Sebastián International Film Festival and linked to it by the Cross Roads initiative, the 64th Gijón International Film Festival (FICX) lineup stacks many of the year’s most talked-about features from international festivals such as Cannes, Berlin, Venice and Sundance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at the same time, running nov. 13-20, the festival serves as a springboard for new local talent into the international arena, which the festival has championed for decades. Both Laxe and Trueba showcased their first works at the festival and have built long careers since their early FICX selections. Simón had her very own first retrospective at Gijón.

The Gijón Festival has a long standing tradition of mixing rising and established talent, top-tier international and regional voice rubbing shoulders, becoming a beacon for emerging talent.

Diungkapkan bahwa this year’s edition opened nov. 13 with James Gray’s “Paper Tiger,” screening in Gijón’s main Albar section. Gray’s previous feature, “Armageddon Time,” also opened the 2022 Gijón festival.

Berdasarkan laporan, closing the festival on nov. 20 is Peter Farrelly’s “I Play Rocky,” described by Variety’s Owen Gleiberman as “a cleverly crafted crowd-pleaser, all designed to tap into the love of ‘Rocky’ that has never gone away. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, “on one side we bring big names from the international industry, as we’ve done in previous editions,” explained ficx director alejandro díaz castaño. “We also bring top-Spanish talent and well-established filmmakers such as Albert Serra (“Sixteen Moments of My Life”) or Hal Hartley (“Where To Land”).

Berdasarkan laporan, albar, the festival’s main competition, includes 21 features aiming for the top prize. Albar’s selection includes Cannes Directors’ Fortnight winner Clio Barnard’s “I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning,” Grant Lee’s Berlin Silver Bear winner “Everybody Digs Bill Evans” and Visar Morina’s “Shame and Money,” winner of the World Cinema Dramatic Grand Jury prize at Sundance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i think we ended up having many unclassifiable features, which do not fully fit into more structured selections because of their strong auteurist component,” explained díaz castaño. “Here at Gijón, we are really into that mix of genres, those hybrids that tend to live on the margins. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among the albar titles is valeska grisebach’s cannes jury prize winner “the dreamed adventure. ” No stranger to either the city or the festival, Grisebach’s previous work “Longing” took the festival’s best feature prize back in 2006.

Hong Sang-soo, a Gijón favorite who has won FICX best feature prize three times, arrives at this edition’s Albar with “Nowhere to Lay My Eyes,” which scooped the best director prize at Locarno.

Radu Jude, another Gijón’s regular who scored Albar’s top prize in 2023 with “Do Not Expect Too Much From the End of the World,” returns with “The Diary of a Chambermaid,” which premiered at Cannes Directors’ Fortnight.

“We are also lucky to have some regular, highly talented attendees from both the local and international landscape, such as Lisandro Alonso (“Eureka”), Albert Serra, Radu Jude and Hong Sangsoo,” added Díaz Castaño.

Diungkapkan bahwa lászló nemes’ “moulin,” jeanne herry’s “garance” and angela schanelec’s “my wife cries” round out a competition that includes mads mengel’s karlovy vary winner “the guest. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, nicolas pariser’s venice contender “one minute to midnight” will screen out of competition. “The Italian coda is sweet, allowing Pariser to redeem the concept of love from the cynicism of a world wary of romance,” wrote Variety’s Jay Weissberg.

Diungkapkan bahwa retueyos, focusing on directors promoting their second or third feature, opens with pierre le gall’s “flesh and fuel,” winner of cannes’ queer palme révélation prize. It also includes Venice Orizzonti winner Ann Sirot and Raphaël Balboni’s “Un détour par Diane. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the festival’s premiere section brings international features to spain for their premieres. It has expanded to 16 titles. Araki first visited Gijón in 1996, presenting three of his early works, “The Living End,” “Totally F***ed Up” and “The Doom Generation. Among attending filmmakers is Gregg Araki, who returns to the festival with Sundance title “I Want Your Sex,” starring Cooper Hoffman and Olivia Wilde. ” He was also the subject of a 1999 FICX retrospective.

Berdasarkan laporan, other spain premieres take in céline sciamma’s cinematic essay “tutti frutti”; jia zhangke’s cannes title “torino shadow”; cédric kahn’s venice screener “a place to heal”; ulrike ottinger’s vampire fantasy “the blood countess,” starring isabelle huppert; and mohammad rasoulof’s 39-minute “sense of water. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sangsoo will also be on hand for gijón presentation of “the day she returns,” which is set to open in u. S. theaters next month.

Sebagaimana diketahui, thanks to the festival’s relation with its audience, its success on ticket sales and its relentless pursuit of partners and collaborations, five san sebastián festival titles arrive at gijón as part of the festival’s cross roads initiative. The list includes Fred Cavayé’s “Les Mirsérables,” Jesse Steinberg’s “The Debut” and Javier Ruiz Caldera’s “5 More Minutes. ”.

Gijón continues to support talent, collaborating with the Asturias Paraiso Natural Film Commision on FICX Pro, its industry wing and on the Semilleru project development lab, which provide opportunities for local Asturian and Spanish professionals.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “what we aim to do is to bring the city together and push together and rally support behind the festival, working hard with local and regional entities, local government, and private initiatives and citizens. The festival becomes like a hub where everyone tunes in to connect and where everyone can find their place,” added Diaz Castaño.
