Hinnant joined Morgan Freeman, Rita Moreno, Bill Cosby, Judy Graubart, Lee Chamberlin and others in the original cast of PBS’ The Electric Company, the Sesame Street offshoot that went on the air in 1971.

Hinnant struck with the program through its 1977 conclusion, and in addition to Fargo North, a detective who unscrambles word messages and phrases for clients, he played the boy in soap opera-styled “Love of Chair” skits and Frankenstein, among other parts.

Diungkapkan bahwa while on the kids show, hinnant went in another direction by voicing the leftist, perpetually stoned title feline in fritz the cat (1972), based on the comic strip by robert crumb and directed by ralph bakshi. Filled with profanity, violence, sex and nudity, it was the first animated film to be rated X.

Hinnant then returned for the sequel, The Nine Lives of Fritz the Cat (1974); that was the first animated film to get an R rating.

Berdasarkan laporan, the youngest of three kids, joseph howard hinnant was born on sept. His sister, Jean, nicknamed him Skip, and it stuck. 12, 1940, and raised on Chincoteague Island in Virginia. He followed his brother to Yale University, graduating in 1962.

A year later, he performed at the White House Correspondents’ Association Dinner for President Kennedy as part of the Julius Monk satirical musical revue Struts and Frets.

Diungkapkan bahwa in you’re a good man, charlie brown, based on the peanuts characters created by charles m. Marks in Greenwich Village alongside Gary Burghoff as Charlie and Bob Balaban as Linus. Schulz, Hinnant and his brother opened at Theater 80 St. The show proved to be a big hit.

He then appeared in the original 1968-69 Broadway production of Neil Simon’s Plaza Suite, directed by Mike Nichols.

After the Fritz the Cat movies, Hinnant returned to the kids arena by playing the Easter Bunny in The Easter Bunny is Comin’ to Town, a 1977 stop-motion ABC special from Rankin/Bass that also featured the voice of Fred Astaire.

He also did voices for Pogo Possum in the 1980 direct-to-video feature I Go Pogo, for Spidey Super Stories in the ’70s and for My Little Pony in the ’80s; handled lots of radio commercials and narration for kids books; and appeared onscreen on Kate & Allie and As the World Turns.

And he served on the national board of SAG from 1980-2003.

Survivors include his children, Chris, Jamie, Julie and Sara, and their respective spouses, Karen, Jennifer, Charles and Kevin; nine grandchildren; his longtime partner, Ruth Nerken, whom he met in 1985; and his ex-wife, Miriam Hinnant, whom he married in 1962.

His brother drowned in 1978 at age 42 while vacationing in the Dominican Republic.

Berdasarkan laporan, a private celebration of life in chincoteague is being planned. Donations in his memory can be made to the Entertainment Community Fund or the SAG-AFTRA Foundation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “skip was known for his quick wit and never missed an opportunity to make a joke,” his family noted. “He also loved admiring the work of fellow entertainers, reveling in quality performances and the perfect harmony. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the canon of the "lord of the rings" movie and tv franchise has become a little complicated in recent years. We finally have a firm answer, and it's. sort of (if we read between the lines).

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a recent interview with screen rant, "the rings of power" co-showrunner patrick mckay addressed the canon question head-on without giving a simple "yes" or "no" answer. " (He was referring to the already controversial upcoming film "The Hunt for Gollum" with that last bit. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in terms of the "lord of the rings" timeline, "the rings of power" is set thousands of years before the "lord of the rings" movies. R. Tolkien's Middle-earth books over the years and not necessarily as part of any other adaptation (including Jackson's):.

Berdasarkan laporan, "so many talented artists in so many mediums over 75 years have interpreted this material, painted or drawn it, or put it in a song or made it into a film or an animated film. I think to sit on a shelf with all those other works, we are only too delighted for that to be our fate. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa he added that the movies and the show are "in conversation with one another. " Put simply, then, "The Rings of Power" is not strictly canon within the universe of Jackson's films.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the lord of the rings: the rings of power" brings the fabled second age of middle-earth's history to life on-screen for the first time. Therefore, it's centuries removed from both the events of J. R. R. Tolkien's "The Hobbit" and "The Lord of the Rings" books and Peter Jackson's film adaptations alike.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even so, it initially looked like jackson was going to be involved with "the rings of power," only for amazon to ghost him while developing the prime video series. In a statement issued in 2022, Amazon claimed, "In pursuing the rights for our show, we were obligated to keep the series distinct and separate from the films. " So, basically, "The Rings of Power" can't, for legal reasons, be officially canonical to Jackson's movies. Why? In essence, it was apparently a contractual matter. Of course, Patrick McKay couldn't just come out and say that, so he found a more diplomatic way to go about it.

Diungkapkan bahwa jackson, obviously, is the man that turned "the lord of the rings" into the one fantasy franchise to rule them all, as his adaptations of j. R. Tolkien's books became massive, beloved hits that have endured for decades. R. Berdasarkan laporan, nevertheless, jackson is producing (but not directing) "the hunt for gollum," with gollum actor andy serkis helming the movie himself. Warner Bros. is also developing another "LOTR" movie co-written by superfan Stephen Colbert, so this franchise has a future on the big screen as well.

Austin Powers 4 Gets Exciting Writing Update From Mike Myers

Diungkapkan bahwa an avid comic book fan since she first read "stan lee's soapbox," allison hambrick is your friendly neighborhood generalist writer. Journalism, editing, media production, copywriting—she does it all. From her very first blog post about Smallville as a primary schooler, Allison developed a passion for superheroes and the entertainment industry at large.

#732. Mads Mikkelsen Delivered His Best Performance In This Unforgettable 2012 Movie

📅 14 Nov 2026

Mads Mikkelsen Delivered His Best Performance In This Unforgettable 2012 Movie

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2310337/mads-mikkelsen-best-performance-2012-movie-the-hunt/

Sebagaimana diketahui, few european actors have found the blend of native and international success that mads mikkelsen has. " He's since become a favorite of Hollywood productions, too, starting with his role as the Bond villain Le Chiffre in "Casino Royale. Born in Denmark, he became a star in his home country during the 1990s and 2000s, his career kicking off with Nicolas Winding Refn's 1996 crime thriller "Pusher. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, since then, mikkelsen has remained a go-to hollywood bad guy, appearing in blockbusters like marvel studios' "doctor strange. More than a few would argue Mikkelsen's Lecter in the 2013 TV series "Hannibal" is even better than Anthony Hopkins in "The Silence of the Lambs. " He's also one of the privileged few to have played arguably the most famous screen villain ever, Hannibal Lecter. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa mikkelsen's razor-sharp cheekbones, intense stare, and european accent instantly code him as "villain" in hollywood language. When "Rogue One: A Star Wars Story" cast him as Galen Erso, a sympathetic scientist conscripted into building the Death Star, it read as casting against type to American audiences. But look at Mikkelsen's Danish resume and you'll find he's a much more diverse actor than the box that Hollywood has stuck him inside. Amusingly, one of those movies — Thomas Vinterberg's "The Hunt" — stars Mikkelsen as a good man mistakenly persecuted as a villain.

Diungkapkan bahwa lucas (mikkelsen) is a danish kindergarten teacher. Klara then vengefully suggests to the school principal that Lucas exposed himself to or molested her. One of his students, his best friend Theo's (Thomas Bo Larsen) daughter Klara (Annika Wedderkopp), has a puppy love crush on him. (In reality, as the movie shows, her crude older brother shoved an iPad displaying porn in her face. Obviously, he gently turns her down. ) The ugly rumor grows out of control, and Lucas' reputation pays the price.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in "the hunt," the town rushes to the worst possible conclusion about lucas. All but a few loved ones like his son, Marcus (Lasse Fogelstrøm), believe the worst from hearsay. But they don't actually know it for a fact (indeed, what ultimately helps clear Lucas is the facts pointing in his favor). "The Hunt" also avoids reactionary narratives about scorned women peddling false rape allegations because Klara is a young child. The movie is never ambiguous, though; we know from the very beginning that Lucas is innocent and this is all just a terrible tragedy of miscommunication. She simply doesn't grasp the consequences of what she did, as is the case with the other preschoolers who echo her claims.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, compare a similar recent film, "fjord," inspired by a real-life story about a norwegian evangelical couple whose children were taken from them after suspicions of abuse. Like in "The Hunt," the allegations are implied to stem from leading questions and miscommunication from the kids. But "Fjord" counterintuitively stacks the deck in the parents' favor while trying to present objectivity, perhaps because it knows many left-leaning audiences are inclined to side against the conservative couple and takes perverse enjoyment in testing those sympathies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a film like "the hunt" could choose not to reveal lucas' innocence either way or cast doubt, inviting you to sympathize with a possible monster as an endurance test. But the reality of "The Hunt," seeing an innocent man be branded with a scarlet letter, is also agonizing to watch in its own way. It's a modern iteration on the parable of the feathers in the wind, and how once spoken, even untruthful gossip can't be erased.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as lucas, mikkelsen sheds any of the power or menace he projects as a villain in those aforementioned hollywood movies. "The Hunt" is also a Danish-language film, and Mikkelsen's comfort with his native tongue also makes for an even more seamless performance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to this day, i've never forgotten the catharsis of a scene where lucas stands up for himself. After being assaulted in a grocery store, he walks in again, headbutts the hostile clerk, and demands his groceries back. The first time I watched "The Hunt," I rewound the movie to see the scene a second time.

Berdasarkan laporan, that relatively late-in-the-movie scene is a well-earned respite from lucas' victimhood. Even in a story like this, too much passivity from a protagonist turns into a chore. Again, Klara's father Theo is Lucas' best friend; while Theo takes Klara's side, he claims to know Lucas so well he can tell when he's lying or truthful by just looking into his eyes. Lucas similarly takes matters into his own hands at the movie's emotional climax. Lucas goes to Christmas Mass, putting himself dead center in the community that has exiled him, and looks at Theo across the pews.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the power of this lynchpin scene is in mikkelsen's silent, icy stare (lucas pointedly ditches his glasses during this scene). But it's not the aloof stare of Le Chiffre or the predatory one of Hannibal Lecter. In his sad eyes and slight frown, Lucas is begging Theo to read the truth on his face. When that's not enough, he storms over to Theo, sobbing, and refuses to let him look away from his eyes.

Berdasarkan laporan, mads mikkelsen is an extraordinary actor, and yet the greatest proof of that is him playing a normal man in "the hunt. ".

#733. 'The Body' Ending Explained: Is Grace Possessed? Netflix Showrunners Talk Season 2

📅 14 Nov 2026

'The Body' Ending Explained: Is Grace Possessed? Netflix Showrunners Talk Season 2

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/the-body-ending-explained/

Also, how White Chicks influenced a key scene.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the body, netflix’s new campy-horror tv series, came out this week. But based on a quick social media browse, it might as well have come out months ago. The high school thriller inspired passionate fan debates among viewers and dozens of fan cams dedicated to favorite characters long before a single episode aired. Now that The Body has finally arrived, however, fans are having an entirely different debate that hinges on its wild cliffhanger ending.

In search of answers, we turned to co-showrunners Quinn Shephard and Gina Gammell, who admit they don't even know where the series is headed next and that they enjoy the conversation the finale has inspired.

"We are amiable and gullible and don't have an answer either," Gammell tells Polygon.

Below, we break down some of The Body's biggest season 1 mysteries with Shephard and Gammell, and discuss where the story might be headed next.

The following contains spoilers for The Body season 1 ending.

Diungkapkan bahwa broadly, the body follows a high school dance team who may or may not have sacrificed a girl’s soul to qualify for their regionals competition. Through its eight episodes, the show explores the shifting dynamics and allegiances between its three main characters: Anya (Kristina Bogic), Lisbeth (Geena Meszaros), and Elise (Sara Boustany).

Berdasarkan laporan, season 1 ends with anya confessing the sins that had been eating at her all through the season, including both her sexuality and the fact that she feels responsible for the series’ inciting incident, where grace (sofia wylie) fell into a coma after taking some ecstasy at a halloween party. Anya reveals that, when Grace started feeling sick, she decided to drive her to the hospital, only for Grace to seemingly die in the back seat. In a spur-of-the-moment decision, Anya returns Grace’s body to her bedroom and tucks her in, hoping to cover it all up without having to deal with the consequences.

Berdasarkan laporan, following anya’s confession, grace wakes up, stunning everyone, and says, “i’m god. ” It’s the season’s final line of dialogue and one heck of a cliffhanger.

“It was the place we were always aiming towards,” Shephard says.

Shephard and Gammell agree that what they enjoy the most about the season finale is the fact that it can inspire passionate debates.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we want people to feel similarly at the end to the way you feel at all of the biggest turns of the show, which is a continued curiosity about what is really going on, and a certain autonomy to influence that in your own watching," shephard says. ' I think those are our favorite conversations to witness. ' And then someone else is like, 'No, in the last episode, they said that she could hear stuff in the coma. "A certain ability to be like, 'No, I know for sure that she's possessed. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the question of what’s real and what’s imagined lies at the core of the series, which is constantly pitting religion against reality. The many supernatural appearances and occurrences that take place could be part of a mass delusion, or they could be a miracle.

#737. Why Batman: The Animated Series Chose Man-Bat As Its First Villain

📅 14 Nov 2026

Why Batman: The Animated Series Chose Man-Bat As Its First Villain

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2310295/why-man-bat-first-batman-the-animated-series-villain/

We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "batman: the animated series" is darker than most superhero cartoons before and since — literally darker. But it wasn't only gangsters that went bump in the night. Drawn on black paper, "Batman: The Animated Series" presents Gotham City like an art deco painting mixed with an old Hollywood crime movie. The very first episode, "On Leather Wings," uses one of the most out-there Batman villains: Man-Bat, aka zoologist Kirk Langstrom (Marc Singer), transformed by a potion into a half-man/half-bat creature like a winged werewolf.

Berdasarkan laporan, debuting in 1970's "detective comics" #400 by frank robbins and neal adams, man-bat had 20+ years of comics history behind him when "on leather wings" was made. But for non-comic fans, that episode would be the first time they'd seen him. According to "Batman: The Animated Series" co-creator Bruce Timm, that's exactly why he was the pilot's villain. In "Modern Masters Volume 3: Bruce Timm," he recounted:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "man-bat was chosen specifically [for the first episode] because he wasn't familiar to very many people outside of comic book fans. It wasn't like the Joker, where you had to deal with people expecting him to be Jack Nicholson or Cesar Romero. Nobody had any preconceived notions about him. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "on leather wings" was written by mitch brian, who had also developed the "batman" series bible. What became "On Leather Wings" originated as an episode premise in that bible, though with the gruesome detail that Man-Bat was killing tourists, which isn't in the episode as made. Brian has said he pushed for Man-Bat to give the series a dash of the fantastical right off the bat (no pun intended) — "Batman: The Animated Series" could do not just film noir, but also Universal Horror-esque mad science and monsters.

Sebagaimana diketahui, man-bat as batman's first villain also carries narrative symmetry. His moniker is a twist on Batman's own and he takes Batman's mission to "become a bat" one step further. "Man-Bat kind of works because he's literally the reverse of Batman and he's also got the obsessive interest in bats," said Bruce Timm in "Modern Masters. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, technically, catwoman's debut episode "the cat and the claw" premiered first on september 5, 1992, one day earlier than "on leather wings" did. (Currently, "The Cat and the Claw" is also listed as the first episode of "Batman: The Animated Series" on HBO Max. "Batman Returns," starring Michelle Pfeiffer as Catwoman, had hit theaters that past summer. ) But, functionally, "On Leather Wings" is a much better pilot episode — because that's what it was made to be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it also demonstrated that "batman: the animated series" was more than just a movie tie-in, down to the choice of villain. " Remember, this was 1992, a year before "Jurassic Park" unlocked the potential of CGI. In "I Am The Night: The Ultimate Unauthorized History of Batman Series," author Daniel Dockery notes a villain like Man-Bat would've been "nigh impossible to pull off in live-action. A human-sized bat monster? And an action scene where it flies through Gotham with Batman towed behind it on a rope? Yeah, in the 1990s, a live-action "Batman" movie that even attempted any of that would look ridiculous. But in a cartoon, it was thrilling, and proved "Batman: The Animated Series" was a canvas for unique Batman stories.

Starting with "On Leather Wings" also highlights another tenet from the aforementioned "Batman" series bible: no origin story episodes, because the audience already knew Batman's origin from decades of prior "Batman" comics, movies, and cartoons.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during "on leather wings," the police mistake man-bat for batman (kevin conroy) and hunt the dark knight instead. This premise rests on Gotham City already knowing Batman, which is only possible because the series starts in media res with Batman as an experienced crimefighter. The first time we see Batman is deliberately unspectacular; he's sitting in the Batcave, in costume, reading a newspaper article about the Man-Bat attacks.

Diungkapkan bahwa the "batman is framed" subplot also demonstrates that this isn't the adam west show where batman is literally deputized by the police and trusted by all of gotham as a paragon of justice. Many people are already scared of Batman, so it's not a huge leap to blame him for Man-Bat's attacks. (The series' movie spin-off, "Batman: Mask of the Phantasm," even used a nigh-identical story, with Batman being mistaken for the film's eponymous villain. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, turning man-bat's identity into a mystery differs from his first appearance in the comics. There, we meet Man-Bat as Langstrom first and see his gradual and tragic transformation. Mitch Brian compared Man-Bat to "The Strange Case of Dr. It also, crucially, allows Batman to act as a detective. Hyde," and by making "On Leather Wings" a mystery, it brings Man-Bat closer to that book. Jekyll and Mr. The twist of Man-Bat being Langstrom works because, again, he's not a villain most of the audience already knew inside-and-out.

Sebagaimana diketahui, artist kevin nowlan, who had drawn a man-bat story in dc's "secret origins" #39, was initially recruited to design the villain. (See his concept art above. In form and function, Man-Bat was the perfect pilot villain for "Batman: The Animated Series. ) Bruce Timm's finalized design includes his characters' standard broad upper chest, which fits well with Man-Bat's arms growing out into wings. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa throughout history, cops and robbers have been inextricably linked. This comes with the territory, of course, yet the closeness between the two leads to the lines between them inevitably becoming blurred. So, naturally, the crime movie has a long standing tradition of exploring this mercurial, murky relationship, with filmmakers like Michael Mann making it a specialty of theirs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, part of the tension inherent in the relationship between cop and thief is one which stems directly from a tenet of drama, which is that the villains are often more interesting than the square heroes. This issue becomes compounded when the heroes represent a flawed and unjust system of governance, something which the so-called villains only seek to rage against.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "how to rob a bank" is a movie cognizant of this exact flavor of moral tension and looks to exploit it to the fullest at every turn. A story about disgruntled and disenchanted radicals who've each been treated horribly by the American system becoming bank robbing YouTubers could've been a simple riff on the Robin Hood mythos, with the vigilantes taking from the banks and corporations and giving back to the needy (as well as themselves). And while this is an element in the film, director David Leitch and writer Mark Bianculli provide an equally compelling argument for the cause of authority, as represented by FBI Agent John West (John C. Reilly) and hacker Reagan Gardner (Zoë Kravitz).

Sebagaimana diketahui, indeed, the pair directly examine the seductive allure of robbing banks versus its harsher reality, even name-checking the '90s keanu reeves classic "point break. " This is more than just a cheeky reference, too, as both "How to Rob a Bank" and "Point Break" share the major theme of grappling with ethical behavior in a broken world.

Berdasarkan laporan, in "how to rob a bank," agent west and gardner are on the trail of the wolf pack, the group of friends turned bank robbing youtubers who've been pulling off bank jobs across the u. Instead, West reveals that it was "Point Break" that made him want to join the FBI, to which Gardner replies, "That means you really wanted to rob banks. while gaining a viral following online. S. During a lunch break, West explains how his father was the innocent victim of allegations of insurance fraud, leading to Gardner asking if this was what inspired West to become an FBI agent. " West's thoughtful look in response to that comment says volumes.

Berdasarkan laporan, this also speaks to the ways david leitch's movie and kathryn bigelow's "point break" blur the lines of morality for those watching as much as their characters, which is by design. In both films, the forces of the law are initially portrayed as stodgy, closed-minded, and bureaucratic, while the bank robbers are alluring and even sexually attractive in their exploits. presidents while doing a job, then go off to be part of a surfer commune as themselves. The Wolf Pack in "How to Rob a Bank" are humble, blue-collar people who adopt "Fortnite"-flavored alter ego personas during their robberies, while the Ex-Presidents in "Point Break" are punk-tinged political satirists who wear caricatured masks of past U. S. Both groups initially look like idealized outlaws, and it's that quality that makes West, much like FBI Agent Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves) in "Point Break," uncertain if perhaps they've chosen the wrong side.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, it isn't long before the robbers' vigilante fantasy crashes hard into reality. But while this trajectory is fairly standard, neither of these movies lose their social commentary bite because of it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as mentioned, johnny utah and john west aren't immune to the plights or charms of the robbers they're respectively chasing, with utah nearly seduced into joining the ones in "point break. " Yet, his and West's quests to see justice served is more about protecting the innocent. As West points out, people like him aren't seeking to stop the robbers on behalf of a corrupt system so much as they're attempting to protect the millions of other people who don't have the luxury of opting out of the system.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is why the conclusions of both films keep their revolutionary themes intact despite the robbers getting caught. Meanwhile, in "How to Rob a Bank," one member of the Pack is killed, and West only captures the leader, Ryan (Nicholas Hoult). In "Point Break," Utah lets Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) surf a once-in-a-lifetime giant wave rather than taking him in, letting the man go out on his own terms. Nevertheless, Ryan is still successful in his quest, as the Pack's videos continue to exist online and foster a growing movement of discontent, while the rest of the Pack start a new video series: "How to Escape From Prison. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's telling that a 1990 film ends with affection for the robber who still ends up being punished, while a 2026 movie ends with hope for a robber's escape. When it comes to cops and robbers, the ethics are murky as ever, but the revolutionary wave is beginning to grow.

"How to Rob a Bank" is currently playing in theaters.

Berdasarkan laporan, disneyland will always be a magical place, but there is something particularly magical during the holiday season. I have been to Disneyland more times than I can count, but there is one ride I have avoided for over a decade: It's a Small World.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's not that i don't like the ride. It's just that if I hear that earworm-inducing song, even just the first note, I will have it stuck in my head for days, maybe even weeks. Berdasarkan laporan, first of all, the ride has definitely had a glow-up since the last time i stepped onto the boat. From adding inclusive dolls in wheelchairs and new characters like Coco's Miguel and his alebrije dog, Dante, to adding a third and final verse to the song, there was a lot for me to see and hear. Sebagaimana diketahui, if you have never been on this attraction, let me tell you, you are in for a treat. " Disney knew what they were doing, and surprisingly, I am here for it.

Diungkapkan bahwa as i took that first bend into the tunnel, with rain coming down on my head, i was greeted by a bright "happy holidays" sign before entering the magical, doll-filled world, complete with all the twinkling lights of the season. Berdasarkan laporan, i had a chance to chat with one of disneyland's cast members, alexa garcia, about why she loves it's a small world this time of year. She told us:.

Inside, you've got the beautiful music heard in different languages, and it's just such a beautiful message during this time of the year.

Diungkapkan bahwa i found myself connecting with the music in a way i haven't in quite some time, and i even got a little choked up. Honestly, I think having "Jingle Bells" mixed in with the iconic song throughout really helps.

Berdasarkan laporan, and then there is the final room, which is truly a showstopper. As the boat takes its final turn, you enter a white winter wonderland with everyone singing "Deck the Halls. " It is elaborate, decadent, beautiful, and above all, just really, really cute.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this ride really won me over, and i am so glad i gave it another chance. Otherwise, I would have missed out on all the holiday joy this little boat ride gave me. And with the combination of songs, you actually end up leaving without either of them stuck in your head. At least, that is what happened to me.

Diungkapkan bahwa while i may not be in a hurry to ride it's a small world again without its holiday makeover, i encourage everyone visiting disneyland for the holidays to give it a chance. #742. Skip Hinnant Dies: ‘Electric Company’, ‘You’re A Good Man, Charlie Brown’ Actor, Voice Of Fritz The Cat Was 86

📅 14 Nov 2026

Skip Hinnant Dies: ‘Electric Company’, ‘You’re A Good Man, Charlie Brown’ Actor, Voice Of Fritz The Cat Was 86

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://deadline.com/2026/11/skip-hinnant-dead-1237223791/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, skip hinnant, an original cast member of pbs’ the electric company in the 1970s and the prolific voice actor behind fritz the cat, my little pony and 1977’s stop-motion easter bunny, died sunday, november 8, in denver. He was 86.

His death was announced by his family, who noted he passed peacefully surrounded by loved ones.

Born Joseph Howard Hinnant on September 12, 1940, and raised on Chincoteague Island, Virginia, Hinnant got his start in television as a recurring character from 1963 to 1965 on ABC’s identical cousins sitcom The Patty Duke Show; he played the boyfriend of Duke’s Cathy (Eddie Applegate played the boyfriend of Duke’s Patty).

Sebagaimana diketahui, after originating the role of schroeder in the off broadway musical you’re a good man, charlie brown (1967) – other cast members included gary burghoff as charlie brown, bob balaban as linus and hinnant’s late brother bill hinnant as snoopy – hinnant began expanding to voice work, including a 1969 episode of sesame street and, perhaps most famously, as the voice behind fritz the cat, the star character in ralph bakshi’s adult-oriented animation films based on the work of underground artist robert crumb. Hinnant voiced the role in the original X-rated Fritz the Cat (1972) and its 1974 R-rated sequel The Nine Lives of Fritz the Cat. Watch on Deadline.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in 1971, hinnant became an original featured performer in pbs’ kids show the electric company, where over the next six years and 780 episodes he would play the roles of fargo north, frankenstein, jay-jay and supper man, among others. His castmates included Morgan Freeman, Rita Moreno and Bill Cosby.

Hinnant voiced the title character in the 1977 Rankin/Bass stop-motion Easter special The Easter Bunny is Comin’ to Town.

Other voice credits include the 1970s cartoon series Spidey Super Stories, the 1980 stop-motion film I Go Pogo (he was Pogo Possum), various roles on My Little Pony from 1986-1987, the 1990 TV movie Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Day and, that same year, HBO Storybook Musicals.

In the late 1980s he had onscreen roles in single episodes of As the World Turns (1988) and Kate & Allie (1989).

Berdasarkan laporan, hinnant was an active union member of actor’s equity, aftra, and screen actors guild, serving on the national board of sag from 1980 to 2003. His family notes that he “was proud of his work to preserve commercial voice contracts and the everyday actor’s rights. ”.

Hinnant is survived by longtime partner Ruth Nerken; children Chris, Jamie, Julie and Sara, and their spouses; nine grandchildren; and his ex-wife Miriam Hinnant.

#745. 5 Forgotten '80s Sitcoms That Still Hold Up Today

📅 14 Nov 2026

5 Forgotten '80s Sitcoms That Still Hold Up Today

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2310208/forgotten-80s-sitcoms-still-hold-up-today/

Berdasarkan laporan, the 1980s were stacked with classic sitcoms. Of course, there was also formulaic garbage like "Who's the Boss," "Full House" and "Growing Pains. " This is always the state of play in television. "Cheers," "Taxi," "The Golden Girls" and so many more had us pinned to our couches during primetime. But the quality-to-trash ratio was pretty favorable throughout the entire decade.

Diungkapkan bahwa nevertheless, there were many terrific '80s sitcoms that got axed before they had a chance to flourish. In most cases, they were flouting formula, which meant viewers had to adjust to different comedic rhythms. Every minor crisis got resolved with a closing laugh (unless it was "a very special episode"). Audiences proved malleable with variety shows like "The Smothers Brothers Comedy Hour," "Rowan & Martin's Laugh-In," and "Saturday Night Live," but the sitcom structure was sacrosanct: set-up and punchline all the way to a tidy finale in 30 minutes. Deviating too far from the norm was typically fatal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the '80s sitcom graveyard is littered with coulda-been classics, most notably "police squad!," which died a quick death after six episodes, but later spawned the wildly successful "naked gun" franchise. Alas, there are others that were so unsuccessful and/or controversial that they're only streamable on YouTube via old VHS rips (if they're streamable at all). Here are five '80s sitcoms that undeservedly got a quick hook.

Sebagaimana diketahui, martin mull was a brilliant comedic performer whose television career got off to a promising start in the 1970s. " The show was something of a lark, but got a second season as "America 2 Night. He was a scream as the detestable Garth Gimble on Norman Lear's "Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman," which earned him a spinoff as his character's brother Barth Gimble on the influential talk show spoof "Fernwood 2 Night. " After that, it seemed to be only a matter of time before he got another network show.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it took six years after the end of "america 2 night," but that opportunity finally arrived in 1984 with "domestic life. Sebagaimana diketahui, the last few weeks of peanuts' run can best be described as "business as usual. Sebagaimana diketahui, the last full peanuts strip ran on february 6, 2000, which is the final appearance of sally brown and charlie brown's last starring role. It's a Valentine's Day strip, and as usual for Peanuts, it's about Charlie Brown wrestling with his own lack of romantic success.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the last installment of one of peanuts' sadder running gags, charlie brown is once again waiting outside his mailbox to see if he gets any love letters. Naturally, he doesn’t.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this time, he's making sure to scrub it down. "The inside of a mailbox should always be kept clean in case you get a love letter," Charlie Brown tells Sally, right before a sudden storm chases them both inside.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once they're both dry, charlie brown continues to explain how these things work to sally, including why he's not going out in the rain to check the mail again. "When it's raining, the only letters you get are those that say, 'I never want to see you again!'".

"You seem to know a lot about love letters," Sally says.

Berdasarkan laporan, "if i ever got one," charlie brown says, "i don't know what i'd do. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, if this wasn't so late in peanuts' run, it'd just be another self-effacing strip about charlie brown's permanent losing streak. Charlie Brown, Love Expert, is here to tell you how it all works. It's also another strip that runs off of one of Peanuts' core pillars, which is about how little kids will sometimes make up their own "rules" on the fly. He doesn't actually know, but he sounds really certain.

Diungkapkan bahwa there is a certain extra layer of pathos with this one, though. Charlie Brown leaves the world the way he came into it, doing his best to stay positive in a setting built around his misery.

Knowing only scant details of his backstory, he intuitively filled in the emotional journey of the character with a pitch perfect performance. Being free of any conflict between page and screen made the job of writing his youthful trials much easier.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, harrelson’s haymitch has long been an unforgettable part of the hunger games movies, and it’s great to see the book’s author giving the actor his flowers. Haymitch only had about 30 minutes of screen time in the first four films, and yet he made a huge impact with his performance. Even when I’ve gone back to the books, it’s been impossible to think about the character without picturing Harrelson. It sounds like the same can be said for Collins when she decided to write Haymitch's own Hunger Games story with Sunrise on the Reaping.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the sunrise on the reaping movie certainly wouldn’t have been possible without the kind of impression woody harrelson made with haymitch, and i love to see collins recognizing this. Here’s how she continued:.

Diungkapkan bahwa woody’s return to reprise his character, along with our amazing original stars, jennifer lawrence and josh hutcherson, adds such poignancy to the film. It’s such a gift to watch them bridge Haymitch’s Hunger Games to Katniss’s tale.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, if you’ve read the book, you know that haymitch, katniss and peeta from the timeline after the hunger games ends are part of the story. Last year, it was reported that Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson would be back before Lawrence confirmed she’d reunited with both Hutcherson and Harrelson in the new movie. Collins added a big thank you to the actors for returning to Panem to help tell the story of her novel. We can’t wait to see it take place on the big screen.

Berdasarkan laporan, while woody harrelson gets to briefly reprise his role, the movie is carried by a new actor, joseph zada, who stars as a young haymitch. The 21-year-old has spoken about how he got into character, and it sounds like it's paid off given all the early praise Zada has received already.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sunrise on the reaping is joseph zada’s movie, but i appreciate the attention collins gave to woody harrelson and his excellent performance as the original version of the character. Now, to see Haymitch's story, you can catch Sunrise on the Reaping in theaters on November 20.

Magic Is Bringing Back Its Most Controversial Creature Type

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/magic-the-gathering-new-sliver-cards-tease/

Magic: The Gathering's Aaron Forsythe tells Polygon he knows when more Sliver cards will come to the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whether you love or hate sliver decks in magic: the gathering, you should prepare for more sliver cards to make their way to the game soon. Vice President of Design Aaron Forsythe revealed as much during an in-person interview with Polygon at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during an interview at magiccon, polygon mentioned how a couple of sliver-related cards that were part of edge of eternities, and asked if the magic: the gathering team is thinking about bringing the cards back in a big way or if they are too broken to actively support. In response, Forsythe confirmed that "we know when they’re coming back," although he wouldn't share a specific timeline for their return.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "they will be back," forsythe elaborated. They are hard to develop. They are hard to make work unlimited, but we have a plan. But we know people love them. "We know when they're coming back, and I'm not going to tell you. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, slivers have a long history in magic: the gathering as one of the most fun yet controversial creature types that a player can use in their decks. Sliver cards actively boost or benefit from other Sliver cards, enabling decks that can quickly scale up in power in a way that's tough to counter or beat.

Berdasarkan laporan, as forsythe mentions, that makes them particularly tough to develop, since they can be very overpowered. That is likely why we haven't seen as many Sliver cards in recent years. Wizards of the Coast now seems up to the challenge of bringing Sliver cards back in a big way, though, and it'll be fascinating to see what form the comeback that Forsythe teased takes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while we have no idea when more sliver cards will come to magic: the gathering, wizards of the coast did debut the nauctis: the sunken realm set of cards at magiccon: atlanta 2026. That set will be released on Feb. 5, 2027, and will introduce a whole new oceanic realm to the game's multiverse.

Additional reporting by Corey Plante and Jake Kleinman.

#755. Jujutsu Kaisen Ending Explained: What Happens To Yuji In The Series' Finale?

📅 30 Sep 2024

Jujutsu Kaisen Ending Explained: What Happens To Yuji In The Series' Finale?

Tanggal: 30 Sep 2024 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/jujutsu-kaisen-271-ending-explained-what-happens-to-yuji-sukuna/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, merlyn de souza is a freelance writer and anime enthusiast based in goa, india, with a bachelor's in english literature. When she isn't writing, she can be found exploring various realms of entertainment, including, but not limited to, K-dramas, novels, and even the occasional manhwa. She also enjoys all things creative, like sewing and makeup.

Diungkapkan bahwa warning: contains spoilers for jujutsu kaisen's final arc and jujutsu kaisen modulo. It's been well over two years since Jujutsu Kaisen concluded its epic six-year-long saga, with an ending that infamously stirred up quite a bit of controversy and mixed opinions at the time. That said, now that the dust has settled and fans have had the time to properly digest Jujutsu Kaisen's ending, the common consensus is that it was quite satisfactory, albeit a bit rushed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with 50 chapters in all, jujutsu kaisen's final arc, the shinjuku showdown arc, is the third-longest story arc in the series, and naturally a lot takes place within the arc. It all begins with the iconic showdown between Gojo and Sukuna, which eventually gives way to an unforgettable battle royale against the King of Curses until he is eventually worn down by Yuji.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, numerous characters enter the fray and are defeated, and just as many lose their lives trying to take down the heian-era legend, making the entire final arc a whirlwind of action. And at the center of it all is Yuji Itadori, Jujutsu Kaisen's protagonist who finally proves himself as such in this final hour.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as the final battle raged on, yuji was soon the only one still able to fight and damage sukuna, as he had the ability to target the "boundary" between sukuna and fushiguro's soul with his version of cleave, trying to force the king of curses out of his host body. Yuji activated his Domain Expansion and took Sukuna and himself into a facsimile of Yuji’s hometown.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and as yuji showed sukuna everything from his old life and talked about how he’s learned the value of life, yuji told sukuna to release megumi and go back inside him if he didn’t want to die. Sukuna, naturally, balked at the idea, and the final battle between Yuji and Sukuna began inside Yuji’s Domain.

Berdasarkan laporan, yuji once again connected to megumi’s soul, but at that time, yuji told megumi it was okay if he wanted to die. However, Yuji said that he would be lonely without him, and Yuji’s sadness was enough for Megumi to fight back against Sukuna again, with Megumi using Ten Shadows to trip Sukuna up so Yuji could land more hits on him. That wasn’t enough to stop Sukuna from recovering his Cursed Technique, however, but before Sukuna could use Malevolent Shrine again, he was shocked to discover that Yuji’s mysterious gauntlets were covering up him missing a second finger.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sukuna quickly realized that yuta tricked him earlier; yuta gained a copy of shrine not from eating sukuna’s last finger, but from eating one of yuji’s. As for Sukuna’s last finger, that was part of Gojo’s final gambit against Sukuna. Nobara, who had been in a coma since the Shibuya Incident, would use Resonance on Sukuna’s last finger to attack his soul and disrupt his Domain. With Nobara’s help, Yuji got the opening he needed to continue beating on Sukuna and deliver him one final Black Flash so powerful it made the light leave his eyes.

The Shinjuku Showdown Arc is the final climactic portion of Jujutsu Kaisen, with many key casualties after the fight with Sukuna.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with sukuna finally pushed to his limit, he was expelled from megumi’s body and forced into a weak, blob-like form. Sukuna was moments away from death, but Yuji tried one last time to appeal to his humanity and gave him a chance to start over and live inside his body again. Sukuna rejected Yuji’s pleas and died, declaring himself a curse, and with that, the battle against Sukuna was finally over.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with sukuna and kenjaku defeated and uraume killing themself in the aftermath, yuji and his friends retired to jujutsu high to recover from the battle. Yuji gave Nobara and Megumi letters Gojo wrote to them before the final battle; Nobara’s had information on her mother’s whereabouts, something she didn’t care about, and Megumi finally learned that Gojo killed his father, which only made Megumi laugh.

Berdasarkan laporan, from there, yuta was revealed to have successfully returned to his original body, and jujutsu kaisen chapter #269 ended with everyone discussing whether they could have done anything differently in the final battle. Jujutsu Kaisen chapter #270 was then devoted to tying up various loose ends. Since Sukuna ate Tengen before the final battle, his remains were used to maintain Tengen’s barrier.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after that, maki told daido and rokujushi to hide in tokyo, declared a dangerous, off-limits zone where curses ran rampant, as reincarnated sorcerers were hunted down. Amai tried to apologize to the boy he bullied, and Megumi had a small romantic moment with Hana. Charles, Higuruma, and Takaba all went back to their jobs, and in a surprising twist, Kenjaku was implied to be alive and formed a comedy duo with Takaba.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for yuji, megumi, and nobara as a trio, they were assigned a mission to deal with a curse user making a woman see her boyfriend as having a disgusting face. Yuji put that into practice by telling the curse user to reform and join them one day. The curse user was dealt with fairly easily, and after he was apprehended, Yuji remembered one of his last conversations with Gojo, where he said that he wanted people to find new ways of dealing with problems. With that optimistic note, Yuji’s time in Jujutsu Kaisen finally came to a close.

Diungkapkan bahwa in another surprise twist, jujutsu kaisen’s final chapter brought back both sukuna and mahito, the two conversing in some form of afterlife. Mahito revealed that Sukuna became who he was to get revenge for the persecution he once suffered; Sukuna said it didn’t matter, but he did admit that he could have walked a different path. Sukuna decided he would try to change himself if he were ever reincarnated, even as Mahito called him soft, and the last panel of Jujutsu Kaisen was of Sukuna’s final finger inside a shrine, calling back to the first chapter of the series.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as nice as it was to see sukuna commit to his beliefs until his last breath, sukuna having the self-awareness to know that losing to yuji meant his way had merit did a lot to flesh out his character in a way consistent with his personality, especially since sukuna deciding to change in his next life directly parallels gojo deciding to stay the same after death. Jujutsu Kaisen’s ending didn’t have time to give everyone their due, and that makes it so surprising that Sukuna got as good an ending as he did.

Diungkapkan bahwa nearly a year after jujutsu kaisen's grand conclusion, gege akutami teamed up with yuji iwasaki to surprise fans with a sequel series dubbed jujutsu kaisen modulo, which ran for six months between september 2025 and march 2026. Set 68 years after the events of Jujutsu Kaisen's final arc, the sequel came with a plot that was all the more unexpected as it introduced aliens known as the Simurians seeking refuge on Earth.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as many suspected early on, jujutsu kaisen modulo would go on to reveal that yuji was still alive, and the fan-favorite hero would step into the spotlight at last as tensions between the simurians and humans reached a tipping point. That said, Modulo not only revealed that Yuji was alive but also that he was aging more slowly now that his physiology was more similar to that of a cursed object rather than a human. Yuji himself confirms that he has at least around 300 more years to live in Modulo's finale, and thus agrees to serve as a witness to the grand plan to eradicate cursed spirits completely.

Berdasarkan laporan, in jujutsu kaisen modulo's ending, maru, one of the simurians, uses yuta's cursed energy stored in rika's ring, his own cursed technique, chaos and harmony, and mahito's cursed technique, amplified by the mul that makes up the simurians' spaceship, to transform the souls of the japanese and strip them of cursed energy so that the energy leaking from them will no longer birth cursed spirits. This Ritual of Harmony, as it is called, wipes out Cursed Spirits completely and also makes it so future generations of humans and Simurians will henceforth be stripped of as much cursed energy as possible, meaning no more jujutsu sorcerers will be born as well.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, since cursed energy cannot be eradicated completely, a few cursed spirits will still pop up from time to time. Thus, Yuji teams up with Panda and Nobara to hunt down Heavenly Restriction users and arm them with Cursed Weapons to cull these Cursed Spirits. In the end, Yuji also reveals that he will turn into a cursed object upon his death that can be consumed should humanity need cursed energy in the future, turning himself into yet another safety net.

Diungkapkan bahwa jujutsu kaisen’s ending is hardly perfect, even by the typical standards for manga. Jujutsu Kaisen’s already quick pacing resulted in a finale that left a lot of the story feeling underdeveloped, whether that’s with the stories of some characters, a lack of meaningful interactions, or a lot of the world-building and plot threads being left unaddressed in the end. In that regard, Jujutsu Kaisen’s ending is rather disappointing, especially with how big a series it has become over the past few years.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, it’s not as if nothing about it works. The conclusion to Yuji’s arc was great to watch, as clumsy as it might have been, and even with so much left up in the air, Jujutsu Kaisen’s finale does show Yuji finding his own way of breaking the cycle of curses, which serves to bring the overarching narrative full circle in a somewhat satisfying way. It might not have been the best ending Jujutsu Kaisen needed, but it still works very well, and hopefully, the anime and any other additions to the franchise will help make it even better.

Diungkapkan bahwa jujutsu kaisen is a japanese anime and manga series created by gege akutami. The story is set in a world where Cursed Spirits, born from negative human emotions, prey on humanity. It follows high school student Yuji Itadori as he becomes entangled in the world of Jujutsu Sorcery after swallowing a cursed talisman—Ryomen Sukuna's finger—and becomes the host for one of the most powerful curses. Yuji joins the Tokyo Metropolitan Magic Technical College to learn how to combat curses while searching for the remaining fingers of Sukuna to exorcise him permanently.

She passed away in September, but the feminist pathfinder was known for throwing these salon-type events (she called them “circles”) at her Upper East Side townhouse, which she bought for just $30,000 in the late ’60s. ) Yet this is one of the first events at the townhouse that Steinem herself isn’t here to lead.

Jihae, Lux Pascal, Naomi Watts, and Bethann Hardison.

Diungkapkan bahwa amy richards, a feminist activist whom many consider to be the daughter steinem never had—a title richards rejects because her mentor “didn’t want kids”—stood up at one point to tell the crowd that this is what steinem would have wanted. Growing up with a transient father and a mentally volatile mother, the late activist took near-obsessive care in maintaining a welcoming home she could share with others. She was traveling the country for the first 10 years of her life and then lived with her mother, who was not very stable. ’ She wanted it to be filled with people,” Richards says. “She didn’t grow up with a home. “As long as I knew Gloria, she always said, ‘I just want my home to be the way it’s always been. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa at least steinem’s still here on the wall: months before her death, she posed for a series of portraits by paola kudacki for weldun, a platform that offers physically adaptive and functional fashion. “Especially in her later years—not because of wrinkles or aging, but she was just like, ‘Aren’t there enough pictures of me?’” Weldun and the Gloria Steinem Foundation are presenting tonight’s dinner, and mementos of Steinem are everywhere. “I will say, Gloria did not always love to be photographed,” Richards says. It was a bit of a small miracle that Steinem said yes. On the fireplace mantle sits a pair of her signature Ray-Ban aviators. But Gloria’s stuff isn’t the same as Gloria herself.

Former secretary of state Hillary Clinton hugging Melissa McCarthy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, which is probably why, in a crowd of women that include huma abedin, mariska hargitay, padma lakshmi, melissa mccarthy, and bethann hardison—who, at the ripe age of 84, shows up wearing gucci—clinton’s unexpected arrival feels seismic, like gloria sent someone in her place. (Hardison tells me she thinks Steinem used whatever divine power she’s got up there to launch the Blue Wave: “She’s probably saying she helped it happen!”) Whatever your views on Clinton’s politics, she was the first woman to receive a presidential nomination from a major party. Paloma Elsesser and I sit crouched in a corner of the room, glued to the window. “There’s mother,” the supermodel whispers to me as Clinton exits her car into the pouring rain and walks up to the townhouse door.

Guests at dinner honoring the late Gloria Steinem.

Berdasarkan laporan, “hi, everybody,” clinton says as she walks in. Madame Secretary doesn’t seem to like the fuss, probably because 30 or so people intensely staring at you when you arrive at a party is objectively unsettling. Clinton sits down next to Naomi Watts and warmly greets Busy Philips, who stumped for Clinton back in 2016. “Go back to eating!” she says, motioning to the Missy Robbins meal on the table. “Hi,” the room responds in unison. All anyone wants to do is talk to Clinton about the 2026 election, in which Democrats won at least 55 seats in the Senate and 256 in the House to take both majorities in the US Congress. Hargitay blows her a kiss across the table. The entire dinner comes to a silent halt. At the end of the meal—and after a proper catch-up with Shonda Rhimes—Clinton tries to leave, but she can’t. Guests block the door, clamoring to chat her up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, amid the clinton traffic jam, i ask hargitay about the photo. She can’t remember exactly what it is from. “Was it Bravo? Was it with Andy…what’s his name?” But she can guess what she thinks Steinem might say about the blue wave: “There is a God!”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i watch clinton finally make her exit. ) But I spoke too soon: Clinton’s stuck waiting for the coat check, another group of women crowded around her hoping to say something—or, more likely, hoping she says something. (I wait for Elsesser, Watts, Hardinn, and Lux Pascal to finish taking a selfie on the steps. It’s late, so I wait several minutes before I descend the stairs to leave too. With the way this night is going, Clinton might be the last one at the party.

#759. The 6 Most Hopeless Netflix Shows, Ranked

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, feel free to connect with him or check out his work. He's everywhere — Upwork, YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Collider, LinkedIn, Instagram.

Berdasarkan laporan, i know a television show has thoroughly destroyed my optimism when somebody receives good news and my first reaction is suspicion. Which terrible decision will ruin it? I've watched enough fictional people get punished for believing in a better tomorrow that even an innocent smile can make me nervous. Who's going to murder them? The family finally has enough money to escape? Excellent. A witness has come forward? Wonderful. Netflix has done it brilliantly, and more than once at that.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and yet, i keep hoping. These shows understand that stubborn little piece of human nature. I'll spend six episodes watching somebody get crushed by circumstances beyond their control, then convince myself that one brave decision might finally change everything. That's the embarrassing part. They make you care enough to believe the impossible, then force you to confront just how difficult it is to escape the world that created the suffering.

Sebagaimana diketahui, narcos follows the drug lord pablo escobar's rise and downfall before turning its attention to the equally powerful cali cartel. Pablo Escobar (Wagner Moura) builds a cocaine empire in Colombia, becoming unimaginably wealthy while unleashing violence against anybody threatening his business. American DEA agents Steve Murphy (Boyd Holbrook) and Javier Peña (Pedro Pascal) pursue him through a country where political corruption, cartel influence, and ordinary fear make justice extraordinarily complicated.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there's a terrible irony in watching escobar's enemies celebrate his death. His attempts to dismantle the Cali Cartel expose uncomfortable connections between traffickers, political interests, and the institutions supposedly fighting them. Peña understands this increasingly well. Yet even when the major players are brought down, the larger machinery remains. I particularly admire how the third season makes Jorge Salcedo's desperate attempts to protect his family so nerve-racking. The victory is real. He risks everything to help destroy the organization. They've eliminated one extraordinarily dangerous man, but the cocaine business barely hesitates before producing another group of powerful criminals. The problem is nowhere near solved.

Sebagaimana diketahui, holden ford (jonathan groff) believes the fbi can understand serial murderers by interviewing them, studying their behavior, and identifying patterns that might help prevent future crimes. Alongside veteran agent Bill Tench (Holt McCallany) and psychologist Wendy Carr (Anna Torv), he begins developing criminal profiling techniques during the late 1970s. Mindhunter makes those interviews.

fascinating, particularly when the investigators discover how intelligent, manipulative, and disturbingly ordinary some offenders can appear.

Berdasarkan laporan, but i find bill's domestic life even harder to watch than the interviews. Meanwhile, the Atlanta child-murder investigation exposes the painful limitations of profiling and the pressure surrounding an investigation with grieving families demanding answers. Here's a man who spends his days examining the psychology of killers but cannot understand what is happening inside his own household. His young son becomes involved in a horrifying incident, and Bill's professional expertise offers almost no comfort to his terrified wife Nancy. And those recurring glimpses of the BTK killer? They promise another nightmare the canceled series never got to confront. David Fincher's meticulous direction gives this uncertainty an oppressive weight. Two extraordinary seasons, with far too much darkness left unexplored.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, marty byrde (jason bateman) relocates his family from chicago to missouri's lake of the ozarks after a money-laundering arrangement with a mexican drug cartel goes catastrophically wrong. Ozark initially makes the Byrdes' predicament understandable. His wife Wendy (Laura Linney) gradually becomes an increasingly ruthless partner in their criminal enterprise, while local teenager Ruth Langmore (Julia Garner) gets pulled into their dangerous world. They're frightened people trying to survive a mistake. Then you notice how comfortable they're becoming with destroying other lives.

Berdasarkan laporan, ruth deserved so much better. The Byrdes don't escape corruption. I remain furious about it, especially because the ending understands exactly how unfair that outcome is. Ruth, who had so much less to begin with, pays the price. The wealthy family survives, having traded its remaining moral integrity for influence and protection. Watching Garner portray her fury after Wyatt's murder is almost physically painful. And when Ruth finally seems capable of building something independent of the Byrdes, Camila orders her death. She grows up surrounded by poverty and criminality, possesses extraordinary intelligence, and spends years struggling to escape the circumstances that shaped her. They become powerful enough to live with it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, four netflix characters, four completely different ways of showing up for somebody. This is the one who fits how you actually do friendship, and what having them in your life would be like.

Berdasarkan laporan, you do not do friendship at half volume, and neither does he. What you want is somebody who says yes to the plan before you have finished describing the plan.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you are the friend who makes things happen, and so is she. Together you would be mildly exhausting to everyone around you and completely delighted with yourselves.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you have no patience for pleasant lies, and she has no ability to tell them. What looks like coldness from the outside is the most reliable friendship on this list.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you look after whoever is having the worst day. So does he. It is the least strategic way to move through the world and the best possible quality in a friend.

Berdasarkan laporan, korey wise goes to the police station because he wants to accompany his friend. That apparently harmless decision changes his entire life. In 1989, five Black and Latino teenagers are wrongfully accused of assaulting a woman in New York's Central Park, and investigators pressure them into false confessions. When They See Us follows the boys through their convictions, imprisonment, and the devastating consequences for their families.

Diungkapkan bahwa ava duvernay directed this four-part dramatization with an understanding that wrongful imprisonment destroys far more than a person's freedom. The eventual exonerations bring enormous relief, but I cannot stop thinking about the ordinary experiences these men lost. Nobody can hand back an adolescence. Birthdays, friendships, relationships, the simple freedom to grow up without fear. His mother Dolores (Niecy Nash) keeps loving him across a distance neither of them can overcome. Watching him spend years in adult prisons, endure violence, and struggle through solitary confinement is devastating. Jharrel Jerome, who portrays Korey as both a teenager and an adult, is extraordinary. The legal system finally recognizes their innocence, long after their lives have been permanently changed.

Berdasarkan laporan, seong gi-hun (lee jung-jae) is drowning in debt when a mysterious recruiter offers him the opportunity to compete for an enormous cash prize. He enters a competition where childhood games carry fatal consequences, and desperate contestants must decide whether their own survival is worth sacrificing other people. Squid Game initially presents the nightmare as a grotesque contest. Eventually, it becomes clear that the competition merely reproduces the cruelty many participants were already experiencing outside its walls.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i still haven't recovered from ali's (anupam tripathi) betrayal during the marble game. And Gi-hun's eventual victory is practically unbearable because everyone he cared about inside the competition is gone. Creator Hwang Dong-hyuk pushes that cruelty further when Gi-hun returns, determined to destroy the games themselves. If I reveal anything more, it will ruin the show. His rebellion fails, his closest friend Jung-bae (Lee Seo-hwan) is killed, and his attempt to dismantle the organization ends with another devastating sacrifice. Instead, that trust becomes the very thing used against him. He trusts Sang-woo (Park Hae-soo), believing his friend has discovered a way for them both to survive. So just go and watch this masterpiece.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a child disappears from the german town of winden, and the investigation begins exposing a network of family secrets stretching across generations. Young Jonas Kahnwald (Louis Hofmann) discovers that the caves beneath the town connect different periods of history, allowing people to travel through time. Dark transforms this mystery into an extraordinary tragedy about families whose attempts to protect one another repeatedly become the causes of their own suffering.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's a conversation between jonas and his father michael (sebastian rudolph) that i genuinely find unbearable. Jonas has traveled into the past hoping to prevent Michael's suicide. But Michael doesn't yet know he's supposed to kill himself. Imagine going back in time to save somebody you love and discovering that your attempt to protect them may help create the tragedy you're desperate to prevent. Dark leaves you feeling devastated. People sacrifice relationships, betray their families, and commit terrible acts because they believe they can change what happens next. That cruel contradiction runs through the entire series. Even its salvation feels like a farewell to people I desperately wanted to see happy.

#764. 35 Years Later, Tim Burton’s Greatest Love Story Is Officially on Streaming

📅 14 Nov 2026

35 Years Later, Tim Burton’s Greatest Love Story Is Officially on Streaming

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/tim-burton-edward-scissorhands-love-story/

35 years ago, Burton delivered one of his quintessential films.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what makes a love story work? for it to transcend, a love story needs more than good-looking actors, chemistry, and romantic dialogue. There’s no set formula, but it must sweep you off your feet. A touch of sadness and wistfulness never hurts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 35 years ago, tim burton delivered one of his quintessential films. Edward Scissorhands came out in 1990 and has since become one of Burton’s staple movies. He made one of his most personal stories, one that he’d been dreaming of for years: a Gothic fairy tale and one of the strangest films to enter the mainstream. After directing Batman and finding box-office success, he had a blank check for his next project. It’s also a timeless love story.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite how much i love it, this movie has a pretty weird concept: caroline thompson, the film’s screenwriter and one of burton’s key collaborators, described burton’s pitch as “the stupidest idea i’d ever heard of. ” It marked their first collaboration, with Burton sharing that the idea of an artificial man with scissors for hands came from one of his high school drawings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, thompson had written a book about a monster fetus, which burton was a fan of, feeling like it had similar themes to his own work. “I knew it was brilliant,” she said. “It was just so clean and so stark in its meaning. And despite the silly premise, Thompson understood Burton’s idea and why it was so effective. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, edward scissorhands begins with a framing device. We enter the fairy tale itself, set in a Gothic castle atop a hill, where we meet the Inventor (Vincent Price), an aging man who lives alone amidst his creations. His most impressive invention is an artificial young man he names Edward (Johnny Depp). An elderly lady tells her granddaughter the story of why it snows on Christmas. Before he can finish Edward, though, the Inventor dies, leaving Edward with scissors as placeholders for his hands.

Sebagaimana diketahui, years later, peg (dianne wiest), a kind avon lady, visits the castle, intent on finding a new customer. She meets Edward, and when she sees his loneliness, she offers him a place to stay. Despite his terrifying appearance, he uses his hands for good: keeping their neighbors’ yards perfectly cut and making stunning topiary creations. Edward makes a positive impression on his neighbors. He moves on to hair, applying this same care to the suburban moms of the area. He also falls in love with Kim (Winona Ryder), Peg’s daughter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, burton and thompson have a perfect grasp of tone in edward scissorhands, one they’ve returned to in films like the nightmare before christmas and corpse bride. It’s a film full of whimsy, with a pastel color palette that allows for its darker, Gothic elements to stand out, whether it’s Edward himself or the revulsion he inspires in the town because he’s not normal.

Berdasarkan laporan, edward scissorhands feels like a film that was fully formed in burton’s head years before production began. It makes sense for this version of Kim to be attracted to the sweet Gothic outcast rather than her loud all-American boyfriend Jim (Anthony Michael Hall). Kim is a blonde cheerleader, a stark contrast to Ryder’s status as the ‘80s goth queen. The role of the Inventor was written for Price, a horror icon, known for his work in films like House of Wax and The Fly. The casting of Winona Ryder also works because of her off-screen persona. That duality is what makes the character work. Kim ends up being a Winona Ryder character; we just meet her right before she gets there.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, edward and kim’s relationship is the heart of the film, though they start on opposite ends. Edward is in love with her from the beginning, longingly looking at a photo of her before she’s even introduced. In the film’s most famous scene, Edward carves an ice statue of her for Christmas, with Kim dancing amid the snow shavings. Kim hates that there’s a weird stranger in her house and takes advantage of his innocence and the fact that he seems to like her so much. After Edward takes the blame for a break-in she talked him into, Kim finally sees him. It’s the high point of their relationship but also its end. The town pursues Edward shortly after until they run him back to the castle where he came from.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the film ends with the reveal that the grandmother from the start is kim. Despite all the years that have passed, it snows every Christmas, making it clear that Edward is still up on the hill, carving the ice. Like the best love stories, the fact that it's incomplete is what makes it memorable. The fairy tale stays perfectly preserved.

Edward Scissorhands is streaming on Disney.

#766. 3 Years After Aquaman Infamous Sequel Flop, DC Confirms The Return Of A Major Lost Kingdom Villain

3 Years After Aquaman Infamous Sequel Flop, DC Confirms The Return Of A Major Lost Kingdom Villain

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/aquaman-ocean-master-return-after-lost-kingdom-flop/

Sebagaimana diketahui, an aquaman villain becomes the biggest threat to the dc universe, and it's up to batman and superman to stop him. James Wan’s Aquaman rightfully surged to over $1. 15 billion worldwide to become the highest-grossing movie in DC cinematic history. Its unapologetically colorful underwater spectacle arrived at the perfect moment, complementing gritty movies like Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice and the Dark Knight trilogy itself. It also provided a very different experience to the Marvel Cinematic Universe's movies, with bioluminescent underwater kingdoms and exhilarating swashbuckling adventure that turned a once-mocked hero into a global box-office phenomenon.

Berdasarkan laporan, patrick wilson’s ocean master pulled off an overlooked feat in the dceu's aquaman movies. Orm Marius is the twisted main antagonist of DC's highest-grossing movie, and four years later, he becomes the charismatic co-protagonist of its sequel. Very few characters in superhero or wider sci-fi cinema have successfully evolved from a clear-cut, world-threatening supervillain to a secondary hero without it feeling forced. Ocean Master's evolution across only two movies places him in exclusive company, alongside beloved movie characters like Tom Hiddleston’s Loki, Karen Gillan’s Nebula, and Arnold Schwarzenegger’s T-800.

While not as popular as the Joker or as recurrent a villain as Lex Luthor and General Zod, Ocean Master is an incredibly well-designed antagonist, an unexpectedly successful movie character, and a genuine threat to the Earth in DC Comics continuity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ra’s al ghul has launched an apocalyptic plot centered around four harbingers of the apocalypse: poison ivy, tokamak, ocean master, and queen bee, each of which threatens to destroy human civilization using their unique source of power. the Bringer of War is the most powerful, as he represents annihilation across the world's oceans controlling the very waters that cover seventy percent of the Earth. k. a. Among them, Black Manta a. While heroes like Batman and Superman scramble to contain famine, war, and pestilence on land, Black Manta prepares to drown the entire surface world before Earth's defenders can start a counteroffensive.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in batman / superman: world's finest #57, the flash's rogues tease black manta by attacking the oceans, to which orm marius responds with a tidal wave. Although shooting the seas with temperature and sonic attacks seems like an ill-advised strategy, the Rogues were sent directly by Batman himself, meaning that their failure is probably nothing but the first step in a carefully devised plan to lead Ocean Master to sabotage himself. After all, Batman and Superman aren't receiving help from the Justice League in the pages of World's Finest, and pitting Ocean Master against his brother Aquaman may not be an option.

Diungkapkan bahwa ocean master’s assault on the surface world comes years after his defeat in throne of atlantis. Now empowered as one of Ra’s al Ghul’s Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, Ocean Master returns with catastrophic weather magic. Previously, Orm Marius unleashed massive tidal waves and Atlantean legions against coastal cities across the world, only to lose his crown when the Justice League united beside Aquaman to push his armies back into the sea. Worse yet, with the rest of the Justice League out of commission and Arthur Curry out of reach, Ocean Master gets his long-awaited chance to settle the score without a pantheon of heroes blocking his path.

The Manhunters are using Earth as a feeding ground, but a savior is coming from an unlikely source connected to Task Force X.

Sebagaimana diketahui, without the justice league at their backs, batman and superman are still capable of toppling ocean master once more. Although Superman matches Orm’s trident lightning and colossal tidal forces head-on in the open water, Batman can dissect the mystical links tether-bound to Ra’s al Ghul’s apocalyptic ritual. The World's Finest have already defeated Queen Bee and Tokamak, and Orm’s royal pride and tunnel vision toward surface destruction can easily allow Batman and Superman to turn Ocean Master's elemental fury against himself.

Batman / Superman: World's Finest #57 is available November 18 from DC Comics.
