#803. 7 Near-Perfect Prime Video Miniseries You Can Binge in One Sitting

📅 15 Nov 2026

7 Near-Perfect Prime Video Miniseries You Can Binge in One Sitting

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/prime-video-near-perfect-miniseries-binge/

Diungkapkan bahwa prime video has earned a reputation as the home of massive, multi-season flagship hits like the boys and the lord of the rings: the rings of power, but the platform has also produced several high-profile, critically acclaimed miniseries and limited series. In the last few years, the streaming giant has released several shows in the category, the likes of which are hard to find elsewhere. Though limited in number, these shows have come to be known for their focused narrative, impactful themes, and, for some, stellar visuals.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ranging from internationally acclaimed, award-winning comedies to niche, cult shows, prime video’s library of miniseries and limited shows spans genres, styles, and formats, so there is something for everyone. While not all of these shows have been widely celebrated or lauded by critics, each of them is noted for its resonant storytelling and unique experience, making every minute of their limited runtime worthwhile. So here’s our selection of near-perfect Prime Video miniseries that you can binge in (roughly) one sitting.

Berdasarkan laporan, a psychological thriller created by naomi sheldon and gabbie asher, the girlfriend follows laura sanderson, an elite art gallery owner whose picture-perfect life is disrupted when her son introduces his new girlfriend, cherry, to the family. Robin Wright stars as Laura and also serves as the show’s director (with Andrea Harkin), with Olivia Cooke as Cherry. Laura’s high-society lifestyle and ideologies instantly clash with Cherry’s working-class background, and she begins to suspect the young woman’s motivations. The show also features Laurie Davidson, Waleed Zuaiter, Tanya Moodie, and Leo Suter as other key characters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a series adaptation of michelle frances’ novel, the girlfriend is a dark and twisted exploration of love, obsession, greed, power, and a mother’s reactions to and perceptions of her son’s love interest. Even if it is not unique in its themes, it is the depiction of those themes that sets this show apart from its counterparts. The unhinged power struggle between Laura and Cherry is brilliantly depicted through the stellar performances by Robin Wright and Olivia Cooke, with their chilling chemistry driving the show’s narrative.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of prime video’s most unique, poetic, and critically praised sci-fi shows, tales from the loop is a stunning series inspired by swedish artist simon stålenhag’s neo-futuristic art book of the same name. Set in a fictional Ohio town, the story revolves around various people living around an underground facility called The Loop, which impacts their perceptions of time, space, memory, and reality. The show stars Jonathan Pryce, Rebecca Hall, Paul Schneider, Duncan Joiner, and Daniel Zolghadri as main characters.

Sebagaimana diketahui, truly out of the ordinary, tales from the loop sets a fantastic example of how a series can be adapted from art. Surreal, sublime, and dreamy, the series brings life to the original artwork and elevates it with a resonant existential narrative about the future of humanity that you would want to watch in one sitting. At the time of its premiere, Tales from the Loop was a critics’ favorite and has remained a sci-fi television gem of the 2020s, even if it has since been overshadowed by bigger, brighter sci-fi contemporaries. The series deserves far more recognition than it has received.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, boots riley’s first television series, i’m a virgo is a surrealist comedy about a 19-year-old, 13-foot-tall boy named cootie, raised by his uncle and aunt, who sheltered him from the harsh realities of the world all his life. But when a group of teenage political activists learns about his existence, Cootie is forced to come out of his protected world, learning about himself and what life truly means. Jharrel Jerome delivers a great performance as Cootie, as does Walton Goggins as the self-proclaimed billionaire vigilante, The Hero.

Berdasarkan laporan, i’m a virgo is a surrealist superhero satire that puts an absurdist spin on the superhero genre, trading power fantasy for social critique. At its heart, the show is essentially a quirky and often darkly funny coming-of-age story that mocks corporate capitalism and systemic racism. I’m a Virgo became a favorite of critics at the time of its release, earning praise for its heart, humor, and satire, as well as Riley’s unique vision, but the series has continued to be one of Prime Video’s most underrated shows.

Sebagaimana diketahui, developed by alice birch, dead ringers is a series remake of david cronenberg’s psychological thriller film, which in turn is an adaptation of the 1977 novel twins by bari wood and jack geasland. Starring Rachel Weisz in the central role that was played by Jeremy Irons in the 1988 film, the series follows obsessively co-dependent twins and fellow gynecologists, Beverly and Elliot Mantle, whose personal relationship, obsession, and ambition push the boundaries of law, ethics, and science. The other key characters are played by Britne Oldford, Poppy Liu, Jennifer Ehle, and Michael Chernus.

Diungkapkan bahwa dead ringers stands out among other gender-swapped reboots with its intelligent writing and dark humor, and is often considered a true homage to cronenberg’s chilling, incisive thriller. Rachel Weisz thrills with her performance, anchoring the show with her contrasting character types, which earned her a Golden Globe nomination and the show a Peabody Award. Widely praised for seamlessly blending high-concept body horror with sharp social satire, Dead Ringers is a psychological thriller that will make genre fans want to watch without breaks.

Diungkapkan bahwa donald glover and janine naber’s dark comedy satire stars dominique fishback as a young woman named andrea "dre" greene, who is obsessed with a world-famous pop star named ni'jah, who remains elusive after a traumatic incident. Swarm focuses on Dre’s extreme, compulsive fandom and how her desperate attempts to follow her desires lead her down a murderous path across the country. Rory Culkin, Paris Jackson, X Mayo, Billie Eilish, Stephen Glover, and more appear as guest stars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a heavily underrated and often misunderstood psychological thriller, swarm works both as a depiction of toxic obsession and a cautionary tale, anchored by fishback’s menacing antagonist. The show is a disorienting blend of dark satire, gory slasher, and psychological horror. The series refuses to fit into any genre, shifting from graphic violence to true-crime mockumentary and surreal satire. Critics widely praise the show for being as disturbing as it is nuanced, and Fishback’s outstanding performance earned her multiple accolades, making Swarm one of the best shows about obsessive fandom.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in his first television show as a creator, director, and showrunner, barry jenkins adapts colson whitehead’s pulitzer prize-winning novel of the same name into a thrilling historical fiction story. The Underground Railroad tells the story of Cora and Caesar, two enslaved people on a Georgia plantation who escape their ruthless owners and attempt to take a magical subterranean train to freedom, while being chased by a slave catcher. Thuso Mbedu stars as Cora, Aaron Pierre as Caesar, and Joel Edgerton as the slave catcher.

Sebagaimana diketahui, alternative history and magic realism come together in this haunting and thrilling story of survival and freedom, underscored by a great cast and an incredible visual style that demands uninterrupted attention. Barry Jenkins transports his theatrical storytelling style to the small screen, bringing life to Whitehead’s critically lauded bestseller that reimagines the titular network of abolitionists and their real-life efforts to help enslaved African-Americans escape to freedom. Even though it was well-acclaimed at its release and won several prestigious awards, The Underground Railroad is an underrated miniseries that deserves a lot more attention.

Sebagaimana diketahui, phoebe waller-bridge’s critically acclaimed, multi-award-winning tragicomedy series that catapulted her to global recognition, fleabag is a first-person narrative of the titular narrator’s personal tragedies, identity crisis, and difficult family dynamics. The 30-something single woman in London juggles her struggling café business and the deaths of her loved ones, giving the audience a darkly funny peek into her intimate emotions and challenges as she navigates romance, heartbreak, family drama, and loss. Besides Waller-Bridge, Andrew Scott also gained popularity as The Priest, while Sian Clifford, Brett Gelman, and Olivia Colman are also memorable for their roles.

Berdasarkan laporan, widely considered a television masterpiece of the past decade, fleabag is pure comedic genius. Anchored by Waller-Bridge's pitch-perfect delivery, with a close second by Scott and Clifford, it is a wholesome, honest show that handles delicate themes like suppressed grief and identity crisis with more humor and heart in its limited runtime than multi-season television phenomena. Even though the show is split into two seasons, it is essentially one limited series divided into two chapters, which collectively tells a complete, single-arc story about the protagonist’s healing process that you will want to binge in one sitting.

#806. Richard Sterban, Oak Ridge Boys Bass Singer Who Helped Make ‘Elvira’ a Hit, Dies at 83

📅 15 Nov 2026

Richard Sterban, Oak Ridge Boys Bass Singer Who Helped Make ‘Elvira’ a Hit, Dies at 83

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.billboard.com/music/country/richard-sterban-death-oak-ridge-boys-1236382272/

Diungkapkan bahwa known for his signature "oom poppa, mow mow" bass line on "elvira," sterban had 17 no. 1s on the Hot Country Songs chart with The Oak Ridge Boys, plus two top 40 hits on the all-genre Hot 100.

Sebagaimana diketahui, richard sterban, the bass vocalist behind the “oom poppa, mow mow” hook on one of the oak ridge boys‘ biggest hits, “elvira,” and whose career launched as a backing singer for elvis presley, died on saturday (nov. 14). He was 83.

Berdasarkan laporan, sterban passed away due to complications from bronchitis and pneumonia in hendersonville, tenn. , his family shared. He died after a long battle with cancer, and after retiring from touring last year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we appreciate all of your love, support, and prayers,” the sterban family said in a statement released on saturday. “Please continue to lift us up in this difficult time. We find comfort knowing that he is currently face to face with Jesus. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, sterban, a member of the oak ridge boys for more than 50 years with duane allen, william lee golden and the late joe bonsall, revealed a pancreatic cancer diagnosis in september 2025, saying at the time that he was “under the care of the best cancer doctors in the country and, with the help of the good lord above, i believe i will be able to get through this. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “elvira” — the oak ridge boys’ highest-charting single on the all-genre billboard hot 100, a song that became one of the quartet’s numerous no. 1s on the Hot Country Songs chart, and the winner of a trio of major awards (a Grammy Award, a CMA Award and an ACM Award) put Sterban’s deep vocal front and center in the hit’s chorus.

Diungkapkan bahwa the oak ridge boys had 47 entries on the hot country songs chart, including 17 no. On the all-genre Billboard Hot 100, the group notched four entries, including two top 40-charted hits: “Elvira” (No. 1s that spanned 1978-90. 1s (Fancy Free in 1981, Bobbie Sue in 1982 and Deliver in 1984). They also had 39 entries on the Top Country Albums chart, including three No. 5 in 1981) and “Bobbie Sue” (No. 12 in 1982).

Sebagaimana diketahui, sterban was born in camden, n. , in 1934, and grew up in nearby Collingswood, where he sang at Sunday school and in his seventh grade glee club. J. He went to Trenton State College, now The College of New Jersey, to study music.

Before his professional journey in music led him to The Oak Ridge Boys, Sterban helped found the gospel quartet The Keystones in the Philadelphia area; Bonsall, who would go on to join The Oak Ridge Boys with him, also sang in the group.

In the early 1970s, Sterban found himself singing as a backing vocalist for superstar Elvis Presley.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for more than a year, he performed with elvis onstage with j. D. Sumner and the Stamps Quartet, who appeared in the concert film Elvis on Tour (1972).

Berdasarkan laporan, by 1972 the opportunity to join the oak ridge boys — then a gospel four-piece who hadn’t yet shifted to the sound that would make them a household name in country music — came. The group’s previous bass singer Noel Fox had departed. Sterban decided to take the gig.

Johnny Cash featured The Oak Ridge Boys on tour, and the quartet would go on to sign with Cash’s manager, Jim Halsey, who’s credited with encouraging them to get into country.

Throughout his decades-long career with The Oak Ridge Boys, Sterban won five Grammys, including the award for best country performance by a duo or group with vocal in 1982 for “Elvira,” which had already been named single of the year by both the Country Music Association and the Academy of Country Music.

Sterban died in Hendersonville, Tennessee, to complications from bronchitis and pneumonia after fighting a battle with cancer, his family and the music group announced.

Berdasarkan laporan, richard sterban, the oak ridge boys’ bass singer who memorably lent his vocals to their beloved “elvira” cover, died saturday. He was 83.

Sterban died in Hendersonville, Tennessee, due to complications from bronchitis and pneumonia after fighting a battle with cancer, his family and the Oak Ridge Boys announced.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we appreciate all of your love, support, and prayers. Please continue to lift us up in this difficult time, we find comfort knowing that he is currently face to face with Jesus,” Sterban’s family said in a statement. Related Stories Music Meet Plave, the Very Real Virtual K-pop Boy Group TV Skip Hinnant, Actor on 'The Electric Company' and Voice of Fritz the Cat, Dies at 86.

Sebagaimana diketahui, born on april 24, 1943, in camden, new jersey, sterban began singing at 6 in sunday school as a soprano. He sang tenor in his seventh-grade glee club, and upon his eighth grade, his voice dropped to bass.

He studied music at Trenton State College (modernly known as the College of New Jersey), and began singing in a gospel quartet where he met Joe Bonsall, his future Oak Ridge Boys bandmate.

Diungkapkan bahwa while singing part-time, sterban joined j. D. Sumner and the Stamps, whom Elvis Presley hired to sing behind him. He then sang and recorded with the King of Rock and Roll, and also appeared in the 1972 concert film Elvis on Tour.

Berdasarkan laporan, sterban was then offered the opportunity to join the oak ridge boys after the departure of noel fox, which he accepted in 1972. Bonsall joined the group one year later, with Duane Allen, William Lee Golden and Sterban already in the group, which carried on as the faces of the band for five decades.

They performed with Johnny Cash, who helped them sign with Columbia Records in 1973, though it was after opening for Roy Clark in 1975 when they met his manger, Jim Halsey, who would later sign with the group.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, they reached success with “y’all come back saloon,” which reached no. 3 on the country chart in 1977, and led to a string of hits. “I’ll Be True to You” became their first No. 1 song, though 1981’s “Elvira” would become one of their largest successes.

Berdasarkan laporan, originally recorded by dallas frazier, the oak ridge boys’ version of the track went to no. 1 on the country chart and No. 5 on the pop chart, sold more than two million copies and won a Grammy. Sterban’s bass refrain was a major touchpoint on the song.

The Oak Ridge Boys went on to also become members of the Grand Ole Opry, the Gospel Music Hall of Fame and the Country Music Hall of Fame.

Sterban released his memoir From Elvis to Elvira: My Life on Stage, written with Steven Robinson, in 2012.

Berdasarkan laporan, sterban is survived by his wife, donna; his daughters, lauren (tyler) and tori (michael); his sons, rich (chele), doug and chris; his grandchildren, mali (zachary), nikolas, tyler (ryann), madelyn, alexandra, rex, owen and charli grace; and his great-grandchildren, salem, asher and theo. He was preceded in death by his mother, Victoria, brother, Joseph and grandson, Zachary.

Sebagaimana diketahui, gail simone has been one of comic books' most iconic writers for the last couple of decades. Among them are Deadpool, Batgirl, and Wonder Woman. That adds up to around two issues a month, which is production that many writers can’t do.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are plenty of reasons to read uncanny x-men, but one of them is the ongoing relationship with gambit and rogue. It’s been everything that a romantic love story should be. They have their disagreements, but it never gets too heavy or angry. On top of that, they’re always showing each other a ton of love. Sometimes the public display of affection is front and center, but never in front of the kids (only that one time in front of Logan in issue #1).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, because of their amazingly written relationship, it's no wonder that gail simone said there’s no way she’s breaking them up. In fact, she said in a very Gail Simone way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anyone who follows gail simone on social media knows that she loves to have fun. Whether she believes it or not is far from the point. For example, one of her consistent jokes is how certain characters can win fights seven times out of ten. It’s why, when she approached the topic of Remy and Rogue breaking up, she said, “I fairly regularly get story suggestions from readers of Anna Marie and Remy separating temporarily or even splitting up entirely. I’d rather throw barbecue sauce on the Mona Lisa. She understands that the internet is a place to have fun. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa relationships in comic books will always have their ups and downs. There are exceptions to the rule, like Superman and Lois Lane, but that’s rare. Sometimes the story ends tragically, like Peter Parker and Mary Jane in Spider-Man: One More Day. So knowing that Gail Simone has no plans to break them up is a refreshing change.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rogue and gambit’s relationship has grown throughout uncanny x-men. In the very first issue, it was clear that it would be a focal point of the series. However, what truly made them one of the best couples in comics is their approach to the former Outliers, who are now the New Mutants.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, they went from being in their honeymoon phase to becoming loving parents. Each of the New Mutants looks at Anna Marie and Remy as their parents, even without the paperwork or being biologically linked. The best part is that they’re amazing at it. Plus, if readers go by context clues, Rogue may be pregnant.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the storylines in uncanny x-men: wild ride was rogue attempting to purge the demon inside gambit’s soul. They don’t know what you carry inside you. During an exorcism, a demon said to Anna Marie, “They don’t know, do they? Even your worthless husband. ” Of course, demons are known to lie and say all sorts of outlandish things to keep their victim uneasy. In this case, the truth could be what throws a person off more than a lie.

Berdasarkan laporan, rogue will always be overprotective of the people she loves. It felt like Anna Marie was fighting for more than her husband’s soul. She was battling for the future of her family and the father of her unborn child. Nevertheless, Uncanny X-Men: Wild Ride seemed different. If that’s the case, then Gail Simone may have furthered the point that Remy and Rogue should never break up.

#812. This '60s Sketch Show Became One Of The Biggest Flops In TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

This '60s Sketch Show Became One Of The Biggest Flops In TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2308325/turn-on-60s-sketch-show-biggest-flops-tv-history/

Berdasarkan laporan, networks tried all sorts of wild and outlandish ideas in the 1960s as they attempted to wrestle audiences' attention away from their rivals. This was the decade that gave us "My Mother the Car," the show for which Jerry Van Dyke turned down "Gilligan's Island" and which had him talking to his deceased mother via a car radio. The '60s also gave us Sally Field as a flying nun and sitcoms such as "The Hathaways" which featured a trio of trained chimpanzees who were treated like human children by their suburban "parents. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, it was during this era that abc decided to debut its surreal sketch comedy series "turn-on," and when i say "series," i mean single episode. The show was so poorly received that it was yanked off the air after its debut installment in 1969, and rumors have since emerged that it became the only series in TV history to be canceled while it was airing. That might be a slight exaggeration, but not by much.

Berdasarkan laporan, 1969 was the year the world watched neil armstrong and buzz aldrin land on the moon, "star trek" aired its final episode, and a man who actually did say yes to "gilligan's island," alan hale jr. paid a visit to Sally Field's aforementioned airborne nun. But the year got off to a rocky start for ABC when it debuted one of the most notorious flops in TV history.

Berdasarkan laporan, "turn-on" was created by digby wolfe and george schlatter, with the latter having created the hugely popular nbc series "rowan & martin's laugh-in," aka "laugh in," and the former having written for that same series. Their attempt to recreate the magic at ABC was a more lewd, surreal affair that aired once on Wednesday, February 5, 1969, and was never seen again.

Berdasarkan laporan, forgotten sketch comedy show "weird tv" might be the weirdest series of all time, but "turn-on" isn't far off. For one thing, its concept seemingly had little to do with comedy. Essentially, the whole thing takes place within the Construct from "The Matrix. " What does that mean? Well, in a practical sense, it means every sketch unfolds in a vast all-white vacuum, where the supercomputer supposedly responsible for the show manifests sets and characters. As one of two computer engineers explains during its opening moments, "Turn-On" is "the first computerized TV show. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the opening sequence is a bewildering and surreal experience, featuring an array of diverse performers who appear within the construct in quick succession, including puppets and a woman who plays a sousaphone before bursting into laughter — all scored by an electronic rhythm and synth hits that apparently have little to do with what's happening on-screen. It's the kind of thing that wouldn't be out of place on Adult Swim in the 2000s. In the late-1960s? Let's just say network affiliates were concerned about their ratings.

Berdasarkan laporan, things get a bit more blue as the debut episode of "turn-on" continues. While "Laugh In" pushed boundaries, its ABC counterpart contained more sexual humor. This mixed media approach sort of calls to mind "Monty Python's Flying Circus," which also debuted in 1969. Meanwhile the show's credits continue to appear throughout the episode as suggestive cartoons pop up from time to time. And by "humor," I mean the word "Sex" flashing on-screen above guest host Tim Conway and Bonnie Boland and a "sketch" in which a woman tries desperately to get a box marked "The Pill" out of a vending machine. Unlike that now legendary series, however, "Turn-On" was cancelled almost immediately.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a stub in the february 7, 1969 edition of the oregonian (via newspapers. com) noted how local ABC affiliate KATU-TV did not air the "Turn-On" premiere at the behest of its management, who were evidently put off by a preview screening. "The station's management decided certain portions of the program 'are not in good taste and that these portions would be objectionable to a substantial and responsible part of the community,'" reads the report, which also noted that the Associated Press critic Cynthia Lowry had highlighted the "frankly blue jokes" that offended the Oregon affiliate management.

Diungkapkan bahwa abc seemed to agree, and it pulled the plug after the first episode went out. ] He convinced them to cancel the show, so by the time it got to California, the show was off the air, and some of it has never been seen. According to co-creator George Schlatter, though, the show's swift cancellation came down to a station manager in Cleveland who wanted to keep "Peyton Place," the show that would have run in the "Turn-On" time-slot, on the air. "[. "He started calling the stations as it came across the country telling them they had to cancel this show," Schlatter stated. " It's this recollection of events that seems to have birthed the "canceled while it was on the air" urban legend.

Berdasarkan laporan, the attempts at transgressive humor and surrealism in "turn-on" feel too try-hard, and the overall experience of sitting through the premiere episode is actually quite unpleasant. That said, it's not impossible to admire Schlatter and Digby Wolfe's attempt to do something different. What's more, we've gotten plenty of awful TV shows with 0% Rotten Tomatoes scores, and I'd much rather watch "Turn-On" than an episode of "Real Rob. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "paper girls" adapts a 2015-2019 image comic series by writer brian k. Vaughan and artist Cliff Chiang. The comic follows them across different time periods. At first, they're just sent to their immediate future in 2016, where they meet a grown up Erin (Ali Wong in the show). The morning after Halloween 1988 in fictional Cleveland, Ohio, suburb Sony Stream, four preteen paper girls — "new girl" Erin Tieng (Riley Lai Nelet), Tiff Quilkin (Camryn Jones) Mackenzie "Mac" Doyle (Sofia Rosinsky), and KJ Brandman (Fina Strazza) — discover a time machine in an abandoned basement. Sebagaimana diketahui, "paper girls" features four kids in 1980s midwest suburbia, riding on bicycles and communicating with walkie-talkies, who stumble onto a science fiction story. There are undeniable similarities to "Stranger Things," and while they're coincidental (the "Paper Girls" comic was already running when the former premiered in 2016), the story's parallels to the Duffer Brothers' Netflix phenomenon probably helped the TV show adaptation get greenlit.

Diungkapkan bahwa but compared to the 1980s nostalgia in "stranger things," "paper girls" takes a harder look at the decade. ) Compare that to "Stranger Things" Season 3, in which one character (Maya Hawke's Robin) admits she's a lesbian to another (Joe Keery's Steve), and he's totally accepting of it. (That bumpy ride is another thing the "Paper Girls" TV series didn't get a chance to realize. The very first time we meet Mac in the comic, she insults some local bullies with homophobic slurs — and she's one of the heroes! But that hatred turns out to be internalized. Across the story, Mac and KJ realize their feelings for each other. It's a nice sentiment about what things should have been like, but it's also completely ahistorical.

Berdasarkan laporan, another story that hits the same mood as "paper girls" is the 2026 time travel amblin throwback "the end of oak street" — for one, both have time-displaced dinosaurs. "Paper Girls" doesn't have as wide a mean streak as "Oak Street," though, making it a happy medium between that and how saccharine "Stranger Things" can get. If you love the "Paper Girls" TV series and crave more, I'd highly recommend the comic as the next best thing. It's a quick read at only 30 issues, and it's got the ending the TV show deserved to adapt.

#828. Forget Ganon, Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Most Overlooked Boss Finally Gets Its Due

📅 15 Nov 2026

Forget Ganon, Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Most Overlooked Boss Finally Gets Its Due

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-twinrova/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the age of ganon is over. It's Twinrova's turn to rule.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the legend of zelda: ocarina of time is iconic for plenty of reasons, but a big part of that is thanks to its villain. Ganondorf is one of gaming’s great bad guys, a reputation that has only been enhanced by appearances in later games like Wind Waker and Tears of the Kingdom. While Ocarina of Time’s Switch 2 remake does the Demon King justice, it’s also a reminder that the Zelda series has another excellent, and far more underappreciated, foe: Twinrova.

Berdasarkan laporan, first introduced in ocarina of time, twinrova makes for one of the best bosses in zelda history. The character concept is fun enough on its own, but the fight itself is memorable, too. In the Spirit Temple, Link encounters two evil sorceresses who serve Ganondorf, Kotake and Koume. Link has to use his Mirror Shield to absorb their elemental attacks (fire and ice) and reflect them back at the witches. They’re classic witches: a pair of bickering old ladies flying around on brooms. It all culminates with the duo coming together Transformers-style to become Twinrova, an even more powerful witch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the sisters’ real star-turn moment happens after link vanquishes their twinrova form and they separate once more. Halos appear above both witches’ heads as they begin floating up towards a light. That sets them off into a panic as they realize they are dying, prompting an unexpectedly great sketch comedy routine.

Koume: We’re twins! Don’t try and lie about your age!.

Koume: Who are you calling senile?! Is that how you treat your older sister?.

Kotake: We are twins! How can you be older?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the remake not only preserves that screwball dynamic, but plays it up tenfold. New animation lets Nintendo go all in on their final argument, as the two taunt and shove each other as they rise into the light. The witches are fully voice acted, and they sound exactly as you probably always imagined, speaking in cartoon squawks. It’s a delightful moment of levity right before Link’s adventure gets serious en route to Ganondorf’s castle.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all of that has left me begging for nintendo to lean on some zelda villains other than ganon in future games. Twinrova got a moment to shine as the big bad of the Oracle games, but they’ve rarely been seen in the 25 years since. There are a lot of villains like that who haven’t been revisited in decades while Nintendo keeps returning to Ganon: Agahnim, Vaati, Demise, Majora, and more. All of them are underexplored in Zelda’s mythos compared to Ganon.

Berdasarkan laporan, there’s a case to be made, of course, that villains like twinrova are so special because they’re not dragged out over and over again. They appear in games where they feel relevant to the story and design, so why force them into games just for the sake of fan service? Maybe Nintendo is better off creating new villains, like Echoes of Wisdom’s Null or A Link Between Worlds’ Yuga.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i can get behind that, though there is a good opportunity to revisit twinrova if nintendo decides to do so. After all, the witches are 400 years old (give or take) by the time we meet them in Ocarina of Time. You can spot the younger version of Koume and Kotake in Tears of the Kingdom, and they play a role in Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment. A new game set in that era, with some incarnation of Link facing off against them, could expand the Zelda mythos in a way that feels natural. I’m down to see what hijinks the siblings were getting up to at the young age of 104.

Nintendo’s excellent Switch 2 remake recaptures the soul of a masterpiece.

#830. Naruto’s New Series Is The Perfect Chance To Finally Solve A Decade-Old Mystery

📅 15 Nov 2026

Naruto’s New Series Is The Perfect Chance To Finally Solve A Decade-Old Mystery

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/naruto-sequel-shadow-rising-rock-lee-mystery/

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the most gratifying moments to cap off the original naruto story was seeing its protagonist's generation finally able to move forward, build new lives, and even families with one another. For some this was an exercise in celebrating fan-shipping that wound up being canon, and for others, it meant wonderfully unique stories like how Sai and Ino ultimately fell in love. But one particular mystery befuddling fans for over a decade has been that of who Rock Lee gets together with, even momentarily, to have his son, Metal Lee. Rock Lee and his son have hardly been critical in newer Naruto and Boruto stories, but it's still been a burning question.

Berdasarkan laporan, first introduced as one of the most eclectic, and certainly hardest-working young shinobi participating in the chunin exams arc, rock lee gradually began to fade into the background ever since the sasuke retrieval arc. There were certainly still moments in which he could still shine as late as the Fourth Great Ninja War, but it was clear Masashi Kishimoto hadn't seen much more purpose beyond completing his rehabilitation arc, instead giving focus to his mentor, Might Guy, who embodied many of the same principles.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but with naruto: shadow rising evidently visiting naruto's generation as they become parents, it's perhaps the biggest chance to find out who metal lee's mother is. With even the latest Boruto databook utterly snubbing the poor lad, there don't seem to be better opportunities around to explore this, especially as Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has utterly abandoned him.

Berdasarkan laporan, rock lee began his journey in naruto, becoming instantly infatuated with sakura haruno. But with Sakura staying forever loyal to Sasuke, it was clear Rock Lee's feelings would remain unrequited. Even though she never reciprocated his feelings for him, Sakura recognized his bravery and selflessness even as early as in the Forest of Death, and grew to respect him as a reliable ally to Team 7 and an asset to Konoha. At this point, there's been no conclusive proof that any known character wound up marrying him or bearing his child. Naruto: Shadow Rising is the clearest opportunity to at least provide some clarity on the enigma that is Metal Lee's mother, especially since Boruto's dodging it entirely.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the boruto manga series as well as naruto's final chapter, at most, metal lee is only ever seen training with his father or in vanishingly few panels depicting his bouts of nervousness ahead of the chunin exams, or small snippets of him in battle. The anime does as much, too, with episode #94, "A Heaping Helping! The Eating Contest!" showing him mostly with his father prepping for an eating competition. But one scene from episode #18, "A Day in the Life of the Uzumaki Family", shows young Metal and Rock Lee alongside Might Guy and Tenten, attending Naruto's Hokage inauguration day in a flashback.

The mythology of the Tailed Beasts and their Jinchuriki is central to the Naruto story, but you don't need a catchy song to remember them all.

Diungkapkan bahwa metal lee has thus been more of a filler character, appearing less frequently in the manga by comparison, but it doesn't have to be this way for the new naruto sequel. Given Shadow Rising's timeline appears to be leading to this inauguration, it's a solid opportunity to revisit more squarely on Kishimoto's terms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with shadow rising likely being about the story leading up to this point, kishimoto could recreate that moment, while definitively ruling out whether tenten is the mother, which at the moment seems unlikely or inconclusive. Much like the trailer showed glimpses of baby Sarada in Sakura's arms, there's also the opportunity for Rock Lee to welcome his baby son into the world. Given his passing resemblance to his father, it's unlikely Metal Lee is adopted or taken under Rock Lee's wing in a surrogate father-son bond like Guy did for him before. Whether Kishimoto reveals who the mother truly is, is up to him at this point, but for what it's worth, it's a question worth answering, even if it begets more questions about Rock Lee in the process.

Diungkapkan bahwa part of the mystique of rock lee is that he's a child utterly born without any remarkable talent or, seemingly, any living parents on record, having to pull himself up by his bootstraps and train harder than everyone around him to reach similar heights. Evidently, Kishimoto never intended to dive into the boy's lineage as it would either be a perfunctory gesture at this point, or actively undermine the core message of his character.

Berdasarkan laporan, just like how fans don't know who rock lee's parents are, naruto readers aren't so much concerned with his son's special lineage. They are simply more interested in seeing Rock Lee happily married, especially after he had to move on from Sakura. For what it's worth, the best possible answer to explain Metal's wildly different temperament, without resorting to fan-shipping his father with Sand ninja Maki or Fourth Tsuchikage Kurotsuchi, is to expect, if anything, for his mother to be a humble Konoha civilian.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, metal lee simply looks just enough like his similarly cartoonish father, with just enough of a layered, anxiety-prone personality and shape to his eyes to suggest a very different mother than the usual company rock lee keeps. Having a more grounded, down-to-earth mother to balance out a father who brings out his intensity would balance out Metal Lee rather nicely. Finally, with more civilians as opposed to ninja emerging after the end of Naruto, it'd feel understated, yet would entirely fit the core of Rock Lee's appeal, to build out a perfectly peaceful, happy ending for a Naruto character.

Berdasarkan laporan, naruto is a franchise spawned from the manga series penned by masashi kishimoto that began in 1999. Generating several tv series, games, movies, and more, Naruto follows the exploits of a young outcast ninja harboring the spirit of a demon fox who seeks to become the Hokage, the leader of his ninja village, to break the stigma against him. Upon the conclusion of the initial series, Naruto expanded into Boruto, following many series protagonists' children and returning faces.

A new Naruto manga by Masashi Kishimoto announced at the 2026 New York Comic-Con, with more details expected to arrive at Jump Festa in 2027.

#832. 8 Survival Thrillers That Are 10/10 Masterpieces, Ranked

📅 15 Nov 2026

8 Survival Thrillers That Are 10/10 Masterpieces, Ranked

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/survival-thrillers-perfect-masterpieces/

Diungkapkan bahwa we often turn to movies to experience situations we can’t imagine in our own lives. It’s part of the thrill of a thriller. Our adrenaline races from the comfort of our seats because we don’t have to experience what the protagonists are going through. Survival thrillers depict worst-case scenarios: trying to stay alive when the odds are stacked against you.

Sebagaimana diketahui, plenty of daring survival thrillers exist throughout cinema history, but these eight titles are true masterpieces. Whether on a beach or in space, the fight to survive is central to these stories. From narratives that both inspired and took inspiration from Survivor to harrowing sci-fi thrillers about a fight to get home, these movies are enthralling from beginning to end.

Berdasarkan laporan, arriving mere months after the debut season of survivor, robert zemeckis’ survival drama cast away received an extra boost from those who pondered what would actually happen if one were stranded on a deserted island. Cast Away tells the story of Chuck Noland (Tom Hanks), a work-obsessed FedEx executive who survives a devastating plane crash and washes ashore on a completely uninhabited Pacific island. Forced to adapt to extreme isolation for four years with only a volleyball named Wilson for company, he must master basic survival skills while holding onto the hope of returning home to his fiancée, Kelly Frears (Helen Hunt). Cast Away strips the genre down to a raw, methodical examination of human endurance, time, and isolation rather than relying on over-the-top action or artificial threats.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cast away thrives for its incredible realism. Stranded alone for four years, Chuck's greatest threat isn't just nature—it's the complete absence of human voice. Chuck doesn’t master the wild at first. A genuine survival masterpiece, Cast Away has a documentary-style feel that makes the narrative quite tangible. The film gains immense satisfaction from ingenuity, showing Chuck creatively using FedEx package contents—such as ice skates for tools and videotapes for rope. Proving the necessity of connection, Wilson externalizes Chuck’s internal monologue and serves as a psychological lifeline, keeping him from descending entirely into madness. He struggles through the agonizingly slow realities of securing clean water, fashioning a stone-edge knife from rocks, opening coconuts, and spending days trying to spark a fire. Zemeckis makes the bold choice to drop the musical score almost entirely during the long middle stretch on the island, replacing it with relentless crash of waves, howling wind, and silence, which forces the audience into Chuck's claustrophobic isolation. Becoming an instant icon, Wilson, the blood-stained volleyball, becomes a crucial companion. Hanks underwent a physical transformation over a year-long production break, losing over 50 pounds and growing a beard to authentically depict the toll of malnutrition and exposure. ​​​​​​​.

Diungkapkan bahwa the evolution of leonardo dicaprio’s career has proven that risky roles are very much in his wheelhouse. Iñárritu, the Western epic follows frontiersman Hugh Glass (DiCaprio) after he survives a brutal grizzly bear attack, only for a treacherous teammate named John Fitzgerald (Tom Hardy) to murder Glass's son, Hawk (Forrest Goodluck), and leave him for dead. Directed by Alejandro G. Such is the case for The Revenant. Fueled by grief and sheer willpower, Glass endures the freezing, unforgiving terrain to track down Fitzgerald and avenge his son's death. The Revenant strips survival down to a raw, punishing, and sensory-driven battle against nature and human betrayal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shot on location in extreme conditions using only natural light, cinematographer emmanuel lubezki creates a visual world that feels harsh, cold, and immediate. The film thrives on its technical elements. Glass’s physical endurance fuses with an emotional core, making the fight for survival a brutal driver of vengeance. This authenticity pulls audiences into the action as simple acts like finding water, hunting for food, crossing freezing rapids, or staying warm become high-stakes, life-or-death events. The grizzly attack scene remains one of the decade's best. The Revenant is a grueling film that keeps your heart pounding. The sound design intentionally isolates and magnifies heavy breathing, cracking ice, and wind, making the audience feel physically trapped and exhausted inside the freezing environment. ​​​​​​​.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the most harrowing true-life films of the survival thriller genre is 127 hours. Written and directed by Danny Boyle, the biographical film tells the true story of mountaineer Aron Ralston (James Franco), who becomes trapped alone in a remote Utah slot canyon when a dislodged boulder pins his arm. 127 Hours turns a static, claustrophobic nightmare into a high-energy, deeply human psychological study led by a powerhouse performance from Franco. Over the course of nearly a week, he endures severe dehydration, hallucinations, and dwindling supplies before making the agonizing choice to amputate his own arm to escape and survive. 127 Hours turns a brutal story of self-mutilation into an inspiring celebration of the human will to live.

Berdasarkan laporan, boyle turns what could have been a static chamber piece into a dynamic, adrenaline-fueled action film. By utilizing split-screens, rapid editing, dizzying camera angles, and intimate point-of-view shots, he keeps a man pinned under a rock in Bluejohn Canyon visually and viscerally gripping from minute to minute. Franco charts Ralston’s arc from a reckless, arrogant adrenaline junkie into a man stripped down to his core, confronting his past regrets, loneliness, and mortality. From how he rations his meager water and tries to chip away at the boulder to the grim mechanics of rigging a pulley system and facing the reality of self-amputation, the film is masterfully plausible. The film balances physical agony with an expansive, life-affirming triumph. By sticking closely to Ralston’s experience, the meticulous authenticity makes the danger feel painfully immediate. ​​​​​​​.

Diungkapkan bahwa jumpstarting a new horror-thriller franchise, a quiet place is a masterpiece of sci-fi post-apocalyptic storytelling. In a world overrun by blind extraterrestrial creatures that hunt by sound, the Abbott family, led by Lee and Evelyn (John Krasinski and Emily Blunt), struggle to survive in near-total silence. To protect their children and an impending newborn, they communicate via American Sign Language and navigate carefully planned paths while avoiding any accidental noise. Directed by Krasinski, A Quiet Place weaponizes silence, anchors its terror in high-stakes family dynamics, and minimizes storytelling down to pure mechanical tension.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what a quiet place does extraordinarily well is invert the horror formula. By brutally establishing the lethal cost of a single toy-rocket noise within the first ten minutes, the film ensures that every subsequent action carries immediate, life-or-death weight. The film is a raw story about two parents desperately trying to protect and raise children in an increasingly dangerous world. As far as sci-fi thrills are concerned, the “Death Angels” are kept largely mysterious and underexposed for most of the runtime, shifting the terror from what the creatures look like to the agonizing vulnerability of the human characters trying to survive. Though the sequel doesn’t match the original’s thrill, Krasinski proved his skill behind the camera. Instead of relying on jump-scare loud noises to shock the audience, the film uses near-total silence—featuring fewer than 100 spoken lines of dialogue—to make every ambient rustle, footstep, or breath feel deafeningly loud. ​​​​​​​.

Berdasarkan laporan, there have been a few dramatizations about the 1972 andes flight disaster, but society of the snow is peak perfection. Bayona and based on Pablo Vierci's 2008 book of the same name, the Spanish-language thriller tells the true story of Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571, which crashed in the remote Andes mountains in October 1972. Trapped in freezing conditions with little food, the surviving members of a rugby team must rely on teamwork, faith, and extreme measures, including consuming the deceased, to endure 72 days until a daring rescue. Directed by J. A. Society of the Snow replaces Hollywood action clichés with a grounded, visceral, and deeply empathetic account of a truly tragic real-life disaster.

Berdasarkan laporan, if there’s one thing this film brings, it's visceral realism. Survival comes through uncompromised brotherhood, shared sacrifice, and organic leadership. The narrative deliberately shifts perspective to honor every member of the rugby team, reframing survival not as a clean "happy ending," but as a complex weight carried by those who made it out. The film treats the impact with a blunt, sobering physical reality that highlights human fragility. Using tight lenses, practical shaker rigs, and raw audio-visual design, the film forces the audience inside the fuselage as metal shears and seats collapse. Rather than a tale about petty leadership rivalries or villainous infighting among survivors, Bayona makes it clear that the sole antagonist is the indifferent, monumental Andes mountain range. The opening plane crash sequence is widely regarded as one of the most terrifying and technically accurate scenes in cinema history. ​​​​​​​.

Berdasarkan laporan, in space, no one can hear you scream, but you can watch people sweat as they did in alfonso cuarón's masterpiece gravity. Ryan Stone (Sandra Bullock) and veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski (George Clooney) as they fight to survive after a destructive cloud of satellite debris wrecks their space shuttle in low Earth orbit. Left completely stranded in the silent void of space with rapidly depleting resources, they must navigate a harrowing journey from station to station to find a way back home. The film tells the story of medical engineer Dr. One of the best space-set survival thrillers of all time, Gravity is a masterclass in the genre because it merges relentless physical peril with a deeply resonant emotional journey of human resilience.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, instead of a space thriller centered around extraterrestrial creatures, the story is rooted in a scientifically grounded, terrifyingly plausible nightmare. Gravity establishes a clock with rapidly depleting oxygen, failing power, and severed communications, making every single second feel dangerous and earned. From its famous opening unbroken take that floats and spins around the astronauts, the camera work places the audience directly inside the microgravity environment. The story operates as a metaphor for rebirth and grief. Her physical struggle to breathe, stand, and re-enter Earth's atmosphere mirrors an internal rebirth. Stone is fighting her way back from the emotional vacuum of grief after the death of her child. You feel the vertigo, the silence of space, and the sheer helplessness of drifting into the void. A minimalist, high-stakes drama, Gravity is a pure exercise in problem-solving under extreme duress.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the newest entry into the survival thriller, send help is an absolute blast of a movie. As their toxic workplace power dynamic dramatically inverts, the struggle for survival turns into a ruthless, darkly humorous battle of wits where morality quickly shatters. Directed by Sam Raimi, the black comedy follows Linda Liddle (Rachel McAdams), an overworked analyst, and Bradley Preston (Dylan O’Brien), her arrogant, newly appointed CEO boss, who become the sole survivors of a plane crash on a remote jungle island. Subverting expectations, this genre-bending survival thriller replaces standard wilderness mechanics with a sharp, psychologically dark examination of workplace power dynamics.

Sebagaimana diketahui, capturing raimi’s signature style, get help blends gritty tension, gross-out horror, and pitch-black dark comedy, keeping the narrative unpredictable and unhinged from moment to moment as the story evolves into a terrifying conceit: linda’s personal game of survivor. Rather than treating the island as a trial to escape, Linda actively curates dependency, controls Bradley, and suppresses her urge to flag down passing rescue boats to stay in power. McAdams plays Linda with a chilling lack of easy likability, framing her motivation not as simple revenge, but as a compulsive psychological need to push back against a lifetime of systemic erasure. Beyond the survival moments is a pitch-perfect exploration into psychological power plays. With a sensationally twisted conclusion, Send Help asks a deeply uncomfortable question: does society applaud survival only when it is convenient? ​​​​​​​.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a classic across multiple genres, the martian is a brilliant story of resiliency in the face of survival. Directed by Ridley Scott and based on Andy Weir’s novel, during a mission to Mars, astronaut Mark Watney (Matt Damon) is accidentally left behind and presumed dead by his crew after a violent dust storm forces an emergency evacuation. Stranded alone on the harsh planet, he uses his scientific knowledge and ingenuity to grow food and signal to Earth that he survived. Meanwhile, NASA teams and his former crewmates race against time to pull off a dangerous rescue mission to bring him home. The Martian works as a survival thriller by celebrating human ingenuity, real-world science, and relentless optimism.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the film treats actual science and engineering as the central protagonist. Stranded botanist and astronaut Watney has to calculate calorie counts, synthesize water from hydrazine, manage atmospheric pressure, and engineer potato crops using Martian soil and biological waste. It not only raises the stakes but also maintains relentless momentum, ensuring every narrative ripple matters. The dual-track narrative seamlessly intercuts between Watney’s lonely, day-to-day struggle on the surface of Mars and the frantic, globe-spanning rescue operations at NASA and aboard the Hermes spacecraft. Everyone—from Watney fighting to stay alive to the NASA scientists, international space agencies, and his former crewmates risking their careers—shares a singular, united goal: bring him home. At the end of the day, the thrills are fulfilling, but sharing a moment of optimism and hope is The Martian’s greatest gift.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as a native southern californian, i’ve never seen a white christmas. The closest I can get without getting on a plane is during Disneyland’s holiday season. A. S. I didn’t know before exactly why rain would stop the snow from falling upon Disneyland, but someone just made the reason quite evident.

Berdasarkan laporan, “disneyland’s wintertime enchantment” makes snowfall in southern california possible every night at 7:30 p. m. and 8:30 p. And FYI, there’s a lot of it coming this week after some notable flooding at Disneyland last month. However, don’t count on it if it’s raining. m. Here’s why:.

A post shared by Molly Evans (@happilyevansafterall).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, i hate to ruin the magic, but disneyland snow isn’t actually snow. It’s something that’s been named "snoap" by fans, because it’s practically soap disguised as snow. It's dispersed by hidden rooftop machines.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to the los angeles times, disneyland’s snow is made up of 98% water mixed with a non-hazardous, proprietary surfactant (soap) blend. On any other day, the “snow” evaporates shortly after landing somewhere and leaves no trace on guests or around the park. However, when too much water mixes with it, you get a very soapy (and gross) ground!.

Berdasarkan laporan, as you can see in the instagram post, when the “snoap” and rain happen at the same time, it creates a major slip hazard for the guests. Therefore, it is usually canceled on rainy days. m. In this recent instance, the guest reports that snow was accidentally turned on at 10:30 p. , causing an issue everywhere in the park where snow fell.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even if the snowfall is stalled by rain, most of the other holiday festivities can still happen during such weather conditions. The firework show will have to be canceled during active rain, heavy cloud cover or high winds, but the projections at “It’s A Small World” will typically still run.

Berdasarkan laporan, the “it’s a small world” ride also has a special holiday version if you’re not into that song. The World of Color - Season of Light over at California Adventure can also usually hold up unless rain is paired with severe wind or lightning. And you can meet Santa Claus at Mickey’s Toontown Trolley Barn, which is located indoors.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of my personal favorite holiday traditions is the a christmas fantasy parade. Disneyland’s holiday-themed entertainment runs until January 6 this year, so there’s plenty of time to enjoy this special time of year.

#836. 9 Giant-Sized Changes Marvel Made to Ant-Man After Edgar Wright Left

9 Giant-Sized Changes Marvel Made to Ant-Man After Edgar Wright Left

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/edgar-wright-ant-man-script-differences/

Unsurprisingly, that Falcon cameo would not have been in there.

Diungkapkan bahwa in may 2014, it was announced that edgar wright, best known for movies like shaun of the dead and scott pilgrim vs. The news was shocking because Wright was not just a director-for-hire like some Marvel filmmakers have been. the World, would no longer be directing Marvel’s Ant-Man movie. Wright first began crafting his Ant-Man film with co-writer Joe Cornish in the early 2000s, before the Marvel Cinematic Universe was even a thing. When the MCU began to develop, Wright’s Ant-Man was one of the earliest confirmed projects. Wright was even a part of the MCU’s first panel back in 2006.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as wright has explained in interviews, he was excited to be on the ground floor of something, setting the tone for what the mcu would become. He wanted to do a superhero movie where it was still emblematic of the director, in keeping with their body of work. After leaving Ant-Man, Wright even told Variety, “I wanted to make a Marvel movie but I don’t think they really wanted to make an Edgar Wright movie. The comparison he’d made was Tim Burton’s Batman, which is still very much a Tim Burton movie. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa part of the problem was timing. But Wright asked that Ant-Man be pushed back so that he could direct The World’s End first. Ant-Man was originally a Phase One MCU movie, with only loose connective tissue to the other films. This was because his producing partner, Eric Fellner, had been diagnosed with cancer and he wanted to finish their “Cornetto Trilogy” while Fellner still could.

Berdasarkan laporan, marvel agreed and ant-man moved to phase two, after the blockbuster success of avengers and when marvel’s “house style” had already been established. As Wright and Cornish were updating their drafts of the film and casting the major parts, Marvel kept pushing for more connections with the MCU. Eventually, Marvel had one of its in-house screenwriters do a draft without Wright’s involvement. This eventually resulted in Wright's departure, and director Peyton Reed took his place. Paul Rudd, who was already cast as Scott Lang, then did a rewrite with Adam McKay, which became the film we now know.

Berdasarkan laporan, to be clear, a good amount of wright and cornish’s script survived and served as the film’s overall backbone. According to Reed, “The idea to make Ant-Man a heist movie structure was all Edgar and Joe. The idea of Hank Pym and Scott Lang as mentor and pupil, again, that was all theirs, and also, the idea of a movie that that all drives toward a third act where the big battle between the good guy and the bad guy takes place in a little girl's bedroom, that was always there from the beginning, and I stand by the fact that I think that's genius. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa still, there were a lot of changes, and while we’ve never seen the original script (and wright has said he has to be careful about revealing too much because of the nda he signed) there’s enough out there to give us a pretty good idea of the differences. Here are the nine biggest changes from Edgar Wright's Ant-Man to the one we got.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the version of ant-man that we got, scott lang’s crew for pulling off heists was just three guys, but according to the film’s editor colby parker jr. , “I think there were, like, 15 people within the gang. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, michael peña’s character luis did exist in wright’s version, but in a much smaller capacity, most likely because scott lang’s crew would have been so much bigger. But as the movie took a new direction under Reed, his part grew and once they got into reshoots, his character grew even more. Even that famous summary montage Luis did was a late addition.

Berdasarkan laporan, this one probably isn't a big surprise, as falcon's fight with ant-man definitely feels shoehorned into the movie. Wright’s version had far less crossover with the existing MCU. I think he was going to be a standalone. As Parker Jr. He didn't want any other Marvel characters in the film. told The Direct, "I don't think there would have been any other Marvel characters set up. ” Parker Jr. even specifically pointed to the scene, saying, “I don't think the Falcon would have been in Ant-Man.

According to the book MCU: The Reign of Marvel Studios, Edgar Wright’s Ant-Man would have begun with a flashback to Hank Pym (Michael Douglas) as the original Ant-Man, then it would have jumped to the present day with Scott Lang stealing the suit.

With Wright opening on Pym as Ant-Man, the movie would not have featured the scene with Hank Pym fighting with Peggy Carter and Howard Stark about trying to replicate his Pym Particles.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as peyton reed told vulture, “in the original drafts i think there was one reference in dialogue to janet. ” While Janet Van Dyne — who would eventually come to be played by Michelle Pfeiffer in Ant-Man and the Wasp — only appears briefly in Ant-Man, her absence informs much of Hank Pym’s arc with his daughter Hope (Evangeline Lilly) and builds into the Quantum Realm story for the sequel. She didn’t appear in the movie. Speaking of which….

Diungkapkan bahwa “we also brought the quantum realm into the movie, which was never in the early drafts,” reed told vulture. What if we got to the third act and we took it even further?’ We found a way to work that into the story with the self-sacrifice that Scott makes to save his daughter, but it also leaves Hank Pym with this realization that Scott got out of the quantum realm, something he didn’t think was possible. We thought, ‘There’s gonna be a lot of shrinking in this movie. “That mostly came about because Adam and I love that psychedelic part of Marvel Comics. ”.

Considering how important the quantum realm is to the MCU, especially for Avengers: Endgame, it’s clear that Wright’s departure didn’t just change Ant-Man, it changed the entire MCU.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the final version of ant-man, scott lang is an ex-con in the very loosest sense, having committed some anti-corporate crime where he did some robin hood kind of thing, stealing corporate money and giving it to people who had been scammed by the company. But in Wright’s version, Lang started out as an “actual criminal,” Wright explained on his Instagram, with a greater redemption arc throughout the film. This undoubtedly would have changed the character, and probably would have made him a bit more interesting.

Berdasarkan laporan, evangeline lilly, who came onto the film as hope van dyne because of edgar wright, was a big supporter of his and almost left the film in solidarity. It just would have taken you away from this cohesive universe they’re trying to create. Eventually, she was convinced to stay on and, after having seen the finished film directed by Reed, she told The Hollywood Reporter that Wright's version “wouldn’t have fit in the Marvel Universe. It would have stuck out like a sore thumb, no matter how good it was. ”.

#837. 10 Best Cowboys & Cowgirls In The Yellowstone Franchise

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Best Cowboys & Cowgirls In The Yellowstone Franchise

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/yellowstone-best-cowboy-cowgirls/

Berdasarkan laporan, faith roswell is a senior writer on screen rant's classic tv team. Faith now combines her knowledge of psychology with her love of monster movies to give more insight into what makes the best ones. Since earning her degree in Creative Writing over a decade ago, Faith has written articles on film and TV from a variety of different angles. You may have read her Screen Rant lists and features covering horror, sci-fi, and fantasy, or read her Amazon Top 10 book, "Movie Monsters of the Deep. " Faith has had an extensive career as a writer, appearing on BBC live radio, researching true crime for Rotten Mango podcast, and writing for publications including Mental Floss, Atlas Obscura, and The Daily Jaws before beginning here at Screen Rant.

Diungkapkan bahwa yellowstone's dutton ranch is the heart and soul of the series, and while classic westerns often romanticize the life of a cowboy, the shows in taylor sheridan's yellowstone franchise embrace the grit and harsh conditions that come with working in such a stunning location. The iconic Yellowstone brand perfectly represents this, with the ranch employing a large staff of cowboys but relatively few having the honor of wearing it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the franchise is not always realistic, but one aspect that has repeatedly been true to life is the casting, with yellowstone casting real cowboys to play some of the ranch hands, which is why so many of the show's actors appear so comfortable with horse riding, rodeo, and even the occasional stunts. This, combined with the performances of the main actors in the series, has ensured that the messy, intense, and demanding job of working as a cowboy or cowgirl earns the respect of the audience, no matter which Yellowstone TV show is playing.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a character, ethan is likely a better cowboy than is shown onscreen, as he came to appear in yellowstone through other jobs on the set. Actor and horse trainer Ethan Lee was initially a stunt double, consultant, and mentor for the show, and with the main actors needing to appear highly competent in their roles, he ran cowboy "boot camps" for the cast, sharing his expertise.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ethan earned his brand by the end of yellowstone's third season, proving him a trusted employee and ranch hand at dutton ranch. That said, much of Lee's work on the show was done outside of playing the character sharing his name and viewers have not had much of a chance to judge his character's individual work, which is why Ethan has such a low rank on this list.

Sebagaimana diketahui, laramie came to dutton ranch with an already established and respected career as a barrel racer, but despite clearly being capable of carrying out the work needed on the ranch, her competence as a cowgirl was quickly overshadowed by love triangle storylines. Laramie was a polarizing character for this reason, and opinions were divided over whether she was an undeveloped character orbiting the more interesting cowboys, or a modern cowgirl who refused to conform to the hierarchy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when lloyd and walker's fight over laramie resulted in women being barred from the bunkhouse, laramie could have chosen a different career, but instead, she left dutton ranch to continue barrel racing on the rodeo circuit. This proved her to be a competent cowgirl with a future working with horses, reflecting the real-life abilities of actor Hassie Harrison, who grew up on a cattle ranch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, actor and musician ryan bingham began a rodeo career at age 17 and, after meeting taylor sheridan while working on the soundtrack for his movie wind river, sheridan wrote the role of walker into yellowstone for him. Walker received his brand in the show's first season, instantly establishing his high status both as a cowboy and as the closest thing to family on the ranch.

In addition to playing Walker, Bingham has also contributed to the Yellowstone soundtrack.

Sebagaimana diketahui, walker is clearly good at his job and seen riding horses and working cattle, but he is also able to teach other characters, like beth, to be better riders, which sets him above the other ranch hands in the series. That said, Walker's heart is not necessarily in ranch life, as the character is an aspiring country singer who does not always support the extreme measures taken by the Duttons.

Berdasarkan laporan, jake ream was a horse trainer and cowboy long before he worked on yellowstone, first meeting taylor sheridan when he sold him a horse. Ream gave lessons to Sheridan and his family, and like Ethan Lee, he also ran the cowboy boot camp sessions for the show's main actors. This led to Ream gradually taking on a greater role in the series, first appearing at the end of the first season and getting his brand in the third.

Berdasarkan laporan, ream's character shares his name, and jake is portrayed as a strong and dependable character regularly seen performing genuine ranch tasks on camera, from roping cattle to working in the bunkhouse. That said, he does not have the intense and dramatic plotlines that many of the other characters do, resulting in him fading into the background despite being one of Dutton Ranch's best workers and continuing life as a cowboy after the Yellowstone finale.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unlike most of the other cowboys and cowgirls in the yellowstone franchise, 1883's elsa dutton was not born into training for this life. That said, as a naturally gifted horsewoman, she takes to frontier life and learns through experience, becoming an excellent cowgirl through her own drive and ambition rather than through expectation. Taking place over just one season, her transformation is dramatic, going from a wagon passenger to a fierce protector of the cattle herd.

Sebagaimana diketahui, elsa is easily one of the best dutton family members, and her overarching storyline is arguably the most tragic in the series for her wasted potential. Had Elsa survived, she could have been one of the most formidable and talented cowgirls in the family, as she was quickly able to hold her own with experienced cowboys like Ennis and even earned the respect of the veteran trailhands.

Berdasarkan laporan, teeter's introduction instantly proved her a talented cowgirl, with rip hiring her after seeing her competing in a rodeo where she ropes a bull in record time. That said, on arriving at Dutton Ranch, Teeter appeared set up to be little more than comic relief at best and a hot mess at worst, but she became one of the best characters in Yellowstone for her work ethic, ability, and refusal to be sidelined for being female.

Berdasarkan laporan, unlike laramie, teeter is seen taking on much of the heavy labor around dutton ranch, including branding, roping, and handling cattle, as well as riding on horseback. Having worked twice as hard to prove herself as capable as the cowboys, she finds herself in demand, working on other ranches throughout the series and finally moving to Texas' Bosque Ranch to continue life as a cowgirl after Yellowstone's finale.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dutton ranch's stoic and imposing foreman is one of the best neo-western protagonists of all time, with an antihero streak. His status among the Dutton family is already established in Yellowstone's first episode, when he gives a character the choice between incarceration or being branded and working at the ranch. Rip choosing his own workers like this instantly shows that he demonstrated his own trustworthiness long ago, and his role goes far beyond just those of a cowboy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rip's duties are much more than those of a typical ranch hand. He handles the herd movements and tracking of cattle, manages and looks after the other workers, and acts as the enforcer for Dutton Ranch. He is responsible for the smooth running of virtually every aspect of the ranch, and while he does not have specialist rodeo skills, the abilities he has make him invaluable to both the Dutton family and to the series.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, forrie j. Smith comes from a family of rodeo riders and began his career at just eight years old, gaining more real-life experience as a cowboy than most of the characters in Yellowstone have. Smith spent years riding in rodeos before his talent saw him taking on stunt work, leading him to Taylor Sheridan, who offered him a role in Yellowstone after seeing him doing stunts and wrangling in Hell or High Water.

Diungkapkan bahwa smith plays lloyd pierce, dutton ranch's resident mentor and one of the oldest ranch hands, seen during the first season and becoming a fan favorite over the course of the show. Unlike some of the other characters played by real-life cowboys, Yellowstone makes use of Smith's experience by showcasing his exceptional riding, which easily illustrates why he is the most respected of the show's many cowboys.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 1923's jacob dutton, the great, great uncle of john dutton, spent decades transforming the family's cattle empire, and while he is technically considered a rancher, he remains one of the yellowstone franchise's best cowboys in terms of his competence and skills. Rather than leaving the hands-on work to the wranglers, Jacob rides with them, personally managing grazing rotations and handling the livestock directly, but there is more to his experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, jacob knows every aspect of life as a cowboy, from the heavy ranch work and riding duties, to the law, making him a formidable character to challenge. He understands the entire business from the ground up, and it is his determination to make something more of the business that led to Dutton Ranch being the success it became. Kevin Costner gave one of the best performances in any Taylor Sheridan show while playing Jacob, making the character an icon.

Berdasarkan laporan, taylor sheridan regularly appears in his yellowstone franchise and adds some extra authenticity to his role as travis wheatley, as he is also a cowboy himself and a part owner of the four sixes ranch that is featured in the series. Wheatley is a rodeo rider and an elite horse trainer and trader who often does business with Dutton Ranch, and his abilities are fully on display in some of Yellowstone's best horse riding scenes.

Yellowstone is based on Taylor Sheridan's childhood coming from a ranching family.

Sebagaimana diketahui, travis' standout scenes showcase sheridan's expert horse riding and cutting experience, with travis impressing beth by isolating a single cow from a herd, entering a competition alongside rip and fellow trainer matt, and demonstrating his knowledge of his industry by explaining bloodlines and pricing. In terms of pure horsemanship and cowboy skills, Travis is the best in the Yellowstone franchise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, yellowstone is a neo-western drama series created by taylor sheridan and john linson, centered on the dutton family and their fight to protect the yellowstone dutton ranch from various adversaries, including land developers and nearby reservations. Premiering in 2018 on Paramount Network, the show has been praised for its depiction of power struggles, family loyalty, and rural conflicts. It has expanded into a franchise with spin-offs such as 1883 and 1923, and an upcoming sequel series is in development.
