#841. CBS’ New ‘Lincoln Lawyer’ Replacement Just Proved Network TV Isn’t Dead

📅 15 Nov 2026

CBS’ New ‘Lincoln Lawyer’ Replacement Just Proved Network TV Isn’t Dead

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/cupertino-lincoln-lawyer-replacement-network-tv-success/

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i’m not dead!” the quote comes from the "bring out your dead" plague cart scene from the iconic film monty python and the holy grail, where an old man repeatedly insists he hasn’t yet shuffled off this mortal coil. The rookie series has found an audience, doubling its viewership with the pilot episode reaching 10. What keeps it alive are shows like the new Lincoln Lawyer replacement from CBS, Cupertino. Yet it could just as easily apply to network television, which refuses to go away despite the dominance of streaming. 58 million viewers, the latest evidence that there’s still life on network TV.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cupertino is a great show and is certainly worthy of the attention it’s receiving, particularly with its perfect 100% on rotten tomatoes. 9 million viewers. It’s also not alone: fellow CBS legal drama Matlock isn’t all that far behind at 93%, with the Season 2 premiere bringing in 11. The thing is, the reason behind these successes isn’t exactly rocket science. Cupertino and Matlock have nailed the essentials.

Diungkapkan bahwa that begins with the writing. Cupertino is the latest venture from Robert and Michelle King, the duo behind The Good Wife and Elsbeth, and what their shows all have in common is their penchant for sharp, smart, and clever writing. The banter is quick; the legal tricks of the trade are interesting, plausible, and engaging (even fun); and, more prominent in Elsbeth, a fearless embrace of the quirky.

Sebagaimana diketahui, writing, however, is only half of it: without the right cast, the words become inconsequential. Mike Colter, who worked with the Kings on the stellar Evil, is great as Michael Price, an attorney whose expulsion from a Silicon Valley start-up prompts him to open a practice devoted to clients who have been wronged by the technology giants in the area. Thankfully, it’s another essential that they’ve perfected. He commands the screen when he’s on it, a gentle giant of a man with a clever legal mind and a heart.

It's about to get personal for Price, Siffre & Associates this Thursday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and rachel keller, who plays his young partner, olivia siffre, balances a character who is enthusiastic, thinks outside the box, and a christian on television that isn’t a stereotype, with an enchanting ease. Ella Stiller brings the quirk as Michael’s assistant Christy, and the addition of the talented Busy Philipps is a home run. It shows that when the writing and the cast is excellent, people will tune in to watch, whether it’s on streaming or on network television.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at first glance, cupertino is a traditional legal drama, hitting the same marks as any other legal drama. Like The Lincoln Lawyer before it, Cupertino is focused on an upstart law firm starting from scratch, which is a rarity in the genre to begin with. But on its premise alone, Cupertino already stands out from its kin. And they lean into it, too, working out where to get office space, which clients can pay up front, and so on, instead of already having the capital to hit the ground running.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the fact that the law firm is the david to the big tech goliaths of silicon valley, though, is fresh and, most importantly, timely. The questions and conflicts that arise in Cupertino are more in line with real-world concerns and situations. That points to the one big advantage that network television has over streaming. An AI who is looking to hire a law firm to have his safeguards reinstalled, for example, or a trial that takes place entirely on cellphones due to a traffic jam.

Berdasarkan laporan, because streamers typically drop all their episodes for a season at once, they run the risk of being slightly behind the zeitgeist. Network television programs, however, still shoot episodes as the season is being aired, allowing for last-minute changes that are, again, timely. Is it a big advantage? Not necessarily, but it shouldn’t be dismissed outright either. The key is quality, after all, and as long as network television continues to make that a priority, as they have with Cupertino, then the Grim Reaper will just have to wait.

#842. Stephen King’s Underrated 1980 Horror Thriller Gets New Prime Video Adaptation

Stephen King’s Underrated 1980 Horror Thriller Gets New Prime Video Adaptation

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/stephen-king-prime-video-crouch-end-tv-show/

King's cosmic horror story is getting a brand-new adaptation.

Diungkapkan bahwa stephen king fans are eating well, with mike flanagan's adaptation of carrie turning out to be a surprise hit, a second season of it: welcome to derry on the way, and a series based on the dark tower books in the works. But that's not all King fans can look forward to.

Sebagaimana diketahui, prime video is reportedly developing a limited series based on king's horror-sci-fi short story crouch end. P. Considered an homage to H. Lovecraft, the story first appeared in the New Tales of the Cthulhu Mythos anthology, and was later published in King’s Nightmares & Dreamscapes short story collection. It bears the distinction of not being set in King's native Maine, like many of his works, but rather in London.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the series' official synopsis reads: “london never sleeps deeply, and its dreams are uneasy. When global movie star Doris Freeman bursts into a London police station claiming that strange phenomena are behind the disappearance of her husband, police inspector Ted Vetter must investigate whether she’s telling the truth, whether she could be a murderer, or whether there’s something even more chilling at play…”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the six-part adaptation is created by paul tomalin (bodies) and directed by tom shankland (berlin noir). Variety confirms its producers include Mammoth Screen (The Serpent), and Fifth Season (Severance), while its executive producers are Paul Tomalin, Ben Irving, Rebecca Keane, Damien Timmer, and Tom Shankland.

Sebagaimana diketahui, tomalin and shankland's project is far from the first time that crouch end has received an adaptation. The short story was also adapted as an episode of TNT's Nightmares & Dreamscapes: From the Stories of Stephen King in 2006, starring Eion Bailey as Lonnie Freeman and Claire Forlani as Doris Freeman. While Crouch End is certainly short enough to fit into a single episode, Shankland and Tomalin's adaptation will have room to explore more of the themes of grief, trauma, and cosmic horror.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i’ve been a stephen king super-fan forever," shankland said in a statement. "The chance to work with this great team and bring his utterly brilliant London mystery to life is beyond exciting – Crouch End will be cinematic, original and thought-provoking in equal measure. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa tomalin added: "after reading ‘crouch end’ some years back, stephen king’s vivid prose has haunted my nightmares ever since. Having the honour to adapt it with the incredible team at Mammoth, Fifth Season and Amazon alongside director Tom Shankland is a dream come true. I couldn’t be more excited to bring this thrilling tale to the screen. ”.

Sit back and go on a wild ride with Maximum Overdrive.

Berdasarkan laporan, in addition to being a supernatural mystery and crime-thriller, crouch end also draws on the cthulhu mythos of h. P. Lovecraft — meaning there will be plenty of grotesque imagery and horror alongside its mystery and crime elements.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nicole clemens, the vice president of international originals at prime video and amazon mgm studios, said in a statement: "stephen king is one of the defining storytellers of our time, and we’re thrilled to bring his lovecraftian tale to life in london with crouch end. Paul Tomalin brings a singular, character-driven vision to the series and, paired with Tom Shankland at the helm, plus the first-class production teams at Mammoth Screen and Fifth Season, this show will grip audiences worldwide with its visceral crime thriller and supernatural mystery. ".

Crouch End does not have a confirmed release date.

#844. Resident Evil 10 Officially Confirmed By Capcom

Resident Evil 10 Officially Confirmed By Capcom

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/resident-evil-10-officially-confirmed-by-capcom/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with so many major video game anniversaries being celebrated this year, it's easy to forget that resident evil is among them, with a staggering 3 decades since the release of the first game in the beloved franchise. The series is back in vogue right now thanks to some stellar titles in recent years, most recently Requiem, which showed what a game focused on both action and stealth could be like.

Berdasarkan laporan, over the last few years, it has certainly felt like capcom has been building towards something quite specific rather than just treading water and bringing players new experiences within the ip. Now, we have had confirmation from the developer themselves about what exactly they plan to do in the coming years, and it's safe to say the fans should be in for a very exciting time if all of it comes to fruition.

As first reported by Polygon, Yahoo Japan sat down with the Resident Evil franchise's creative director, Jun Takeuchi, and he laid out exactly what the timeline is going to look like for the series moving forward, as well as giving us an idea of what their plans are for the overarching narrative.

Berdasarkan laporan, "with the release of requiem this year, i feel like the first 10 years have come to a close, so i think the conclusion will come in the next 10 years," takeuchi said. "I can't say because it would spoil the fun for everyone, but there won't be just one. There will be multiple titles. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, that's obviously brilliant news in and of itself, as if we get several titles of requiem's quality in the next few years, then we could arguably be entering a golden era for the series. Interestingly, Takeuchi also made it clear that the remakes we have seen so far have been deliberately chosen to facilitate the story from here, and they have made subtle changes to bring that on further.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we've always slightly altered the original storylines in our re remakes. When we were planning "RE:2" (the remake of 2) and creating a 10-year branding concept, this was the most challenging aspect. I hope you'll look forward to seeing the true nature of Spencer (the mastermind behind the series)," he said. These differences gradually become meaningful. If you play through all of them, I think you'll realize the meaning behind the order of the remakes. "The series' story wasn't planned out from the beginning; it expanded with each new game. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, they are certainly interesting tidbits, even if he wouldn't be drawn on the specifics of what is to come yet. It does sound like we might not be too far away from another announcement at the very least, with most expecting that to be a full reveal of the now confirmed Code Veronica remake.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, given resident evil's importance to the video game ecosystem as a whole, particularly in the late-90s and early-2000s, it is really nice to see it become so relevant to fans again. It has certainly been through some ups and downs as a series over the years, but it's absolutely on a more certain footing now than it has been in some time, and that can only be encouraging for the future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ink director danny boyle on saturday confirmed that redacted sun newspaper headlines shown as part of an epilogue in his netflix drama about the founding of the uk tabloid will be shown in full in the u. S. theatrical and streaming version of the film.

Speaking while receiving the Deadline Legend Awards during Deadline’s Contenders Film Los Angeles awards-season event Saturday, Boyle said an edited version showing the headlines is currently being edited into a new cut of the film in time for its December 11 release in select theaters.

Berdasarkan laporan, the pic, based on james graham’s play and adapted screenplay that tells the story of rupert murdoch and editor larry lamb’s takeover of the british tabloid the sun in the late 1960s, setting the tone for new kind of journalism in the process, was unable to show the headlines owing to britain’s stringent libel laws. Watch on Deadline.

Diungkapkan bahwa “we’ve had a battle to get the film to where it is now, and i can tell you — i can say this, can’t i? — i think that we just won the ability [to show the headlines] because we’re in america, and you have better protection for freedom of speech than we have in britain,” boyle said during the q&a session at the dga theater, adding that he hopes the uncensored version “will be [in] the finished version of the film, which we’ve never been able to show in britain. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, boyle pointed to one specific headline in the epilogue that was redacted in uk versions of the pic, above an article about the 1989 death of 97 fans crushed while trying to enter hillsborough stadium to watch a liverpool-nottingham forest fa cup soccer game. The tabloid report blamed Liverpool fans for the tragedy, citing what turned out to fabricated police and official reports.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “there are various headlines … at the end of [ink], and there’s one particular, which although it won’t mean anything to you, to anybody from britain it does mean a great deal, which is that the sun ran a terrible headline called ‘the truth,’ which is one of the principal concerns of james graham’s screenplay throughout the whole film,” boyle said. We have these redacted versions, but know that we’re in America. “[The Sun] ran this headline, and it was a bunch of lies about the way that Liverpool fans were killed at the Hillsborough disaster,” he continued. “It’s one of the low points of British journalism, and we wanted that to be always in the film, and we weren’t able to have it in the British version. We’ve got it in there, and I hope that the tidal wave will then reach back to Britain, and we’ll be allowed to put them in there because it’s an important moment for freedom of speech, which you have enshrined. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he added, “you know, it’s it’s it’s interesting that a tabloid that you know that lets it all hang out would try to stop you from doing something similar. ”.

The epilogue in the pic, which stars Jack O’Connell as Lamb and Guy Pearce as Murdoch, is also key as it ties The Sun’s rise to modern tabloids — and Murdoch’s eventual founding of Fox News.

Diungkapkan bahwa “what they ignited … and the pact that they came up with to start the sun culminates financially and principally in the birth of fox news,” boyle said. So there’s an umbilical cord, I think, that connects these two guys and their meeting in 1969 with where we are now. “Because the money that The Sun made allowed Murdoch to buy 20th Century Fox and then to finance the establishment, the extraordinary establishment, of a new terrestrial channel in America, which takes a lot of money. ”.

#858. Michael Jackson Movie Sequel Faces A Bigger Challenge Than The First Film

📅 15 Nov 2026

Michael Jackson Movie Sequel Faces A Bigger Challenge Than The First Film

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/michael-jackson-movie-sequel-bigger-challenge-first-film/

Diungkapkan bahwa lionsgate's 2026 musical biopic michael brought the life and legacy of the king of pop, michael jackson, to the big screen in perhaps the largest way any movie has done so far, and now, they will be trying to replicate that feat in the upcoming michael sequel movie that is already confirmed to be in the works. Michael was a fascinating release when it hit theaters this April. Although some reviews of Michael were very positive, most of them effectively tore the movie apart, for a range of reasons.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among the biggest complaints were the movie's seeming avoidance of jackson's real-life controversies (although, notably, the movie concludes before many of those events transpired, chronologically) as well as related criticisms that the movie glorifies jackson and avoids any thornier, more negative traits or moments from his life. However, audiences had an overwhelmingly positive response to the movie by comparison. To put it in perspective, the critic score on Rotten Tomatoes is a bleak 38%, representing 312 reviews, whereas the audience score is a staggering 97%, accounting for more than 25,000 ratings.

Diungkapkan bahwa that division isn't likely to go anywhere in the michael sequel, which has been given the working title of michael 2, although a different final title is almost certainly coming. In fact, this upcoming movie, which will very likely focus on the remainder of Jackson's life until his death in 2009, has a significantly more daunting task ahead of it, as the very events that critics complained were absent in Michael will, by necessity, be appearing in Michael 2. In addition to the controversies, that means some of the most significant moments of the star's very complicated life.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, michael concludes in 1988, during jackson's bad tour. At the time, this choice was, in part, what led to such harsh backlash from many critics, as it seemed like Michael had intentionally ended then, before any allegations about Jackson emerged. It wasn't yet known that Michael was getting a sequel. Presumably, Michael 2 would pick up soon after that conclusion, but whether there's a slight jump forward in time or not, a sequel that highlights the remainder of Jackson's life will have some very choppy waters to navigate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for one thing, jackson went on to have three children, paris, prince, and bigi, with paris and prince born in the late 1990s and bigi being born in 2002—meaning that all three births come after the conclusion of michael. There is some question about whether the movie is going to include his children, as there may be some objections from within the family (although, for now, those conversations are largely speculative chatter), but it feels next to impossible that they won't be present at all; they were, understandably, a huge part of his life.

Of course, the 90s and 00s also saw the release of some of Jackson's most famous songs and albums from throughout his life and the emergence of the first allegation of child sexual abuse against Jackson, none of which is going to be easy to capture on the big screen, for very different reasons.

Diungkapkan bahwa michael concluding in 1988 means that some of jackson's best songs were released after that movie's end. Along with many others, that album included the song "Black or White," which continues to be one of Jackson's best-known and most celebrated songs today. Among the most notable releases following the conclusion of Michael was his studio album Dangerous, which was released in 1991. Also released after Michael's conclusion was his final studio album of new material during his lifetime, Invincible.

Diungkapkan bahwa found an error? send it info@screenrant. com so it can be corrected.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, michael already proved that lionsgate is up to the difficult task of bringing concert-level experiences to the screen even as the biopic follows a narrative arc. In fact, this was among the reasons that many audience members loved it; chatter online and audience ratings suggest that many Michael Jackson fans felt it was the closest they could come to seeing him in concert again. In that sense, Michael 2 will just have to repeat that success. That's easier said than done, of course, but it's far from the most daunting obstacle the sequel movie has ahead.

Berdasarkan laporan, the single biggest obstacle facing michael 2 is the fact that the film will absolutely have to address the multiple allegations of child sexual abuse made against jackson in his lifetime. Already, there have been discussions about why those stories weren't in Michael, from the timeline of that movie to the fact that certain stories could not appear in the film for legal reasons. However, considering that Michael 2 is set after 1988, there is just no way around it, and, in addition to being incredibly sensitive, serious subject matter, this is going to require a tonal shift from Michael.

Diungkapkan bahwa critics weren't wrong that michael has a largely positive, upbeat tone that does center michael as a loving, fun, kind-hearted character who has been wronged by many people. While there are those who would agree with that representation of Michael Jackson and those who wouldn't, there is no conceivable way that Michael 2 can move forward with the same depiction of Jackson and his life that the first movie had—at least, it can't without being much more seriously criticized even than Michael was.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, additionally, michael 2 will have to take some sort of stance on the allegations made against jackson and whether they were true. Notably, Jackson was found not guilty in court. However, the court of public opinion is another matter, and many feel that the allegations were true (not to mention the fact that a court ruling does not automatically mean that something is true or untrue). Michael 2 will inevitably anger those who hold one belief or the other—or, potentially, those on both sides of the argument.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this may actually alienate the very fanbase that loved michael, if the movie suggests the allegations were true or even leaves that in question. On the other hand, if Michael 2 suggests that the allegations were false or largely sweeps the allegations under the rug, then it will only intensify the criticism and backlash from Michael. In either case, Michael 2 has a very difficult path ahead.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, assuming that michael 2 takes the story all the way to the singer's death in 2009, which feels more likely than not, then it will also have the monumental task of somehow providing an "end" to the story, although arguably, there hasn't been one, even now. For one, in terms of the aforementioned controversies, those legal battles continue, with new updates and even new allegations over the years following Jackson's death.

Berdasarkan laporan, additionally, it's difficult to capture what jackson has meant globally and the profound impact he continues to have on pop culture. That is perhaps what made Michael so impressive already; Michael Jackson is an incredibly complex public figure, and capturing those complexities on screen is no easy feat. He is seen by many as the true greatest of all time, and he has continued to influence the music industry and beyond, long after his death (and the conclusion of that legacy doesn't seem to be arriving anytime soon). The question simply remains, can Michael 2 pull it off?.

#864. 18-Part 'The Crown Meets Bridgerton' Series Is Hands Down Netflix's Best Historical Drama

📅 15 Nov 2026

18-Part 'The Crown Meets Bridgerton' Series Is Hands Down Netflix's Best Historical Drama

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/the-empress-netflix-best-historical-drama/

Sebagaimana diketahui, memory ngulube joined screen rant in april 2024 as part of the movies and tv team. Memory is currently a Classic TV writer. Before joining Screen Rant, Memory was a freelance copywriter who specialized in email marketing and social media management. While she enjoyed her job, her true passion was always movies and TV. Since then, she has written for the Perennials and Streaming team, covering a wide range of topics from new releases to old movies and TV shows. When she isn’t writing for Screen Rant, Memory can be found reading, baking (which is one of her passions), or watching her favorite K-drama.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when the crown premiered on netflix in 2016, it immediately piqued audience interest. After all, who doesn't love a show that delves into the lives of one of the world's most powerful families? The beloved historical drama didn't survive unscathed, but overall, it performed well with audiences and critics alike. To this day, The Crown is considered to be one of Netflix’s best period dramas.

Diungkapkan bahwa bridgerton, on the other hand, gained popularity thanks to its steamy, heartfelt romances and alternate-history regency-era setting. Though not based on a true story, the Shonda Rhimes show is magnetic, offering viewers diverse, tantalizing romances and family drama. While it's not as popular as Bridgerton or The Crown, Netflix's German original series The Empress is a beautiful, intriguing series that combines the best elements from both shows.

Sebagaimana diketahui, chronicling empress elisabeth’s life in the 19th century, this dramatized true story is an absolute joy to watch, elevated by its compelling protagonist and sordid royal drama. The Empress is by no means as steamy as Bridgerton, but matches the period drama’s swoon-worthy romantic focus. With the show’s final season now streaming on Netflix, The Empress deserves its flowers, more so because each installment is better than the last and has something important to say about mental health, women’s rights, and autonomy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, many tv shows start with a bang and promise great things to come. However, as they add more seasons and episodes, they fall off and lose the elements that made them so addictive in the first place. The Empress, however, is different. The period drama’s first installment earned an impressive 85% Rotten Tomatoes audience score, while its second season’s nearly perfect 92% RT audience rating proved the series was getting better.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the empress is so charming and watchable largely because of its layered, well-developed main character. By season 2, Austria is at war, and the Empress begins to hate her life as her duties take their toll. In The Empress season 1, Elisabeth is a naive girl who believes she has finally found her happily-ever-after ending when she marries Austrian Emperor Franz Joseph. The show's third and final season, however, is a true masterpiece.

Berdasarkan laporan, elisabeth, now grown and weary in the empress season 3, does what she does best: whatever she wants. The titular Empress has a vulnerability and fierceness in the show's final run that reminds audiences why they fell in love with her in the first place. Sure, her and Franz's marriage isn't always as strong, but their love endures, mostly because they bring out the best in each other.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, numerous movies and tv shows have dissected the british royal family, so fictionalizing their lives is nothing new. However, given how ubiquitous the royals are, it isn't always easy to handle their stories delicately, especially for a series like The Crown. It invited a lot of controversy during its run. Even beloved British icon Dame Judi Dench criticized the successful series, calling it “crude sensationalism” (via Entertainment Weekly).

Spanning 6 decades of British royal history, The Crown brought many real-life figures to the screen, and these ten performances stand out as the best.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the events depicted in the netflix series were still relatively new, or at least recent enough for people to remember — even during the first few seasons, which dramatized queen elizabeth ii’s earliest years as a monarch. People knew where they were when she was married, when she was crowned. There is archival footage of her reign. This issue worsened as the show went on. The backlash was inevitable.

Berdasarkan laporan, like queen elizabeth ii, empress elisabeth was revered. Still, Elisabeth was born in 1837 and died in 1898. Audiences were (and are) unlikely to scrutinize The Empress to the same extent as The Crown. The Crown couldn't avoid being put under a microscope. As such, her story still fascinates people, which is why it’s been widely documented and examined. That creates a safe distance and room for creative expression. Many of the people the show talks about are still alive — and their legacy is more precarious than ever.

All three seasons of The Empress are streaming now on Netflix.

#865. Calvin and Hobbes’ 5 Greatest Spaceman Spiff Comic Strips

Calvin and Hobbes’ 5 Greatest Spaceman Spiff Comic Strips

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/calvin-hobbes-best-spaceman-spiff-comics/

Send this article to your favorite space crustacean.

Send this article to your favorite space crustacean.

Sebagaimana diketahui, calvin and hobbes wasn't bill watterson's first pitch for a comic strip. C&H's protagonists began as side characters in Watterson's comic The Doghouse before his original syndicate suggested that they ought to be the focus. "Marvin" became "Calvin," the rest of The Doghouse's cast was dropped, and while United Feature Syndicate still didn't take the resulting comic, Universal Press Syndicate did.

Berdasarkan laporan, before then, watterson had drawn cartoons about a spacefaring character as early as college. Watterson went on to make that character the focus of one of his rejected comics: a mustachioed, cigar-smoking parody of adventurers like Flash Gordon. Shortly after Calvin and Hobbes began, Watterson reworked "Mort" into Calvin's fantasy alter ego Spaceman Spiff.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, over the course of calvin and hobbes' run, spiff was one of calvin's most frequent escapist characters. Whenever Calvin was caught in a boring or unpleasant situation, he frequently retreated into his Spiff persona to pass time or even make a hasty retreat. In practice, that gave Watterson a handy excuse to take Calvin and Hobbes' art well outside its usual mundane setting, with tons of gross aliens, impossible landscapes, and great phrases like "eat hot electric death" that don't usually come up in everyday conversation.

Diungkapkan bahwa much like the rest of calvin and hobbes, spaceman spiff really hit his stride in the comic's last three years, when watterson began doing his trademark "unbreakable" sunday strips. Some of the most colorful and evocative C&H comics are Spaceman Spiff adventures from the mid-'90s, but Spiff made a few solid appearances before that point. Here are some of our picks for the best Spaceman Spiff comics in Calvin and Hobbes.

Berdasarkan laporan, when calvin gets sick during his summer vacation, his first reaction is to get annoyed. Sick days are for the school year. I think we all can relate.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately for all involved, calvin's mom takes him to the doctor. That includes a checkup, an injection, and a retreat into Calvin's Spiff mode, as he imagines himself as a prisoner of aliens rather than a little kid trapped in an examination room.

Diungkapkan bahwa the most extreme (in the '90s sense) spaceman spiff adventure was a week-long story where calvin got deeply enough into character that he staged a breakout from elementary school. Berdasarkan laporan, right from the start, bill watterson has said that one of his primary influences on calvin & hobbes is george herriman's golden age newspaper comic krazy kat, which ran from 1913 to 1944. That was already some inside baseball in the 1980s when Calvin and Hobbes was new, as Krazy Kat’s modern following is almost exclusively made up of historians, fanatics, and other cartoonists. It’s not dead media yet, though, as historians and preservationists have made a point of keeping collections of Krazy Kat in print. Curious readers can check out Fantagraphics' George Herriman Library hardcover collections, which are still in print at time of writing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you check out krazy kat, its influence on calvin and hobbes is obvious immediately, particularly in its colored sunday comics. Herriman's characters inhabited a cartoonish version of the Arizona desert, and many of Watterson's Spaceman Spiff strips feature him visiting alien planets with similar arid backgrounds. This largely-wordless strip from 1993 is a perfect example, with so much of it devoted to Calvin's imagined spaceship journey from an alien valley to home.

#868. 5 Best Cartoon Network Anime Available Now On Netflix

📅 15 Nov 2026

5 Best Cartoon Network Anime Available Now On Netflix

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/best-cartoon-network-anime-available-on-netflix/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for an entire generation of kids rushing home from school in the late '90s and 2000s, or staying up way past bedtime with the volume turned down low, cartoon network was basically their first anime streaming service, long before streaming was even a thing. Nobody really cared whether Dragon Ball Z, Sailor Moon, or Yu Yu Hakusho came from Japan. They were just the coolest cartoons on television, and Toonami made sure every afternoon felt like an event.

Sebagaimana diketahui, launched in march 1997 with the iconic robot tom aboard the spaceship absolution, toonami introduced western audiences to some of anime's biggest names. From Naruto, Bleach, and One Piece to later hits like My Hero Academia and Dr. Stone, its lineup helped turn casual cartoon watchers into lifelong anime fans. Even after moving to Adult Swim's late-night Saturday block, Toonami kept that connection alive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sadly, finding those old favorites isn't as easy anymore. With streaming rights constantly changing, classics like Cowboy Bebop and Yu Yu Hakusho have left Netflix's US library, sending fans to platforms like Prime Video, Hulu, and Crunchyroll. Thankfully, Netflix still has plenty of former Cartoon Network favorites, including One Piece and Neon Genesis Evangelion. But beyond those household names, Netflix still has several other standout Cartoon Network and Toonami anime that deserve the spotlight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, few anime capture the feeling of late-night cartoon network quite like inuyasha. Created by Rumiko Takahashi and animated by Studio Sunrise, the series first arrived on Cartoon Network's Adult Swim block in August 2002. Those who stayed up until 2 AM watching Adult Swim will probably remember its haunting ending themes and the sight of Kagome and Inuyasha travelling through feudal Japan. It remained a regular part of the channel's lineup until March 2014, before returning to Toonami that November to finally air its 26-episode conclusion, InuYasha: The Final Act.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the story follows fifteen-year-old kagome higurashi, whose family shrine hides a well that sends her straight into japan's sengoku period. After accidentally shattering the wish-granting Shikon Jewel, she joins forces with the hot-headed half-demon Inuyasha to recover its scattered shards before the spider-demon Naraku gets his hands on them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, along the way, the pair are joined by sango, miroku, and shippo, while inuyasha's rivalry with his older brother sesshomaru adds another great layer to the story. And, of course, there's the complicated love triangle involving Kagome and the tragic priestess Kikyo. Both the original series and The Final Act are available on Netflix, making this a great chance to revisit one of Toonami's most memorable anime.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, before inuyasha became a late-night cartoon network favourite, rumiko takahashi had already given anime fans another classic with ranma ½. It was especially popular on late-night screens across Latin America from July 2006. Studio Deen's original 161-episode adaptation ran from 1989 to 1992, first reaching North American fans through VHS releases before becoming a memorable part of Cartoon Network's international Toonami blocks. With its ridiculous martial arts battles, wild transformations, and unmistakable '80s charm, it was the kind of show that made staying up past midnight worthwhile.

Berdasarkan laporan, the chaos begins when teenage martial arts prodigy ranma saotome and his father, genma, visit china's cursed jusenkyo springs during a training trip. After falling into the wrong pools, Ranma transforms into a girl whenever splashed with cold water, while Genma turns into a giant panda. Hot water reverses both curses, but that doesn't make their lives any easier.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, back in japan, ranma is also stuck in an arranged engagement with akane tendo, soun's short-tempered youngest daughter. Their constant bickering is half the fun, especially with Ryoga, the hopelessly directionally challenged rival who becomes Akane's pet piglet P-chan, and Shampoo, a Chinese Amazon determined to win Ranma's affection. The original is a nostalgic treat, while Studio MAPPA's vibrant remake is now in its third season on Netflix.

Diungkapkan bahwa few late-night toonami memories are as unforgettable as staying up until 2 am on a saturday and hearing kamina shout about a drill that will pierce the heavens. Studio Gainax's 2007 mecha classic first reached American cable through Sci Fi's Ani-Monday block in 2008, but it found another home on Cartoon Network when Adult Swim revived Toonami.

Diungkapkan bahwa gurren lagann ran on the block from august 2014 to march 2015, bringing its wild mix of giant robots, over-the-top speeches, and pure hype to a new generation. Directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi, who later co-founded Studio Trigger and directed Netflix's Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, the 27-episode series remains one of the studio's most beloved works.

Diungkapkan bahwa set in a future where the tyrannical spiral king, lordgenome, forces humanity to live in cramped underground villages, the story follows timid fourteen-year-old digger simon and his fearless big brother kamina. Their lives change when Simon discovers a glowing Core Drill and a buried mecha called Lagann.

Berdasarkan laporan, after breaking through the ceiling to reach the surface, they meet sharp-shooting fighter yoko littner and begin a rebellion against lordgenome's beastmen. And yes, the show gets every bit as ridiculous and awesome as that sounds. What starts with a small team called Dai-Gurren eventually turns into a galaxy-sized war against the Anti-Spirals. All 27 episodes are currently streaming on Netflix.

Diungkapkan bahwa few anime openings are as instantly recognisable as case closed's jazzy saxophone theme. Gosho Aoyama and TMS Entertainment's long-running mystery series first arrived on American cable through Cartoon Network's Adult Swim block in May 2004 under the localized title Case Closed. It even renamed its leads Jimmy Kudo and Rachel Moore for the US audience. The series aired there until September 2005, while also becoming a regular part of daytime Cartoon Network programming across international regions.

Diungkapkan bahwa the story follows teenage detective prodigy shinichi kudo, who gets caught investigating a shady deal involving the black organization. After the syndicate forces him to swallow an experimental poison called APTX 4869, Shinichi wakes up in the body of a first-grader.

Sebagaimana diketahui, taking the alias conan edogawa, he moves in with his childhood crush, ran mori, and her bumbling private-eye father, kogoro. With Professor Agasa's tranquilizer wristwatch and voice-changing bowtie, Conan secretly uses Kogoro to solve impossible cases while searching for the people who poisoned him. Following TMS's July 2025 relaunch under the original Detective Conan title with a brand-new English dub, curated episode collections are now available on Netflix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wielding a reverse-blade katana and hiding a blood-soaked past behind a goofy smile, rurouni kenshin gave early-2000s cartoon network viewers a samurai hero unlike anyone else on television. Studio Gallop and Studio Deen’s 1996 classic first hit American cable on Toonami’s weekday afternoon lineup in March 2003, instantly hooking kids after school before shifting to Cartoon Network’s Saturday night SVES block to finish its legendary 62-episode run through the Kyoto Arc.

Diungkapkan bahwa set in 1878 during japan’s meiji era, the story follows the former imperialist assassin once feared as “battosai the manslayer. ” Haunted by the lives he took during the revolution, Kenshin wanders the countryside under a strict vow never to kill again. After saving hot-headed kendo instructor Kaoru Kamiya in Tokyo, he finds a peaceful new home at her dojo alongside scrappy orphan Yahiko Myojin and street brawler Sanosuke Sagara.

Diungkapkan bahwa fans seeking a nostalgic journey need look no further. These ten Cartoon Network and Toonami anime are now available on streaming platforms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, peace never lasts long as deadly figures from his past, including longtime shinsengumi rival hajime saito and bandage-wrapped mastermind makoto shishio, force him to draw his blade once more. Fans can relive that unforgettable journey on Netflix through both seasons of Liden Films’ modern remake and the five-movie live-action saga.

#881. Listen to the River! ‘Arrow for a Stone Heart’ Is a Poetic Hybrid Experience Told Through an Indigenous Lens

📅 15 Nov 2026

Listen to the River! ‘Arrow for a Stone Heart’ Is a Poetic Hybrid Experience Told Through an Indigenous Lens

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/arrow-for-a-stone-heart-film-brazil-indigenous-lens-tallinn-1236753851/

Yes, a peccary in the forest near São Paulo is also talking to us in writer, director and cinematographer Luiza Calagian's debut feature premiering in Tallinn's Rebels With a Cause Competition - find out why.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a pig-like creature is walking around in the territory of the indigenous guaraní on the outskirts of são paulo, brazil. And it shares what started happening to nature back in the days when the colonizers began to settle. “My name is Rete, I am a peccary,” it tells us. “One day, those who are many started arriving. ” Over time, the stones they brought started swallowing up more and more space, restricting an ancient river, plants and many creatures.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also in the indigenous territory, a woman named jera rete dreams. In her nightmares, the city invades her village. And even the river has a voice – if you are only willing to listen. Related Stories Movies 'Fatherland' Wins Top Camerimage Prize as 'Wild Horse Nine' Nabs Audience Award Lifestyle L. But there is also an old woman who keeps talking to her. A. 's Most Celebrated French Chef Is Staging a Comeback.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in her poetic debut feature, arrow for a stone heart (flecha para um coração de pedra), writer, director and cinematographer luiza calagian, in collaboration with the local guaraní indigenous community, transport us into the heart of the forest near the city. And the documentary-fiction hybrid’s narrative is very different for a reason. The way the indigenous people experience and narrate reality is different. From their perspective, myths, dreams, and relationships with non-humans connect different temporalities and perspectives.

Berdasarkan laporan, the cinematic, maybe even hallucinatory, journey that the movie takes us on elucidates the history of the community’s struggle. Cinema emerges as an opportunity for understanding and, possibly, change.

Berdasarkan laporan, arrow for a stone heart celebrates its world premiere on tuesday, nov. 17, in the Rebels with a Cause Competition of the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF) in Estonia.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, calagian co-wrote the film with jera rete. Ahead of the world premiere, Calagian told THR about how the idea for Arrow for a Stone Heart came about and its unique voice, look and feel. Calagian also handled cinematography and shared the editing duties with Caio De. “I kind of grew up with this film. The producers are Vinicius Toro and Sabrina Zimmermann, with Bruno Cucio serving as executive producer. It had to be told from their point of view and from their perspective rather than one that comes from the West. It’s been seven years now,” the creative explains. Utopia Docs is handling distribution and world sales. “The film began to transform as well, and at a certain point, I understood that it wouldn’t make sense for me to try to tell the story, which is the story of the Guaraní. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so, how do you do that in a comprehensive way? “the mission became how do we bring the guaraní cosmology, the guaraní philosophy, the way that they see, organize, narrate and symbolize reality into the structure of a film, which is by its nature a western thing,” calagian tells thr. “But this also opened up the possibilities of transformation that this art has. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the first thing she started looking at was dreams. “The Guaraní are very, very, very connected to their dreams,” she explains. “They don’t understand dreams just as something that your mind creates or something that your imagination creates, but the dream for them is a form of connecting to other dimensions, other beings, other spirits, to people who are not here anymore, and to gods. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the process, jera became a close friend. “She also started organizing who was going to be in the film. “She embraced the project to the point that she became a co-writer,” Calagian shares with THR. She is the leader of this village, and she became not only the co-writer but also the whole heart of the film. So everything kind of revolves around Jera. The main characters other than her are her two daughters. One of the girls, her youngest, plays the river, and the older daughter, who also appears briefly at the end of the film, voiced Rete, the peccary. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the filmmaker also fell in love with rete, the peccary. “It has a lot to do with the magic of cinema. The Guaraní say it has the capacity of moving and traveling between worlds and entering different dimensions, different perspectives and visiting the gods. And the peccary became the symbol of her production company, Mata Fechada Filmes. “For me, it is a symbol,” Calagian says. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, humans destroying the natural balance and colonization are recurring themes of arrow for a stone heart. Despite all of this destruction, there is still life in the river, which is amazing. The river, for example, is considered one of the wisest and most powerful spirits for the Guaraní. “That’s why I wanted to include this character, the river, to tell her side of the story. She represents an anthropomorphic presence. “Even before colonization, when everything was more in harmony, the Guaraní were very careful and very respectful of those river spirits because they can be dangerous – they are not to be messed with,” the filmmaker highlights. Somehow, nature finds a way to survive, even in such adverse conditions. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, even words and language were chosen with care to properly represent the indigenous people’s view of the world. “Those who are many” is one of the recurring phrases, for example. “That is the common way they call the people who invaded,” Calagian tells THR.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, she has actually worked with the guaraní for more than 10 years now, having in the past also focused on communications efforts to make their voice heard. “We were working on a campaign to make the government recognize the indigenous lands that they had inside the city, one of the biggest metropolises in the world,” the filmmaker notes. “There is a big historical dispute around the history of colonization, especially in São Paulo. There is a regional culture that celebrates the colonizers who were responsible for invading this territory, which has always been Guaraní territory. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, that’s also where the film title, arrow for a stone heart, comes from. It is not only a play on the phrase “heart of stone” for cruel or cold-hearted people but also a reference to the statues and other reminders and colonialism. “There are still a lot of historical monuments, a lot of street names, a lot of public political symbols that celebrate the colonizers, the people who killed and enslaved the indigenous people,” highlights Calagian. “We understood how important this dispute between narratives was, and that’s how this project was born. ”.

The 30-year-old has also been nominated for best actress at the European Film Awards, while May el-Toukhy's Golden Lion winner is representing Denmark in the best international feature race at the Oscars.

Danish actress Mathilde Arcel would be the first to admit she didn’t see this coming.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s been hardly two months since arcel, in her first-ever leading role in a feature film, was awarded the volpi cup for best actress for her breakout performance in “woman unknown,” may el-toukhy’s riveting, post-world war ii drama that was also feted with the festival’s golden lion. Praised by Variety‘s Beatrice Loayza for her “magnetic” performance, Arcel plays a young housemaid whose intimate relationship with a German soldier during World War II threatens her future. Related Stories Did Midterm Elections Cause Changes in News World Order? Fox and Endemol Shine Team to Adapt 'Fear Factor' as a Scripted Microdrama Series for My Drama App.

Berdasarkan laporan, now, on the eve of the closing ceremony of the thessaloniki film festival, which wraps nov. 15 with el-Toukhy’s Venice winner, Arcel is taking in the news that she’s among the six nominees for best actress at the European Film Awards, whose nominations were announced Saturday afternoon in Thessaloniki.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for arcel, whose grandmother comes from the greek island of lesvos, the award ceremony, which will be held in athens in january, feels like “a weird kind of homecoming. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa over coffee at thessaloniki’s mediterranean palace, the 30-year-old still seems awestruck by her meteoric rise. Just over two months ago, Arcel was herself a relative unknown, with a career that had mostly spanned the stage and television. Before her Venice breakout, her only appearances on the big screen were in supporting roles.

After accepting best actress honors on the Lido, Arcel revealed to Danish media that she’d been collecting unemployment benefits ahead of the Italian fest; she was on her way to report to a job center in Copenhagen when she got word that she needed to fly back to Venice for the award ceremony.

Reflecting in Thessaloniki on what she describes with wide eyes as “an adventure,” Arcel says, laughing, “It’s only downhill from here, right?”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “woman unknown” draws on accounts of the many women across europe who in peacetime were publicly shamed for their actions during the nazi occupation — women whose stories have been swept to the margins of the collective memory of world war ii. Accepting the Golden Lion in Venice, el-Touky acknowledged that the film had been “incredibly challenging to make financially, logistically, emotionally,” adding that “what kept me going was the urgent need to illuminate the unknown women of our common history, to make them known. ”.

For Arcel, that history hit close to home.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i remember my danish grandma, when i asked about the war, she told me that she was a kid on the day of the liberation, and she remembered that all of these women, her neighbors, were suddenly being pulled out onto the street. “It really stuck with me, that this was…her most vivid memory from the occupation. Other neighbors spitting at them, calling them names. Their hair was cut off,” Arcel says. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, still, until she began researching the part, the actress says she “didn’t know how vast this phenomenon was, all across europe, how these women were treated. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in some ways, arcel might have been destined for the part; after graduating from drama school in copenhagen, she says, el-toukhy was “the first person i wrote to. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i wrote to her that i really loved her movies and i would love to work with her. It was very different from the parts I’d played. I didn’t think it would happen,” she says. “But then she called me in for a casting. It was a new kind of challenge. I definitely didn’t think I would get it, because I felt like the role had a different vibe to it than what I thought at that time was a natural fit for me…. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, her feelings changed once she unexpectedly landed the role, and she began to discuss the part with el-toukhy. “When I read it, I couldn’t get a read on [the character of Marie] immediately,” she says. “It was kind of like detective work when I started working with her to see what kind of person she is and why she does what she does. It was intriguing. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, as with the director’s 2019 drama “queen of hearts,” which stars trine dyrholm as a successful lawyer whose life gets turned upside down by an illicit affair, arcel praises el-toukhy for her ability to craft female characters “that are complex in their morality,” something that she describes as “quite rare. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, working with the danish egyptian filmmaker was a “very collaborative process,” she adds, describing the duo as “a good team. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i wanted to know as much as i could about the period. “May is also very hands-on in the research. We both want to do everything we can to know as much as possible. What kind of dreams did they have at that time? What kind of movies did they watch? What kind of music did they hear?” Arcel says. ”.

Next up for Arcel is a trip to the Marrakech Film Festival, where “Woman Unknown” plays in the festival’s Horizons section, while an Oscar campaign in the best international feature category is also underway, after Denmark selected the film as its submission for the 99th Academy Awards.

Berdasarkan laporan, scripts have begun pouring in and the actress — who now has u. S. representation — has cleared her calendar for the next six months as she considers various offers.

Berdasarkan laporan, for now, it’s too soon to say what comes next. “It feels like being on the verge of something that might happen and might not even happen. A lot of dreams and hopes. “It’s very different, very exciting,” she says. Everything is open. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the thessaloniki film festival runs nov. 5 – 15.

#889. Can You Feel It in the Air Tonight? 11 Best Moments From 2026 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony

📅 15 Nov 2026

Can You Feel It in the Air Tonight? 11 Best Moments From 2026 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.billboard.com/lists/2026-rock-roll-hall-fame-ceremony-recap-best-moments/

From Cynthia Erivo & Travis Barker doing *the* drum break justice to the Red Hot Chilli Peppers donning Rick Rubin wigs, these were our highlights.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while many of the headlines leading up to the 2026 rock & roll hall of fame induction ceremony this weekend were about who wouldn’t be there, our highlights from saturday night’s (nov. 14) show at L. A. ’s Peacock Theatre are all about who showed up and showed out.

The night was bookended by two surprise performances, starting with 2005 inductees U2 playing a brand-new song and a classic to kick things off and ending with 2001 inductees Aerosmith joining forces with 2009 inductees Run-DMC to perform their pioneering rock/hip-hop mash-up “Walk This Way,” a top five Billboard Hot 100 smash in 1986.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in between, a mixture of rising stars and bona fide legends showed up to either introduce or pay musical tribute to the class of 2026 — or, in some cases, the inductees themselves got in on the action. The full Wu-Tang Clan hit the stage for a medley, while Queen Latifah and MC Lyte joined forces for a joint performance celebrating their contributions as women in hip-hop, Billy Idol and his longtime guitarist Steve Stevens did one solo song and one duet with a famous face, and Peter Hook of Joy Division and New Order was surrounded by superfans for a celebration of his dual groups.

Berdasarkan laporan, the through-line of the night was innovation. While the Rock Hall has expanded far beyond the genre of rock & roll, each member of the new class has something vital in common: They changed music for generations to come.

Diungkapkan bahwa below, find billboard‘s best moments from the 2026 rock & roll hall of fame induction ceremony, which will air dec. m. 8 from 8-11 p. ET on ABC and stream on Disney+ the next day.

Diungkapkan bahwa u2 crashed the rock hall ceremony, opening the show with a surprise two-song set a day after releasing their new album, carnaval de luz. The band wasn’t on the bill — they were inducted back in 2005, their first year of eligibility — but they kicked off the night with “Silencio,” the album’s second single, joined by a line of performers dressed as riot police and carrying shields, then closed with 1984’s “Pride (In the Name of Love). ” The twofer from the Hall of Fame vets set the tone for an evening of legends only.

Diungkapkan bahwa trying to match luther vandross’ velvety vocals is a thankless task, but usher was up for the challenge, paying tribute to the late r&b legend with a smooth medley of “so amazing,” “never too much” and “here and now,” a top 10 billboard hot 100 hit in 1990. He nailed the warmth of Luther’s voice, but Usher also made sure to leave in his own signature dance moves for “Never Too Much” to make it his own.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, oprah winfrey, vandross’ friend and fan, nodded to the swag usher channeled for the performance in her induction speech, saying, “the new york times called him the king of the soul ballad. Both are so true, but I think perhaps more accurate was when Luther was named the top artist that people made love to. He was praised by critics as the Pavarotti of Pop. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, neither sade the singer nor her namesake band were in the building for their rock hall induction, but the nigerian-british icon loomed large thanks in part to an intro package that included a very complimentary drake interview, with the canadian rapper praising her “haunting” music and declaring: “there are no bad sade songs. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, case in point: the band’s 1985 top five hot 100 hit “smooth operator,” which rising british star sienna spiro covered after an introduction from fellow sade superfan andra day. “There will only be one Sade,” Day said — but fellow Londoner Spiro brought her own powerhouse vocals to the song to honor the absent superstar.

Berdasarkan laporan, in one of the most striking performances of the night, cynthia erivo covered “in the air tonight” in honor of inductee phil collins — who was previously inducted into the rock hall as part of genesis — and blink-182 drummer travis barker joined her for one of the most iconic drum breaks in all of pop music. It was a perfect illustration of the power of Collins’ career, between the excellent, haunting songwriting and the drum-forward production, and Erivo and Barker were an electric pair.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, barker also gave a speech in tribute to collins, saying of his balancing act between playing in genesis and his solo career: “he wasn’t just successful at both; he was one of the best at both. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in his own speech, collins also put the drums center stage, noting, “i grew up wanting to play drums. Everything else has been a happy accident. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, chris rock gave a note-perfect introduction to wu-tang clan, declaring: “wu-tang didn’t leave staten island; they took it with them. ” He also added to their many catchphrases when he said, “Wu-Tang is for the children, Wu-Tang is forever, and now Wu-Tang is in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all nine living members attended the ceremony, with the group paying tribute to late rapper ol’ dirty bastard throughout. And for everybody that didn’t, you can kiss my inducted a–. RZA had the lengthiest speech of the group, while Method Man kept it light by saying, “I want to thank everybody that believed in us, including the Hall of Fame. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the group also took the stage for a medley that included “c. E. A. M. R. ” and “Wu‐Tang Clan Ain’t Nuthing ta F’ Wit,” as well as ODB’s son Young Dirty Bastard taking over for his dad on “Shimmy Shimmy Ya. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a lot of headlines ahead of saturday’s ceremony centered on who wasn’t going to be in attendance, including the previously warring, now-touring-again gallagher brothers. But Better Call Saul star Bob Odenkirk wasn’t too shocked by the news that Oasis had opted out.

Berdasarkan laporan, “anybody surprised they didn’t show up?” odenkirk asked the crowd, immediately adding, “they didn’t want to be here! it would have been out of character if they had. I would’ve worried about them. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, in his intro, odenkirk said he listened to their music to get pumped up before playing breaking bad attorney saul goodman. “I played Oasis songs every day before stepping on set. … If I needed that injection of swagger, energy, moxie, I needed a dose of Viagra for the ego. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, in oasis’ absence, stephen wilson jr. put a country-rock spin on their 1995 smash “Wonderwall. ”.

With Queen Latifah and MC Lyte both being inducted into the Rock Hall in the same year, it only made sense that their paths would overlap, just like they have in the music industry as pioneers of hip-hop.

Berdasarkan laporan, mc lyte was inducted first, with an introduction from fellow female mc remy ma, while megan thee stallion inducted queen later in the night (with a crown fittingly placed atop her head). Both women shouted each other out in their speeches — and they also shouted out their respective sororities, to big whoops from the crowd. And finally, they took the stage together for a medley of their hits (along with Meg and Remy), proving that U-N-I-T-Y always goes a long way in lifting other women up in the historically male-dominated genre.

Berdasarkan laporan, “thank you to my sisters in the name of hip-hop,” queen said during her speech. But when I heard Lyte rap, I was like, ‘Yo, what is that? I want to do that!’ … And then we met, and we just hit it off like sisters. If it wasn’t for Lyte, I don’t know if I would have known this was really possible. “Thank you, MC Lyte. We just had so much fun doing this thing we love. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, just like his unpredictable career, rick rubin also had one of the most unexpected tributes of the night. It all started with a 10-minute-plus monologue/stand-up routine from Neil Young as he led the crowd through Rubin’s winding work history and was book-ended by a speech that made up for the rock legend’s verbosity.

“You can’t kill rock & roll,” Rubin succinctly stated and then quickly left the mic.

Berdasarkan laporan, but it was a pair of musical performances that were the real rubin highlights. Then the show ended with Aerosmith and Run-DMC joining forces for the Rubin brainchild “Walk This Way. First, the Red Hot Chilli Peppers — all hysterically wearing Rubin’s signature long hair-and-beard combo — hit the stage to perform “Give It Away,” from the Rubin-produced 1991 classic album Blood Sugar Sex Magik. ” The pair of musically powerful-yet-slightly offbeat sets set just the right tone for honoring the yogi producer.

You can’t celebrate New Order without first celebrating the band’s origins as Joy Division, which is why the Rock Hall made the unusual move of giving a dual honor to the group fronted by singer Ian Curtis as well as the band that rose after Curtis’ untimely death with the remaining members.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that twofold honor was on perfect display saturday night thanks to a performance that included bassist peter hook jamming with deftones’ chino moreno and chvrches’ lauren mayberry for joy division’s “love will tear us apart” and new order’s “bizarre love triangle. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as trent reznor said while introducing them, “there are only two types of people in this world: those who already know just how influential joy division and new order are, and those whose favorite bands — such as u2, radiohead, the cure, the killers, nirvana, depeche mode — how different they would sound if joy division and new order never existed. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa presenter jack black let everyone know early in his speech that iron maiden wouldn’t be in the building for the rock hall ceremony (“they aren’t even here tonight because they’re rocking a world tour as they have been for the last 50 years!” he said proudly), but the metal-loving actor came bearing bad news/good news. Because performing 1983’s “The Trooper” in their stead would be “a supergroup the likes of which have never been seen. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i’m talking about guitar god john 5. And on lead vocals, we got St. I’m talking about Brad Wilk from Rage Against the Machine. I’m talking about Kirk Hammett and Robert Trujillo of Metallica. Vincent!”.

Berdasarkan laporan, black then mashed up all their names for this supergroup title: “give it up for the st. Rage-a-tallica 5!”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the hard rock showcase did not disappoint, with st. Vincent taking the lead and superfan Black even chiming in for some harmonies.

As the final inductee of the night, Billy Idol had a robust showcase, between an intro from No Doubt’s Gwen Stefani and Tony Kanal, a solo performance of “Rebel Yell” as well as a Stefani duet on “Eyes Without a Face,” and a 10-minute-plus speech shared with his longtime guitarist and songwriting collaborator Steve Stevens.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and it was the joy of idol’s speech that ended the evening on a high note, with him imparting wisdom to the next potential honorees. Find out who you are and be it. Go make the impossible possible. “To all the young people out there … now it’s your turn. ”.

Oh, and one last thing: “Now I’m going to party with the Wu-Tang Clan!”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hall left taxiride in 2001 to pursue solo work and later formed the band airway lanes. He subsequently returned to Taxiride, and the band has continued performing in Australia, with dates still in the diary at the time of his death.

Diungkapkan bahwa singh, his former bandmate, said he was “absolutely shattered. Forever in my soul. I. ” Writing on social media, he said: “R. I’m totally heart broken. my brother Dan Hall. P. Thank you for being one of the hugest parts of my life brother. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, jakarta world cinema has taken its festival outside the indonesian capital for the first time, with the inaugural bandung world cinema and malang world cinema opening simultaneously on nov. 14 in two cities with large student populations and busy creative scenes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bandung’s screenings are taking place at cgv paris van java, while malang’s are at cinépolis malang town square, with both editions running through nov. The move takes the festival to audiences who have tracked the Jakarta event from elsewhere in the country. 21. Related Stories Fox Commits to Carrying Non-Fox Content on Roku for at Least 3 Years as DOJ Closes Antitrust Investigation HBO's 'The Gilded Age' Season 4 Ratings: Most-Watched Premiere Yet.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the bandung edition is programming 203 international titles drawn from 69 countries. Cristian Mungiu’s “Fjord,” which won this year’s Palme d’Or at Cannes, opened proceedings.

Berdasarkan laporan, also on the slate are beth de araujo’s “josephine,” which took both the grand jury prize and the audience award in sundance’s u. S. Dramatic Competition in 2026, and Marine Atlan’s “La Gradiva,” winner of the AMI Paris Grand Prize at this year’s Cannes Critics’ Week. Sandra Wollner’s “Everytime,” which picked up the Un Certain Regard Prize at Cannes, screens alongside Kurosawa Kiyoshi’s new feature “The Samurai and the Prisoner,” a Cannes Premiere selection.

Diungkapkan bahwa the festival’s online program, available until nov. 21, includes Ildiko Enyedi’s “Silent Friend,” a Fipresci Prize winner at Venice in 2025, and Ilker Çatak’s “Yellow Letters,” this year’s Golden Bear winner at the Berlinale.

Bandung Mayor Muhammad Farhan attended the opening night at CGV Paris Van Java.

Berdasarkan laporan, “bandung world cinema gives the local audience an unprecedented opportunity to watch alternative cinema outside of the mainstream hollywood films that dominate the theaters. The hope is that this festival will foster a greater local appreciation for film, become a source of inspiration for cinephiles, and encourage aspiring filmmakers to pursue their dreams,” Farhan said.

Diungkapkan bahwa frederica, executive director of bandung world cinema, said organizers had noticed keen interest from cinephiles beyond jakarta for years. “Over the next eight days, audiences in both cities will experience the exact same caliber of bold, thought-provoking, and celebrated global cinema that defines JWC. “Bringing the Jakarta World Cinema experience to Bandung and Malang for the first time has been a long time coming,” she said. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa unlike the jakarta event, bandung will wrap on nov. 21 with a free open-air screening for the general public. The outdoor program will feature work by students at Bandung universities and winners of the KlikFilm Short Movie Competition, before closing with a restored version of “Lewat Djam Malam” (“After the Curfew”), Usmar Ismail’s 1954 Indonesian classic.

Travis Barker inducted the Genesis frontman as a solo artist, while Cynthia Erivo performed "In the Air Tonight" in his place.

Sebagaimana diketahui, phil collins was inducted into the rock & roll hall of fame as a solo artist on saturday (nov. 14), and used his acceptance speech to tell the crowd he isn’t done yet. Explore Cynthia Erivo Genesis Phil Collins See latest videos, charts and news.

Berdasarkan laporan, “you haven’t heard the last of me,” collins said during the ceremony at the peacock theater in los angeles. “I promise you that. ” Related Karol G Surprises Mexico City Fans With Thalía as Special Guest: 'The First Person I Wanted to Be' Simple Plan, Hoobastank & More Take Warped Tour Mid-Flight Amid FAA Ground Stop Journey Drummer Deen Castronovo Exits Mid-Tour to Focus on His Health.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the honor marks collins’ second induction. He entered the Hall in 2010 as a member of Genesis, making him one of a small number of two-time inductees.

Diungkapkan bahwa travis barker inducted collins, highlighting his impact as a drummer. It helped define the sound of drums in the eighties, and you can still hear Phil’s influence today. ” “That sound changed everything. “I remember hearing the drums for the first time and being blown away,” the Blink-182 drummer said of “In the Air Tonight. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, barker also pointed to collins’ success with both genesis and his solo career. “He wasn’t just successful at both,” he said, “he was one of the best at both. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, collins did not perform at the ceremony. He said earlier this year that he had declined an invitation to play because he wasn’t “match-fit” enough to rehearse and sing properly, though he did not rule out returning to the stage. Cynthia Erivo performed “In the Air Tonight” in his place, with Barker on drums.

Diungkapkan bahwa in his speech, collins said he felt unprepared following a night of more polished addresses, and opened by telling the audience he’s “really not as bad as it looks. ” He said his career began with a single goal: “I grew up wanting to play drums. Everything else has been a happy accident. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, collins credited his assistant with saving his life, saying he needed to name her despite her dislike of attention. ” He said she had told him what he was doing was bad for him and what to do about it, adding that he’s “a well man now. “I’d be in a box six feet under. “I’m not joking when I say without her I wouldn’t be here,” he said. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa he also thanked longtime manager tony smith, atlantic records’ ahmet and nesuhi ertegun, and virgin records founder richard branson, who he said “took me under their wing and they saw something that was worth nurturing,” as well as “my three ex-wives, because they’ve loved me through the years and given me five great children. ” His daughter, actress Lily Collins, attended the ceremony with him.

Diungkapkan bahwa collins closed by naming eric clapton and robert plant among the musicians he has played with. “These guys were heroes to me,” he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the induction follows years of health issues for the 75-year-old musician. His son Nic played drums on Genesis’ 2021-22 farewell tour, with Collins singing from a seated position. A 2007 spinal injury caused nerve damage that left him unable to grip a drumstick, and he has since undergone knee surgeries and dealt with ongoing mobility problems. Collins told the BBC in January that he now has a 24-hour live-in nurse.

Diungkapkan bahwa as a solo artist, collins scored seven no. 1 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, including “Against All Odds (Take a Look at Me Now),” “Sussudio,” “One More Night” and “Another Day in Paradise. ” His albums No Jacket Required and …But Seriously both topped the Billboard 200.

Berdasarkan laporan, the 2026 rock & roll hall of fame induction ceremony airs dec. m. 8 from 8-11 p. ET on ABC and streams on Disney+ the following day.
